  • Ability to translate and present complex data in a manner that educates, enhances understanding, and influence decisions
  • Experience preparing reporting, metrics, and presentation materials for various levels of leadership
  • Proven research and analytical skills with the ability to independently work through complex and ambiguous situations
  • Partner with stakeholders responsible to document, improve and strengthen processes that support the Services including ensuring adherence to data quality and control standards
  • Hands on experience using Power BI and Tableau with understanding in underlying framework necessary to create visualizations that accentuate insights
  • Advanced Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and Access) skills
  • Proficient in using Python and / or R for data acquisition and analysis
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Proficient in Excel including pivot tables, complex formulas, VBA, and charts
  • Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to work with complex teams; have global experience, specifically US banks
  • Comfortable with making and presenting recommendations to a wide audience of stakeholders

Job Expectations

  • Translate business requirements into an array of business intelligence and metrics dashboards and reporting views in ServiceNow, Tableau, SharePoint, Power BI, Excel, and other platforms.
  • Translate business requirements into epics, features, and user stories
  • Update and create process and procedure documentation, detailed job aids, and training materials
  • Lead the development of new metrics and track/evaluate performance over time
  • Facilitate and host discussions to troubleshoot data issues that are out of line with requirements
  • Establish and promote Data Ops Best Practices in collaboration with multiple Product and Tech teams
  • Support Application Security’s technology and data environment modernization efforts
  • Research moderately complex business, operational, and strategic initiatives that require analytical skills, basic knowledge of organizational strategy and Business Execution, and understanding of international business

descriptionHtml:
About Us

CDK Global is a leading provider of cloud-based software to dealerships and Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) across automotive and related industries. The Company’s cloud-based, software as a service (“SaaS”) platform enables dealerships to manage their end-to-end business operations including the acquisition, sale, financing, insuring, repair, and maintenance of vehicles. By automating and streamlining critical workflows, the integrated platform of modern solutions enables dealers to sell and service more vehicles by creating simple and convenient experiences for customers and improves their financial and operational performance.

Position Summary

As an Associate Network Security Engineer at CDK Global, you will help secure the infrastructure that powers our SaaS platforms for the automotive industry. In this role, you will focus on the day-to-day administration, tuning, and monitoring of Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) and Web Application Firewalls (WAF). You will work closely with senior engineers to implement security policies, analyze application traffic, and troubleshoot network connectivity issues, ensuring a secure and reliable environment for our applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Firewall Administration: Assist in the configuration, deployment, and daily management of enterprise firewalls (such as Palo Alto Networks) to control internal and external network traffic.
  • WAF & ASM Management: Configure and tune Web Application Firewalls and Application Security Management (ASM) policies to protect internet-facing applications against OWASP Top 10 threats, botnets, and layer 7 attacks.
  • Policy Tuning & Optimization: Regularly review and optimize security policies and firewall rule sets to support Attack Surface Reduction initiatives and ensure least-privilege access.
  • Network Troubleshooting: Apply foundational networking knowledge to troubleshoot traffic flow, VPN connectivity, and access issues across the enterprise network.
  • Threat Monitoring & Response: Monitor security logs, investigate blocked traffic or anomalies, and work with application teams to resolve false positives while maintaining strict security postures.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate network diagrams, traffic flow documentation, and standard operating procedures for firewall and WAF deployments.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: Approximately 2 years of hands-on experience in network security, network operations, or a related technical support role.
  • Networking Knowledge: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, TCP/IP suite, routing protocols, DNS, DHCP, and VPN technologies.
  • Firewall Fundamentals: Practical experience managing and configuring Next-Generation Firewalls (creating rules, NAT policies, and monitoring logs).
  • WAF/ASM Concepts: General understanding of Web Application Firewalls, ASM modules, and web traffic security concepts (HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS termination, basic web vulnerabilities).
  • Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities and a methodical approach to analyzing network traffic and security events.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with network security frameworks like Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).
  • Experience with ticketing and change management workflows.
  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA Network+/Security+, CCNA, or vendor-specific firewall certifications (e.g., PCNSA).
  • Non-discrimination clause

The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship.

Business Unit:

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details:

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

Job Details:

Principal Operations Engineer

Service Operations

  • Product & Platform Engineering for NOC and SOC


Grade / Job Profile: P4

Reports to: NOC Senior Manager

Dotted line to: SOC Manager

Function: Service Operations

Location: Hyderabad, India

Work pattern: Shifts, with an on-call during weekends as technical expert for P1/P2 incidents

Experience: 8+ years in IT infrastructure, application support or operations; internal candidates with hands-on Cubic product experience preferred

Role Purpose

The Principal Operations Engineer is the product and platform expert who links how Cubic's products are built with how they are run. Involved from design and development through implementation and maintenance, you stay current on our products and bring that knowledge to the NOC and SOC to keep services available, performing well and secure, and to stop problems from coming back.

Your technical skills are broad across Windows, Linux, Azure, networking, Java applications and Microsoft SQL. Your depth is in Cubic's own products, applications and OT/IoT devices. You will serve the NOC and SOC equally, working alongside the teams that run day-to-day operations rather than duplicating them.

Product Portfolio

  • Each Principal Operations Engineer is primary for an assigned set of Cubic products and backup for another set, so every product always has cover.
  • Portfolios are set by the NOC Senior Manager, together with the SOC Manager, and reviewed as products and contracts change.


Key Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle: Design to Maintenance

  • Take part in design reviews and development check-ins for releases and major changes to portfolio products.
  • Define requirements for supportability, monitoring, logging, security and access before products go live.
  • Sign off operational readiness before go-live, and provide hypercare support for two weeks afterwards.
  • Keep up-to-date knowledge of portfolio products, applications and OT/IoT devices, and their architecture, dependencies and normal behaviour.


Availability and Performance

  • Monitor the health of portfolio products daily (availability, performance and capacity) and act on warning signs before they become incidents.
  • Act as technical expert for incidents and war rooms involving portfolio products, working with Incident Commanders and Major Incident Managers.
  • Run a monthly service review for each portfolio product covering availability, performance, incidents, problems, risks and upcoming changes.


Problem Prevention and Best Practices

  • Carry out the technical root-cause analysis for problems on portfolio products, working within the problem management process.
  • Deliver assigned problem fixes, and draft known-error entries and workarounds.
  • Build operational best practices, and feed lessons from problems into design reviews and readiness checklists so they don't recur.


Vulnerability Remediation into Production

  • Give technical guidance to the patch pod and to change and delivery teams on taking vulnerability fixes into live production: impact on products and services, test plan, rollback and readiness.
  • Act as technical reviewer at the change advisory board for changes affecting portfolio products and the Azure and Wintel estate.


Secure Operations Architecture (Azure and Wintel)

  • Maintain reference designs and hardening standards that support secure operations in Azure and Wintel environments.
  • Check portfolio products against hardening baselines every month, and raise gaps with the owning teams.


Application and Database Support

  • Act as the top internal escalation point for Java-based applications (JVM, threads, connection pools, application servers) and Microsoft SQL databases (slow queries, blocking, performance).
  • Diagnose problems that span several technologies across network, operating system, cloud, application and database layers.


NOC and SOC Support

  • Work a shared NOC/SOC consult queue in order of severity, with roughly equal capacity for each.
  • Provide product and infrastructure context to SOC investigations, including what normal behaviour looks like and the business impact of containment options.
  • Supply runbooks, product knowledge articles and known-error articles to NOC, SOC and the service desk.
  • Identify automation opportunities and define what healthy looks like for products, working with the automation pod and the observability team.
  • Take on additional design-to-support responsibilities for NOC-run services as defined by the NOC Senior Manager.


Compliance and Planning

  • Follow audit and compliance processes (including ISO 27001), and provide technical evidence and close findings for portfolio products.
  • Review capacity and end-of-life for portfolio products, and contribute to future hardware and software planning and budgets.


Working With Other Teams

This role makes other teams more effective on Cubic products. It does not duplicate their work.

Out of scope: alert triage, incident command, patch deployment, building automation, administering monitoring tools, and provisioning access.

Required Skills And Experience

Cubic Products

  • Thorough understanding of Cubic products, applications and OT/IoT devices: architecture, components, data flows, dependencies and how they connect to back-end and cloud services.


Broad Technical Skills

  • Windows / Wintel: Windows Server, Active Directory and Group Policy, with an understanding of hardening.
  • Linux: administration and troubleshooting.
  • Microsoft Azure: compute, networking, identity and security services, with the ability to design secure operations; working knowledge of AWS.
  • Networking: TCP/IP, routing and switching, firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP and load balancers.
  • Application support: Java-based applications and application servers, including JVM, thread and heap analysis.
  • Microsoft SQL Server: performance, query plans, blocking, backup and restore, and access control.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (AppDynamics, SolarWinds, Oracle Enterprise Manager, Site24x7, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch).


Process and Professional Skills

  • ITIL change, problem and release management; experience with operational readiness and service transition.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  • Structured, analytical troubleshooting across technology layers.
  • Clear communication with engineers, delivery teams, auditors and senior stakeholders, and the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to balance competing NOC and SOC priorities.


Preferred Skills

  • Scripting in PowerShell or Python.
  • Experience with OT/IoT device management, gateways and firmware lifecycle.
  • Experience supporting a SOC or security investigations.
  • Experience in a multi-customer environment with contract-specific SLAs.


Certifications (Preferred)

  • ITIL 4 Foundation or higher
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • ISO 27001 Foundation or Internal Auditor
  • CCNA, RHCSA or equivalent


Success Measures

Targets are baselined during the first 60–90 days. Individual measures cover work this role controls; shared measures cover outcomes this role influences alongside other teams. Suggested weighting: individual 60%, shared 40%.

Summary

 Position Summary

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform their security posture.

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Serving as a primary point of contact for client stakeholders and supporting security automation strategy and value realization
  • Designing, developing, and managing SOAR playbooks for triage, enrichment, investigation, containment, escalation, and remediation
  • Leading integrations across security platforms, including security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity and access management (IAM), threat intelligence, ticketing, firewall, email, cloud, and endpoint security tools
  • Building and optimizing AI-augmented SOAR workflows, including alert triage, contextual enrichment, incident summarization, escalation logic, and governed decisioning
  • Defining automation metrics, dashboards, technical documentation, and workflow improvements to enhance reliability, scalability, and security operations maturity

The team

Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR).

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, SOAR engineering, security automation, or security operations
  • Experience with SOAR platforms such as Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Swimlane, IBM Resilient, or Tines
  • Experience with security operations center processes, security information and event management (SIEM) workflows, and incident response lifecycle activities
  • Experience integrating application programming interfaces (APIs), webhooks, and third-party security technologies into automated workflows
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, REST APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies
  • Experience designing AI-augmented SOAR workflows that include large language model (LLM)-based reasoning, prompt engineering, output validation, and human-in-the-loop decisioning
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, or Information Technology

Preferred:

  • Experience with multi-cloud security environments across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, detection engineering, and incident response practices
  • Experience with information technology service management (ITSM) or case management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira
  • Relevant certifications in cybersecurity, cloud security, or SOAR or SIEM platforms
  • Experience with AI-assisted playbook generation, machine learning-based alert triage, or automated incident summarization in enterprise SOAR platforms
  • Experience architecting Claude-based or equivalent agentic security operations center capabilities, including tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), extended reasoning, or structured outputs

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

CMS-TDR Senior

As part of our EY-cyber security team, who shall work as SME for Defender XDR security solutions in CMS TDR team

The opportunity

We’re looking for Senior Consultant with expertise in Microsoft Defender. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Architecting and implementation of Defender XDR.
  • Perform as the subject matter expert on Microsoft Defender for the customer, use the capabilities of the solution in the daily operational work for the end customer.
  • Securing overall cloud environments by applying cybersecurity tools and best practices
  • Advise customers on best practices and use cases on how to use this solution to achieve customer end state requirements.
  • Content development which includes developing process for automated security event monitoring and alerting along with corresponding event response plans for systems

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender and related technologies (e.g., Windows Defender, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for cloud, Defender for IoT).
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, with a strong commitment to customer service and teamwork.
  • Expertise in use case management in Defender XDR
  • Create and maintain documentation related to Microsoft Defender configuration, policies, procedures, and incident response playbooks.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Intune for AV policy creation and deployment
  • Knowledge in Cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS
  • Strong technical knowledge in Windows Server/Linux
  • Identify opportunities for performance optimization and efficiency improvements within Microsoft Defender solutions, and implement changes as needed
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Extensive knowledge of different security threats
  • Good knowledge and experience in Security Monitoring
  • Good knowledge and experience in Cyber Incident Response

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
  • Strong command on verbal and written English language.
  • Demonstrate both technical acumen and critical thinking abilities.
  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
  • Certification in Azure (SC-200, SC-100, SC-900,AZ-500) (any other cloud vendor certification is a plus)

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  • Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
  • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
  • The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

descriptionHtml:
Job title: Network Security Engineer

  • Location: Hyderabad
  • Hybrid Mode

Our Team

Faced with an ever-increasing cyber-security threat, Sanofi needs to maintain a vigilant approach to protect their systems, infrastructure, and data.

This team, behind Sanofi’s Next Generation Network & Security services and infrastructure that powers it, is looking for a self-motivated and innovative thinking individual to raise the bar on Sanofi’s Network Security systems while maintaining relevance in the fast moving and evolving network security industry.

As a member of the team, closely with Network Engineering, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Architecture teams to implement security controls, improve network resilience, automate security operations, and respond to security incidents.

You will also be interacting with cross-functional team engineers, architects, internal and vendor partners to evangelize and provide NextGEN network security technology solutions to;

  • Maximize the business value from Sanofi’s Digital Technology and Solutions investments.
  • Unleash innovation for our organization, employees, and customers.

Main Responsibilities

Network Security Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, efficient, & cost-effective enterprise network security solutions
    • Next-generation firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, secure web gateways, and network access controls.
  • Keep Sanofi safe through active operation and defense of critical network infrastructure, developing and maintaining firewall policies, security zones, NAT, routing, and access-control policies.
  • Implement secure LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Internet, data center, and cloud connectivity.
  • Design, implement and support network segmentation, micro-segmentation, and Zero Trust security initiatives.
  • Conduct security reviews of network designs and infrastructure changes.
  • Ensure network security controls comply with enterprise security standards and policies.
Ultimately, ensure high levels of security, availability, and performance within the Sanofi’s environment.

Cloud & Modern Network Security

  • Implement security controls across AWS, Azure, and/or other cloud environments.
  • Secure hybrid and multi-cloud network connectivity.
  • Design secure connectivity between data centers, cloud platforms, SaaS environments, and remote users.
  • Support SASE, SSE, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and cloud security initiatives.
  • Partner with cloud engineers to secure VPC/VNet, routing, security groups, and cloud firewall architecture.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Monitor network security events and investigate suspicious network activity.
  • Troubleshoot and respond to network security incidents.
  • Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and remediation activities.
  • Analyze firewall, proxy, VPN, IDS/IPS, DNS, and network traffic logs.
  • Work with SOC teams to improve detection and response capabilities.
  • Perform vulnerability remediation and security hardening of network infrastructure.

Automation, Improve Efficiency & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate service delivery, network security provisioning, configuration, compliance, and operational processes.
  • Develop scripts and workflows using Python, Ansible, Terraform, APIs, or similar technologies.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration-management practices.
  • Develop automated security compliance and configuration validation.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual operational activities through automation.

Governance & Documentation

  • Maintain network security architecture diagrams, standards, procedures, and operational documentation.
  • Participate in security assessments, audits, and compliance activities.
  • Ensure network changes follow enterprise change management and security processes.
  • Evaluate emerging security technologies and recommend improvements.

Drive Continuous improvement of solution platform, specification & design, systems integration, platform lifecycle management.

Contribute to security standards, reference architectures, and engineering best practices.

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in network engineering or network security engineering.
  • Understanding complex technical issues and managing them within a fast-paced business environment.
  • An enthusiasm for staying up to date with the very latest updates about security threats and technology solutions.
  • Strong experience in architecture/design, development, and implementation of large-scale Network Security technology and solutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of Firewalls platforms from Palo Alto, Cisco and Checkpoint, IPS/IDS,
  • Experience with LAN, WAN, Internet, data centre, and/or SD-WAN environments and understanding of Network Routing and Switching.
  • Experience with AWS and or Azure networking, Cloud solutions and Network Access Control.
  • Experience with SASE, SSE, ZTNA, and Zero Trust architectures.
  • Understanding of and exposure to network segmentation and methodologies like SCADA and enable it to be both manageable and scalable.
  • Experience using firewall security orchestration and Python, Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, and network automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Audit for Firewalls configurations, ACLs and implementing security controls aligned to Sanofi’s policies and standards.
  • Excellent Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Occasional work outside business hours
  • Good communication and presentation skills in English including the ability to convey complex security related concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

descriptionHtml:
Truveta provides unprecedented real-world data and real-time intelligence, powered by a dataset built with and owned by US health systems united in a mission of Saving Lives with Data. Together, we power breakthrough medical discoveries, accelerate regulatory-grade evidence, and improve patient care. Today, Truveta enables research on more than 130 million de-identified patients across the US.

Achieving Truveta’s ambitious mission requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values.

This job requires daily onsite work at our headquarters in Hyderabad.  

Who we need 

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking candidates inspired by the opportunity to securely apply data in the development of real-world health solutions. Beyond core capabilities, we seek problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. 

We do things the right way. Our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance is foundational to the trust our members, customers, and partners place in us. This position is critical to protecting the infrastructure behind the most representative, complete, and timely source of linked patient data in the US.

If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you. 

This opportunity 

Success in the healthcare industry is predicated on a foundation of trust. We demonstrate our trustworthiness as stewards of health data through three foundational pillars: security, privacy, and compliance.  

At Truveta, data security is not just an internal requirement; it is essential to enabling trusted research, regulatory-grade evidence, and responsible innovation at scale. Truveta has achieved HITRUST r2 certification, completed a SOC 2 Type 2 examination, and maintains ISO 27001 certification, with ISO 27701 and ISO 27018 extensions. These certifications reflect a rigorous, independently assessed approach to managing risk, protecting sensitive data, and maintaining the controls required for a highly trusted research environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Azure cloud-based infrastructure, including using tools for infrastructure as code(IaC) and automation to meet technical, security and business needs.
  • Design and implement Azure cloud environments (tenant, subscription, VM, storage account, databases, networking, firewalling) optimized for AI/ML workloads.
  • Manage and maintain Azure Networking, Azure firewalls/VPN and associated policies/rules, Web Application Firewall, Application Gateway, Front Door, VNET peering, ensuring security, availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Secure Azure Kubernetes clusters, containers, and images.
  • Establish and enforce Azure security policies, manage access controls, and ensure the infrastructure complies with relevant regulations.
  • Automate tenant and infrastructure provisioning, deployments, and other routine tasks to increase efficiency.
  • Monitor Azure cloud resources, analyze performance, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
  • Perform incident troubleshoot and problem resolution for office network, cloud infrastructure, and own postmortems.
  • Work with Engineering teams and external teams, gather requirements, develop and integrate cloud solutions and support business needs.
  • Actively participate in architecture, code reviews, presentations, share learns and best practices to enable flawless deployment and quality operations.
  • Evaluate and implement new security features/services/products to secure Truveta Azure infrastructure.
  • Support innovation and cost management by developing new ideas for Azure cloud infrastructure and related tools.
  • Interact with compliance team to deliver compliance certificates and remediate gaps during compliance finding and controls.

Qualifications 

  • A minimum bachelor's in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent
  • 5+ years’ experience in public cloud networking & security design, implementation & support
  • Experience of TCP/IP IPv4/v6, office network (Routing/Switching/WAN, Wi-Fi & Security) management
  • 3+ years automation experience in Azure Cloud Networking / Azure DevOps or GitHub CI/CD pipelines in any of the following: Python, PowerShell, Terraform, Bicep, YAML template
  • 3+ years network security practices in on-premises and/or cloud environment
  • Experience managing and supporting Windows Desktop OS, MacOS, managed endpoint administration at scale across an enterprise sized environment
  • Understanding the Windows Desktop/Mac OS packaging, scripting, and automated deployment tools, such as Microsoft Intune and Jamf.
  • Ability to participate in on-call rotation

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in implementation & securing platforms/services in one or more public clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP) 
  • Self-starter with proven ability to develop creative solutions that enable customers and cost efficiency
  • Interest and ability to research new and emerging technologies to better solve cloud infrastructure problems or improve security posture
  • Certifications in Cloud/Network/Security (such as Azure AZ500, AZ700, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE 3-6, Palo Alto PCNSE, etc.)

Cyber Managed Services – Privileged Identity & Access Management – Senior Consultant (BeyondTrust PAM – Operations)

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Consultant – BeyondTrust PAM Operations to join our Cyber Managed Services team. This role focuses on delivering ongoing operational support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of BeyondTrust PAM environments for our clients. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in BeyondTrust operations, strong troubleshooting skills, and a commitment to ensuring secure and reliable access to privileged systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 operational support for BeyondTrust PAM-related issues, including access failures, session management disruptions, and system performance concerns.
  • Perform day-to-day administration of privileged accounts within the BeyondTrust platform — including provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and policy updates as per change requests.
  • Monitor BeyondTrust system health and logs proactively; perform regular housekeeping activities to ensure availability, stability, and performance.
  • Coordinate with client IT/security teams to maintain alignment with security policies, operational procedures, and audit requirements related to PAM.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and runbooks; contribute to documentation and knowledge base for consistent operations.
  • Perform routine health checks, validations, and access audits; work on remediation of findings from internal or external audits.
  • Support operational controls like Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), session recording, and other security configurations within the PAM environment.
  • Handle incident tickets, change requests, and service requests per agreed SLAs, escalating as needed and ensuring proper closure with documentation.
  • Keep up with BeyondTrust product updates, known issues, and patches to advise on operational relevance or risk.
  • Identify automation opportunities within day-to-day operations to reduce manual effort and increase efficiency.
  • Work closely with BeyondTrust support or third-party vendors when necessary to resolve product-level or environment-specific issues.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience in BeyondTrust Password Safe, Session Management, and general PAM operational functions.
  • Understanding of IAM concepts, access lifecycle management, and integration touchpoints with directory services or ticketing systems.
  • Working knowledge of ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira, etc.) for managing tickets and changes in a structured environment.
  • Basic scripting capabilities (e.g., PowerShell or Python) for automation or data extraction/reporting.
  • Ability to analyze logs and events to troubleshoot issues and provide RCA (Root Cause Analysis).
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, PCI-DSS, especially in an operations context.
  • Strong communication skills for stakeholder interactions, documentation, and process adherence.
  • Experience working in 24x7 or follow-the-sun support models.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Work Requirements:

  • Willingness to work in rotational shifts or be part of on-call support as per business needs.
  • Occasional off-hours or weekend support during critical issues or planned activities.
  • Readiness to collaborate across time zones with global teams or clients.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Description:

insightsoftware

Job Description

Job Title

Command Centre Specialist

Department

IT — Command Centre (DevOps)

Location

Hyderabad, India (On-site for the first 3–6 months; remote thereafter)

Reports To

Senior Manager / Director, Command Centre

Employment Type

Full-time, Permanent

Shift Pattern

24×7 rotational shifts

About Insightsoftware

insightsoftware is a global provider of connected solutions for the Office of the CFO. We empower business leaders with accessible insights and connected solutions to drive actionable business strategy. With operations spanning 40+ countries, we help finance and IT teams work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence.

Role Overview

We are establishing a new Command Centre in Hyderabad to provide around-the-clock monitoring, incident response, and operational support for our global multi-cloud infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments. The Command Centre Specialist will serve as an active operator, responsible for system monitoring, incident triage and resolution, execution of runbooks, and escalation of issues in accordance with established procedures. This role is highly execution-oriented and supports DevOps teams worldwide, adhering to ITIL best practices. The initial three to six months require on-site presence in Hyderabad for environment familiarization and team integration, after which the position will transition to remote work.

Key Responsibilities

Incident Response and Troubleshooting

  • Monitor alerts and triage incoming incidents—classify, prioritize, and document in Jira Service Management per ITIL guidelines.
  • Troubleshoot issues across multi cloud infrastructure (EC2, VPC, VPN, load balancers), identity and access management (IAM, SSO, directory services), networking (DNS, firewalls, routing), databases, and application layers.
  • Execute established runbooks and standard operating procedures to resolve or contain incidents within SLA targets.
  • Escalate unresolved or high-severity incidents to senior specialists or engineering teams with clear, accurate context.

Monitoring and Alerting

  • Monitor multi-cloud infrastructure, network, and security tooling 24×7 using enterprise observability platforms.
  • Identify anomalies, threshold breaches, and potential security events; take first-response action or escalate per SOPs.
  • Flag false positives and noisy alerts to senior specialists for threshold tuning and runbook updates.

Shift Operations

  • Participate in 24×7 rotational shifts; execute clean handoffs with detailed shift logs.
  • Follow escalation matrices and communication protocols during all incidents.
  • Maintain accurate, real-time operational logs throughout each shift.

Documentation and Knowledge Contribution

  • Update and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and SOPs in Confluence as issues are resolved.
  • Document recurring incidents and known workarounds to build the Command Centre knowledge base.
  • Log all actions taken during incidents for post-incident reviews and audit trails.

SLA Tracking and Reporting

  • Track incident response and resolution times against defined SLAs; flag breaches or at-risk tickets promptly.
  • Contribute to operational dashboards and shift reports as directed by senior specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in a Command Centre, NOC, or equivalent 24×7 operations environment.
  • 1–2 years of hands-on exposure to AWS and/or Azure—working familiarity with EC2, VPC, VPN, and IAM basics.
  • Practical troubleshooting skills across cloud, identity, network, database, and application layers.
  • Awareness of Kubernetes and containerized workloads sufficient to interpret alerts.
  • Networking fundamentals—TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and basic routing.
  • Familiarity with ITIL concepts (Incident, Problem, Change Management).
  • Experience with at least one monitoring/alerting tool—PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, or Azure Monitor.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills for shift logs, incident documentation, and escalations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ITIL V4 Foundation certification; any AWS or Azure foundational/associate certification.
  • Experience with Jira Service Management and Confluence.
  • Basic scripting skills (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for log analysis or simple automation.
  • Prior experience in a global, multi-time-zone support environment.

What We Offer

  • Be part of a greenfield Command Centre build in a high-growth global software company.
  • Hands-on exposure to a modern multi-cloud tech stack (AWS, Azure, SaaS, enterprise platforms).
  • Clear growth path—learn from senior specialists and grow into advanced operational roles.
  • Collaborative, results-oriented culture underpinned by our core values of Winning Attitude, One Team, and Disciplined Execution.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Summary

Role purpose: Build, integrate, deploy and operate the agent platform that powers AI-enabled Cyber Defense. Engineer reliable agent tools, Azure Functions, enterprise integrations, deployment pipelines and runtime controls so agents can move safely from development to production and remain observable, recoverable and supportable.

About The Role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain the Azure Functions, APIs, services and agent tools used to retrieve trusted information and perform approved actions
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, Purview, Graph, Cortex XDR, XSOAR, SharePoint, JIRA, Confluence, Azure Storage, Key Vault and other approved Cyber Defense systems
  • Implement agent workflows and backend services for notifications, feedback, state management, audit records, deduplication, orchestration and human approval
  • Implement versioning, release controls, automated testing, rollback and recovery patterns for agents and supporting services
  • Operate agent runtime reliability through telemetry, tracing, Application Insights, health checks, dashboards, alerts and actionable service-level indicators
  • Investigate and resolve production incidents involving agents, Azure Functions, identities, networking, data access, integrations and deployment pipelines
  • Monitor performance, latency, availability, token or model consumption, operational cost and integration health, and implement improvements based on evidence
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, support procedures, configuration records and deployment evidence

Essential Requirement

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, cloud platform engineering, DevOps, security automation or integration engineering
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production APIs, serverless functions or backend services. Practical experience with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure Functions, App Service, Key Vault, Managed Identity, Application Insights, Storage and private networking
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including environment promotion, approvals and rollback. Experience integrating enterprise systems through REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, certificates, OAuth 2.0 or managed identities
  • Understanding of agentic AI or LLM application patterns including tools/function calling, instructions, context, state, tracing and evaluation. Understanding of secure software engineering, secrets management, least privilege, input validation and auditability
  • Ability to troubleshoot across application code, identity, network, platform and dependent-service boundaries. Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly and collaborate across Cyber Defense, platform, architecture and engineering teams
  • Experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, agent frameworks, API Management or multi-agent implementations. Knowledge of LLMOps or AgentOps practices including prompt/instruction versioning, evaluation, tracing, cost controls and production guardrails
  • Background in Cyber Defense, security operations, detection engineering or SOAR automation. Experience designing test harnesses for adversarial inputs, prompt injection, permission boundaries and tool misuse
  • Experience evaluating and using frontier models for enterprise agentic AI solutions.

Desirable Requirement

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM, Terraform or equivalent tooling. Experience with containers, Kubernetes, event-driven architectures, queues or durable workflow patterns
  • Experience building agentic applications with LangChain and LangGraph . Experience with Amazon Bedrock and its model, agent, knowledge-base or guardrail capabilities.

descriptionHtml:
About the Team

DoorDash is one of the world's most trusted on-demand logistics platforms. The Global Safety and Security team exists to keep it that way, protecting our people, property, operations, brand, and reputation across all our markets. We manage risk and create value through agility, technology, and a people-first approach. Our DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt brands now span more than 40 countries, dozens of offices, and tens of thousands of employees. We strive to stay ahead of emerging threats and be there for our people anytime, anywhere.

About the Role

We are hiring an Analyst, Global Safety and Security Operations to support DoorDash's 24/7 physical security operations center. The Regional Security Operations Center monitors physical security threats and coordinates responses to incidents affecting our people, facilities, and operations around the world. This is an in-person position based in Hyderabad, India. This is not a cybersecurity role.

Reporting to the Manager, Regional Security Operations Center (RSOC), you will monitor threats, triage incidents, and coordinate real-time responses to protect DoorDash's people, assets, and operations. As a frontline operator, you will assess risks, follow standard operating procedures, and escalate issues quickly and accurately. You will also validate information, distinguish signal from noise, and provide clear context to support timely escalation and informed decision-making.

You are excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Operate the RSOC in Real Time: Monitor dashboards, alerts, inbound reports, and open-source signals to identify security, safety, and operational incidents as they emerge.
  • Execute Incident Response with Precision: Triage incidents, follow established SOPs, and support incident command activities through accurate documentation, coordination, and information validation.
  • Maintain Situational Awareness: Track ongoing incidents, relevant global events, and operational conditions to maintain a clear, real-time understanding of risk across shifts and regions.
  • Apply Foundational Analytical Intelligence Tradecraft: Conduct initial fact-finding and source validation to distinguish signal from noise and support effective escalation in accordance with established Risk Intelligence guardrails
  • Support Escalation and Decision-Making: Identify when issues exceed thresholds and escalate to the RSOC Manager with clear, structured, and decision-ready information, without owning strategic risk interpretation.
  • Ensure Seamless Shift Handover: Produce concise shift reports and conduct disciplined handovers that capture incident status, risk context, and outstanding actions.
  • Contribute to Operational Excellence: Participate in drills, retrospectives, and continuous improvement efforts to strengthen RSOC readiness, workflows, and analytical rigor.
  • Operate Calmly Under Pressure: Demonstrate professionalism, composure, and sound judgment during fast-moving or high-impact incidents.

We are excited about you because you bring…

  • Experience and education: Three or more years in a GSOC, RSOC, SOC, or comparable 24/7 operations or incident response environment; bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience.
  • Incident response and judgment: Ability to triage incidents, assess risk, follow playbooks, and escalate decisively under pressure.
  • Analytical and technical skills: Ability to validate information, identify trends, and use monitoring, ticketing, communication, and basic analytics tools. Basic OSINT familiarity preferred; training provided as needed.
  • Communication and reliability: Clear incident documentation, effective communication with leaders and partners, attention to detail, and consistent adherence to procedures.
  • Adaptability and availability: Willingness to learn and work rotating or extended shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support 24/7 global operations.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Center of Excellence)
description: Job Description SummaryWe are looking for a senior OT cybersecurity engineer to join the Grid Automation Cybersecurity Centre of Excellence (COE), a new central team that owns how cybersecurity is executed on GA projects worldwide.The role is hands-on. You will design, build, configure, test and optionally commission security solutions on complex utility and industrial projects. You will then turn that work into the standards, templates and training that regional teams use on every project that follows.You will be the recognized technical owner for a set of solutions in the GA cybersecurity portfolio, covering areas such as firewalls, OT network monitoring, secure remote access, identity, PKI, SIEM, etc... Regional teams will come to you when a project goes beyond their depth.You will also make execution faster and more consistent. That means automating repeatable build and verification work in PowerShell, and using frontier AI models to shorten documentation, requirements mapping and configuration review, while engineering judgement and the protection of customer data stay firmly with you.Job DescriptionAbout the Cybersecurity COEThe COE Gives GA a Single Owner For Cybersecurity Execution Standards And Process Across All Regions. Customer configurations, network drawings and logs from critical infrastructure stay inside approved boundaries, and an engineer verifies every AI output before it reaches a customer or a live system.Turn proven scripts, prompts and AI-assisted workflows into toolkit assets, so regional engineers get the same gains on Tier 2 and Tier 3 projects.Competency buildingDesign and deliver structured technical training for regional engineers, from foundation to advanced level, on the solutions you own.Coach regional engineers on live projects, so that project types can move from Tier 1 to Tier 2, and from Tier 2 to Tier 3.Maintain independent working capability (Backup) in competencies owned by COE colleagues, so the team keeps delivering when one person is unavailable.Specialist support and regulatory intelligenceProvide on-demand support to regional teams on design questions, site troubleshooting and escalations.Support patch management, vulnerability assessment and incident response engagements on GA-delivered systems, working with Product Security.Track IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62351 and regional mandates, and translate new requirements into execution checklists and deliverables.Help regional teams answer customer compliance questions that arise during project execution.Product and partner feedbackFeed field experience back to Product Management and R&D: integration issues, recurring defects and gaps in the portfolio.Support validation and first deployments of new GA cybersecurity solutions as they come through NPI.Work with technology partners on integration, technical escalations and joint validation.Required QualificationsBachelor's or master's degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.8+ years in industrial automation or the energy sector, including at least 5 years delivering OT cybersecurity hands-on on customer projects, from design through commissioning.Applied knowledge of IEC 62443 on real projects, in particular 3-2 (risk assessment, zones and conduits), 3-3 (system security requirements and security levels) and 2-4 (service provider descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a senior OT cybersecurity engineer to join the Grid Automation Cybersecurity Centre of Excellence (COE), a new central team that owns how cybersecurity is executed on GA projects worldwide.

The role is hands-on. You will design, build, configure, test and optionally commission security solutions on complex utility and industrial projects. You will then turn that work into the standards, templates and training that regional teams use on every project that follows.

You will be the recognized technical owner for a set of solutions in the GA cybersecurity portfolio, covering areas such as firewalls, OT network monitoring, secure remote access, identity, PKI, SIEM, etc... Regional teams will come to you when a project goes beyond their depth.

You will also make execution faster and more consistent. That means automating repeatable build and verification work in PowerShell, and using frontier AI models to shorten documentation, requirements mapping and configuration review, while engineering judgement and the protection of customer data stay firmly with you.

Job Description

About the Cybersecurity COE

The COE Gives GA a Single Owner For Cybersecurity Execution Standards And Process Across All Regions. It Reports Into The GA OT Cybersecurity Product Line And Covers Five Functions

  • Delivery of complex project scope, and specialist support to regions on demand.
  • A standard execution toolkit: security plans, reference architectures, checklists, templates and automation scripts that regions can apply directly.
  • A structured competency programme of periodic technical and non-technical training.
  • Formal cybersecurity reviews at key project milestones.
  • Regulatory intelligence on IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA and regional mandates, so execution teams are ready for compliance before customers ask.

Roles And Responsibilities

Project execution

  • Lead the cybersecurity workstream on Tier 1 projects end to end: requirements review, security architecture, detailed design, build, configuration, FAT, SAT, commissioning and handover.
  • Work hands-on in staging and at customer sites: build and harden Windows and Linux servers, and configure firewalls, Active Directory, PKI, KDC, network intrusion detection, SIEM and syslog, application control, backup and recovery, and secure remote access.
  • Produce the project security deliverables: security plan, zone and conduit model, risk assessment, hardening records, test procedures and reports, and the security handover package.
  • Map customer requirements to contract scope early, flag deviations as they arise, and give project managers the technical basis for change orders.
  • Support tender and project teams with scope definition and effort estimates for complex cybersecurity scope.

Execution standards and toolkit

  • Act as the technical owner (Expert) for an assigned set of COE competencies. Set the reference configuration for each and keep it current with product and partner releases.
  • Build the GA execution toolkit as a by-product of delivery: reference architectures, configuration baselines, build checklists, PowerShell scripts, how-to guides, test procedures and templates.
  • Run formal design and configuration reviews at project milestones, so misconfigurations are found before FAT and handover rather than by the customer.
  • Capture lessons learned at project close and feed them back into the toolkit.

Automation and AI-assisted execution

  • Write and maintain PowerShell scripts and modules that automate repeatable execution tasks: Windows Server and workstation hardening, Active Directory and Group Policy build, account and group provisioning, certificate enrolment, audit policy and log forwarding setup, and backup job configuration.
  • Build automated checks that compare as-built systems against the COE reference baselines and produce the evidence for milestone reviews, FAT and SAT, so verification no longer depends on manual screenshots and spot checks.
  • Use frontier AI models to speed up execution work: drafting and reviewing security plans, test procedures and as-built documents; mapping customer specifications against IEC 62443-3-3 requirements; analysing firewall rule bases, configuration exports and logs; and writing and reviewing scripts.
  • Use AI only within GE Vernova approved platforms and data-handling rules. Customer configurations, network drawings and logs from critical infrastructure stay inside approved boundaries, and an engineer verifies every AI output before it reaches a customer or a live system.
  • Turn proven scripts, prompts and AI-assisted workflows into toolkit assets, so regional engineers get the same gains on Tier 2 and Tier 3 projects.

Competency building

  • Design and deliver structured technical training for regional engineers, from foundation to advanced level, on the solutions you own.
  • Coach regional engineers on live projects, so that project types can move from Tier 1 to Tier 2, and from Tier 2 to Tier 3.
  • Maintain independent working capability (Backup) in competencies owned by COE colleagues, so the team keeps delivering when one person is unavailable.

Specialist support and regulatory intelligence

  • Provide on-demand support to regional teams on design questions, site troubleshooting and escalations.
  • Support patch management, vulnerability assessment and incident response engagements on GA-delivered systems, working with Product Security.
  • Track IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62351 and regional mandates, and translate new requirements into execution checklists and deliverables.
  • Help regional teams answer customer compliance questions that arise during project execution.

Product and partner feedback

  • Feed field experience back to Product Management and R&D: integration issues, recurring defects and gaps in the portfolio.
  • Support validation and first deployments of new GA cybersecurity solutions as they come through NPI.
  • Work with technology partners on integration, technical escalations and joint validation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.
  • 8+ years in industrial automation or the energy sector, including at least 5 years delivering OT cybersecurity hands-on on customer projects, from design through commissioning.
  • Applied knowledge of IEC 62443 on real projects, in particular 3-2 (risk assessment, zones and conduits), 3-3 (system security requirements and security levels) and 2-4 (service provider requirements).
  • Working knowledge of NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62351 and NIST guidance, and how each translates into project deliverables.
  • Expert-level, hands-on depth in at least three of the following areas, and working capability in most of the rest:
    • Next-generation firewalls (Fortinet preferred)
    • OT network intrusion detection and monitoring (Nozomi, Dragos or similar)
    • Secure remote access for industrial systems (Xona or similar)
    • Active Directory, Group Policy, RADIUS and LDAP
    • Public key infrastructure and certificate lifecycle management
    • SIEM and syslog collection (Splunk or similar)
    • Centralised security management platforms
    • Application control and host intrusion prevention (Trellix or similar)
    • Backup and disaster recovery
    • Windows and Linux server build, hardening and virtualisation
    • Hardening of IEDs, RTUs, gateways and other field devices
  • Sound understanding of substation and grid automation (protection and control, RTUs, gateways, SCADA and EMS) and the protocols that run them: IEC 61850, DNP3, IEC 60870-5-104 and Modbus.
  • Working proficiency in PowerShell for Windows Server and Active Directory administration: the ActiveDirectory and GroupPolicy modules, remoting, error handling and logging, and running signed scripts under the restricted execution policies typical of OT environments.
  • Practical, regular use of frontier AI models (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Microsoft Copilot) in engineering work, with the judgement to check outputs, catch errors and keep sensitive customer data out of unapproved tools.
  • A track record of producing project security documentation that customers and auditors accept.
  • Experience training and mentoring engineers.
  • Willingness to travel 20–40%, including extended site stays, and to join calls across time zones.
Desired Characteristics

  • Certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert (or its specialist certificates), CISSP, Fortinet FCP or FCSS (formerly NSE 4 and NSE 7), Splunk Core Certified, or vendor training on Nozomi or Dragos.
  • Experience as the cybersecurity lead on large utility, data centre or industrial projects with multiple vendors and a demanding customer.
  • Experience building AI-assisted engineering workflows, such as structured prompt libraries, agent-based tools or API integrations, for document generation, requirements mapping or log triage.
  • Configuration-as-code and scripting discipline: PowerShell DSC or Ansible, Pester tests for scripts, Git version control, and Bash or Python for Linux systems.
  • Writes clear, precise documentation. A checklist or procedure written by this person can be followed by an engineer who has never met them.
  • Teaches well. Can explain a design decision to a junior engineer and defend it to a customer's security team.
  • Holds scope boundaries with customers firmly and professionally, and understands that scope discipline protects both schedule and margin.
  • Works comfortably in a global organisation with people from many cultures and backgrounds. Additional languages are an advantage.
  • Takes ownership. Treats a problem found on one project as a gap in the toolkit, and fixes the toolkit.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Candidates should be aware that this role involves a client's critical infrastructure; shortlisted candidates would therefore be subject to heightened security checks as directed by our clients. All personal data will be handled with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with our data protection policies, solely for recruitment and security purposes.

descriptionHtml:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell is seeking an Infrastructure Security Engineer to drive cyber security best practices across the systems, appliances, and platforms that run Marvell's data center and cloud (IaaS/PaaS) environments, along with email security. This role partners closely with Cyber and IT Engineering/Operations teams across each area of the data center, cloud, compute, storage, network, and virtualization to identify risk and drive adoption of stronger technical controls

What You Can Expect

  • Partner with Cyber and IT Engineering/Operations teams spanning compute, storage, network, and virtualization in the data center and cloud environment, as well as the M365/Exchange Online team, to drive cyber security best practices.
  • Maintain working knowledge of the tools and systems used to manage and protect data center and cloud infrastructure (hardening standards, patch and vulnerability management, privileged access, configuration management, cloud security posture tooling) and administer/tune the Proofpoint email security platform.
  • Design and recommend email security architecture and technical controls that reduce phishing, business email compromise, and account takeover risk.
  • Identify and help drive remediation on gaps in baseline security controls across data center, cloud, and email environments, working with system owners to prioritize based on risk.
  • Act as a technical liaison between Security/SecOps and IT Infrastructure, Operations, and Exchange teams, translating security requirements into practical, operationally feasible controls.
  • Work with the SOC as needed to support investigation and response for infrastructure- and email-related security incidents, providing technical context on affected systems.
  • Contribute to metrics and reporting on infrastructure and email security posture, control effectiveness, and residual risk.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience administering and managing servers running Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems with focus on cyber security hardening and best practices
  • Working knowledge of virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V).
  • Solid understanding of core network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP) and data center appliances (firewalls, load balancers such as F5, switches/routers)
  • Experience with cloud IaaS/PaaS environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) compute, storage, networking, and identity/access management services.
  • Working knowledge of configuration and patch management tooling (e.g., SCCM, Ansible, Puppet, Chef) and vulnerability management/scanning platforms (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7).
  • Practical experience with enterprise storage and appliances (e.g., NetApp, Dell EMC, Pure Storage) and how they're typically secured and managed.
  • Hands-on experience administering Proofpoint (or a comparable secure email gateway platform such as Mimecast, Abnormal Security, or Microsoft Defender for Office 365) in an enterprise environment is a big plus
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365, with deep focus on Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, connectors, authentication protocols).
  • Solid working familiarity of core email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
  • Practical understanding of identity infrastructure (Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID) and privileged access management (PAM) concepts.
  • Experience with asset discovery/inventory tooling and building compliance reporting or dashboards to track endpoint protection coverage across a large device fleet.
  • Broad cybersecurity fundamentals across a modern enterprise: identity, endpoint, network, and cloud security concepts.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with IT Engineering, IT Operations, SecOps, SOC, and Security Engineering teams.
  • Ability to translate security requirements into practical guidance for operational teams and communicate risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience with backup/disaster recovery platforms (e.g., Veeam, Commvault) and container/Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience with cloud security posture management (CSPM) tooling and SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, XSIAM).
  • Experience in a high-growth or high-visibility organization with an elevated threat profile.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GIAC/GSEC, Proofpoint certifications, cloud security certifications, Azure, AWS and GCP certifications).

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

Role purpose: SOC operations across Tanla Group Companies [Tanla Platforms, Karix and ValueFirst] with accountability for EDR and SIEM operations, incident response, detection of quality and management reporting.

Expected outcomes

Documented SOC ownership and escalation paths; validated EDR and SIEM coverage baseline; measurable improvement in investigation quality and alert relevance; timely reporting and closure of agreed incident and coverage actions.

What you’ll be responsible for?

  • Own SOC procedures, incident severity definitions, escalation paths, response playbooks and operational service levels across the Group.
  • Lead investigation and coordination of security incidents, including endpoint compromise, ransomware, identity attacks and suspicious network activity; preserve evidence and drive post-incident improvements.
  • Oversee EDR and SIEM coverage, log onboarding, ingestion health, alert handling and detection effectiveness. Prioritize gaps using asset criticality and business risk.
  • Guide the Security Engineer in detection development, threat hunting, correlation tuning and reduction of duplicate or low-value alerts.
  • Manage and review any outsourced SOC or MDR service, including investigation of quality, escalation timeliness, ownership and closure evidence.
  • Coordinate containment and recovery with IT, DevOps, network and entity Security Operations teams under approved response authority and change processes.
  • Provide CISO reporting on incidents, detection and response times, coverage gaps, overdue actions, and material risks. Support audit evidence and corrective actions.
  • Coach team members, maintain operational readiness, and establish handovers and on-call escalation arrangements.

What you’d have ?

  • 10 -12 yrs years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including demonstrated SOC leadership and ownership of incident response.
  • Strong hands-on understanding of EDR, SIEM and security analytics; experience with Palo Alto Cortex XDR / XSIAM or comparable platforms (Crowd Strike).
  • Ability to assess endpoint, identity, email, firewall and cloud telemetry; working knowledge of Windows, Linux, macOS and common attack techniques.
  • Experience with detection engineering, threat hunting, MITRE ATT&CK mapping and SOC performance measurement.
  • Strong critical thinking, prioritization, stakeholder management, written reporting, and incident communication skills.
  • Education – BE / B.Tech / MCA - Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Certifications - CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCIA or relevant vendor certifications are desirable, not mandatory.


Why join us?

  • Impactful Work: Play a key role in strengthening HR operations and delivering a seamless employee experience across the organisation.
  • Tremendous Growth Opportunities: Be part of a rapidly growing company with opportunities to build and improve HR processes and practices.
  • Innovative Environment: Work alongside a collaborative team in a dynamic environment where ownership, accountability and innovation are valued.

Tanla is an equal opportunity employer. We champion diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
