descriptionHtml:
Business Unit:

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details:

Role Summary

The Tier-2 NOC Engineer takes escalations from Tier-1 and restores service across our customer contracts, which span on-premises, Microsoft Azure and AWS environments, each with its own SLA. You will troubleshoot across network, compute, operating system, database, application and cloud layers, engage vendors and internal teams, and keep customers informed during major incidents.

You will also make the NOC better over time: tuning noisy alerts, writing and automating runbooks, and raising problem records so recurring issues are fixed for good. You will work closely with the SOC, providing infrastructure data during security investigations.

Job Details:

Key Responsibilities

Diagnose and Restore

  • Take escalated tickets from Tier-1 and troubleshoot across network, compute, OS, database, application and cloud layers.
  • Restore service through fixes, failover, scaling, or rolling back a bad change, within contract SLAs.
  • Identify the likely root cause and record it, with resolution notes, in the ticket.


Change Management

  • Raise and implement emergency changes needed to restore service.
  • Roll back changes that cause incidents, and check whether a recent change caused an incident.
  • Execute critical out-of-band patches when requested by the SOC and validate service health after patching.


Coordination and Communication

  • Engage vendors (Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, ISPs and others) and internal infrastructure and application teams.
  • Send status updates to customers and stakeholders on each contract's schedule during P1/P2 incidents.
  • Collect and provide data (logs, configurations, flow data) to the SOC on request during security investigations.


Continuous Improvement

  • Raise problem records for recurring or unexplained issues.
  • Tune alerts: remove noisy ones, adjust thresholds, and action false-positive tuning requests from Tier-1.
  • Write and improve runbooks and automate common fixes so Tier-1 can resolve more issues at first contact.
  • Coach Tier-1 analysts on troubleshooting and runbook use.


Scope and Escalation Boundaries

Inputs this role works from

  • Escalated tickets from Tier-1 with triage evidence
  • Monitoring data across all tools, CMDB/service maps per contract, change records and vendor contacts
  • Requests from SOC Tier-2 for infrastructure data


Escalate to NOC Tier-3 / engineering when

  • The root cause is outside standard operations (code defect, architecture limit, product/IoT firmware, capacity design).
  • A fix needs a significant change or design decision.
  • The issue is not resolved within the P1/P2 time limit (e.g., 1 hour of active work on a P1).


Escalate to the Incident Commander (war room) when

  • There is a major incident: several contracts affected, a full customer outage, a likely SLA breach with penalties, or a possible security cause.


Required Skills

Technical Depth

  • Hands-on depth in at least two of the following, with working knowledge of the rest:
  • Network: TCP/IP, OSI model, routing and switching, firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP, load balancers, network connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Systems: Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux administration.
  • Databases: Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server (performance, blocking, storage, job failures).
  • Cloud: Microsoft Azure and AWS (compute, networking, identity, monitoring).
  • Applications: Java-based applications, web and application servers, application logs.
  • Working knowledge of the products and IoT devices for the contracts supported.
  • Log analysis across firewalls, routers, switches, servers and applications.


Monitoring and Observability Tools

  • SolarWinds: NPM, NetFlow analysis, node and interface health.
  • AppDynamics: transaction tracing and application performance analysis.
  • Oracle Enterprise Manager: database and middleware performance analysis.
  • Site24x7: synthetic monitoring and availability checks.
  • Azure Monitor and AWS CloudWatch: metrics, alarms and log queries.
  • PRTG Network Monitor and Nagios
  • Ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira or similar) and Microsoft 365.


Scripting standards this role follows:

  • All scripts kept in Git in an approved, peer-reviewed library.
  • Read-only by default: diagnostic scripts never change anything; scripts that make changes need a change or ticket reference.
  • No hard-coded credentials: credentials are pulled from a vault.
  • Parameterized by contract and CI, safe to run twice, and logging what they did into the ticket.


Process Skills

  • ITIL incident, problem and change management, including emergency changes and rollbacks.
  • Vendor escalation and management.
  • Shift handover and incident documentation.


Professional Skills

  • Structured, analytical troubleshooting under pressure.
  • Clear written and verbal technical updates for both technical and customer audiences.
  • Attention to detail, and the ability to manage several incidents at once.


Preferred Skills

  • Python for automation that spans several systems (e.g., one script that checks a service across Azure, AWS and on-premises).
  • Splunk SPL basics.
  • Network device CLI for reading switch, router and firewall state.
  • Experience in a multi-customer or managed services NOC with contract-specific SLAs.


Certifications (Preferred)

  • ITIL 4 Foundation
  • CCNA or CompTIA Network+
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
  • CompTIA Security+


‎

Worker Type:

Employee

‎

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 5 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Proven experience or strong foundational knowledge in broader cybersecurity principles and practices.
  • Familiarity with the development lifecycle and security considerations specific to browser extensions or similar technologies.
  • Working knowledge in one or more of the following areas: cyber security, threat intelligence, statistical analysis and machine learning libraries (e.g., R), programming languages (e.g., Python), Large Language Models (LLMs) or applied AI.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

Trust and Safety has the critical responsibility of protecting Google's users by ensuring online safety fighting fraud and abuse across Google products. We collaborate with anti-abuse teams across the company to identify and resolve the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. More specifically, in the Trust and Safety Chrome Web Store and Extensions Security team, we are responsible for protecting users from harmful extensions, while enabling developers to provide useful and safe experiences in Chrome.

As a Security and Applied AI Engineering Analyst, you will apply large-scale data analysis to protect Chrome users from abuse, discover and interpret attack vectors and leverage AI to build scaled protections to keep users safe. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Product partners to identify threats, mitigate risks, and launch new protection mechanisms.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct investigations through reverse engineering, enforce our product policies, learn abuse patterns, and establish ground truth data to train automated systems. Identify vulnerabilities and performance gaps in automated and manual review pipelines.
  • Design AI-powered and automated solutions that enable scalable identification of malware, and other harmful techniques.
  • Collaborate with other teams to develop and deploy new detection methods and signals.
  • Understand the abuse landscape and techniques.

Your role includes executing changes responsibly, flagging risks and mitigation plans, and ensuring all changes have proper approvals.

Collaborative efforts are at the heart of this role. You'll work closely with automation teams to optimize efforts and automate routine tasks, ensuring seamless handovers during shift changes. Your analytical skills will be key in auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and contributing to trend analysis reports to identify automation opportunities.

As a go-to for initial client escalations, you'll assist L1 Security Engineers with triage and troubleshooting, and support project work when required. Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:

  • Experience with managed services handling security infrastructure and working knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in active listening, with techniques like paraphrasing and probing for further information.
  • Excellent planning skills, able to anticipate and adjust to changing circumstances.

descriptionHtml:
Note

Years of Experience - 6 to 12 Years

Job Location - Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad

Notice Period - Immediate to 15 days only

Final Level discussion Face to Face Mandatory

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Application & Software Security (AppSec)

  • Implement, manage, and optimize Veracode platform capabilities, including SAST, DAST, and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Conduct authenticated security scans using Qualys TotalAppSec, analyze detailed vulnerability reports, prioritize risks, and collaborate directly with engineering teams to guide remediation.
  • Perform manual and automated application vulnerability analysis and penetration testing using tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus, OpenVAS, and Nmap.
  • Manage Edge and Layer 7 security using AWS WAF and Cloudflare WAF, defining and maintaining rate-limiting rules, bot management policies, and custom firewall configurations.

Cloud & Network Security Architecture

  • Design, configure, and manage secure AWS network architectures involving VPCs, Security Groups, Network ACLs, NAT Gateways, Bastion Hosts, and Site-to-Site VPNs.
  • Administer AWS security governance, monitoring, and compliance tooling, including Security Hub, GuardDuty, Macie, Config, Inspector, and CloudTrail.
  • Implement and audit identity and data protection standards using AWS IAM, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, and AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).
  • Configure network-level logging, analyze network traffic, and troubleshoot complex routing or security issues.
  • Perform dynamic packet analysis using Wireshark, tcpdump, and packet inspection tools to diagnose complex network/security anomalies.

Security Operations & Automation

  • Maintain operational visibility into Malware Protection, SIEM, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms (configuration, monitoring, and incident investigation).
  • Develop continuous automation scripts in Python to streamline repetitive security operations, automate report generation, and integrate security workflows.

Requirements

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud & Application Security Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team. In this role, you will play a critical part in protecting our cloud infrastructure, network architectures, and software applications. You will be responsible for end-to-end application security testing, threat detection, network-level troubleshooting, and cloud security governance across AWS and multi-cloud environments.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

  • Application Security: Hands-on experience with Veracode (SAST/DAST/SCA), Qualys TotalAppSec, Burp Suite, ZAP, Nessus, OpenVAS, and Nmap.
  • AWS Security Infrastructure: Deep understanding of AWS networking/security services (VPC, Site-to-Site VPN, GuardDuty, Macie, Config, SecurityHub, Inspector, IAM, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, Certificate Manager).
  • Network & Packet Troubleshooting: Expertise in network components (NAT, Bastion, Security Groups, ACLs, CloudTrail) and deep packet analysis via Wireshark / tcpdump.
  • WAF & Edge Security: Expertise with AWS WAF, Cloudflare WAF, Bot Management, and Rate Limiting.
  • SecOps & Endpoint Security: Operational knowledge of SIEM, EDR, and Malware Protection configuration and threat monitoring.
  • Automation: Proficiency in Python for security scripting, API integrations, and reporting.

Preferred Certifications

  • AWS Certified Security – Specialty (Highly Preferred)
  • CompTIA Security+
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • Equivalent certifications such as CISSP, OSCP, or GIAC (GSEC/GCIH) are a plus.

We offer

  • Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects
  • Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team
  • Competitive salary
  • Flexible schedule
  • Benefits package - medical insurance, sports
  • Corporate social events
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Well-equipped office

About Us

Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in data, analytics, cloud & DevOps, application modernization and customer experience. Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

The Identity Management Analyst is responsible for hands‑on delivery and operationalization of Identity Lifecycle & Access Management (IDM) of non‑human identities (NHI).The role will be responsible for managing NHI platforms, onboarding enterprise systems, operating discovery and governance workflows, maintaining dashboards and reporting, and driving visibility, governance, and remediation of non-human identities across the enterprise.

The individual will work closely with Cloud Engineering, SAAS platforms, DevOps, Security, Infrastructure, Application Development, IAM, Governance, and Platform teams to ensure comprehensive discovery, onboarding, lifecycle management, and access governance of NHI’s including service accounts, API keys, secrets, certificates, service principals, workload identities, and application credentials etc.

Responsibilities

Non‑Human Identity (NHI) Management

  • Manage the full lifecycle of non‑human identities, including, Service accounts, Application identities and APIs, bots, and system users
  • Integrate NHI data with downstream applications and IAM/IGA platforms to enable: Risk analysis, Reporting and Access reviews
  • Establish and maintain ownership, purpose, and usage metadata for all non‑human identities.
  • Identify and analyse high‑risk NHI accounts
  • Enable risk‑based reporting and dashboards for NHI, covering Privilege levels, Access scope, Last used / inactive accounts, Ownership gaps

Integrations & SaaS Connectivity

  • Implement integrations between IAM(NHI) platforms and SaaS applications
  • Work with API‑based integrations, File‑based or custom connectors where required
  • Troubleshoot failures, data mismatches, and reconciliation issues
  • Support onboarding of new applications & platforms into IAM standards

Reporting, Dashboards & Data Analysis

  • Build and maintain operational and compliance dashboards for NHI metrics.
  • Develop custom reports using SQL and IAM reporting frameworks
  • Analyse identity data to identify access risk, drift, and anomalies
  • Support audit and compliance evidence generation

Database & Technical Operations

  • Perform hands‑on SQL querying against IAM databases
  • Collaborate with platform teams on performance and data quality improvements

Architecture & Platform Support:

  • Work closely with IAM architects to:
    • Translate architecture designs into configurations
    • Validate feasibility during POC’s and pilots
  • Contribute to runbooks, and operational documentation

Qualifications

Core IAM Experience

  • Working with NHI, Secrets Management, PAM, or Machine Identity solutions.
  • Experience with discovery and governance platforms such as:
  • Veza, Astrix, Akeyless, HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, Thales CTM
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale security and identity programs
  • Strong understanding of Identity lifecycle concepts (JML), Roles, entitlements, access models, Human and non‑human identity & access governance, PAM
  • Knowledge of Service Accounts, Service Principals, API Tokens, OAuth Clients, Secrets, SSH Keys, Certificates, Encryption Keys, Workload Identities, Kubernetes Service Accounts, Cloud Managed Identities

Technical Skills:

  • Strong SQL and database experience (queries, joins, analysis)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Working Knowledge of IAM Roles, Managed Identities, Service Accounts, Key Management Services, Cloud-native security controls
  • Experience integrating with SAAS and Enterprise platforms like Entra ID, Sales force, ServiceNow, GitHub, OKTA etc.
  • Strong experience in API & Integration Skills like REST APIs, JSON, OAuth etc.
  • Directory services (LDAP / AD / cloud directories)

Reporting & Analytics:

  • Experience building dashboards and operational reports
  • Comfortable working with large datasets and identity relationships

Qualifications:

Core Engineering & Cloud Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud platform development, DevSecOps, or platform engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on programming experience with Python and experience developing enterprise-grade automation, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native applications.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of GitHub, source control management, branching strategies, code reviews, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Experience working with multi-cloud environments including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Strong understanding of non-human identities and machine credentials including:
  • Service Accounts, Service Principals, Managed Identities, API Keys, OAuth Clients, Tokens, Secrets, SSH Keys, Certificates, Encryption Keys, Workload Identities, Kubernetes Service Accounts
  • Experience integrating cloud-native secret management solutions such as:
  • Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, Google Secret Manager, HashiCorp Vault
  • Understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevSecOps practices, and cloud security fundamentals.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Python development skills with experience building automation frameworks, SDKs, APIs, and integration services.
  • Strong experience with REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JSON, and event-driven integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native services including IAM, networking, storage, compute, serverless, and container platforms.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, AKS, or GKE.
  • Experience managing cloud identities and machine credentials across multiple accounts, subscriptions, projects, and tenants.
  • Working knowledge of:
  • AWS IAM Roles, Azure Identities, Azure Service Principals, GCP Service Accounts, Cloud KMS and Secret Management services
  • Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Entra ID, Okta, Salesforce, and cloud-native services.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI APIs, or cloud AI services is a plus.

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an IT & Endpoint Administrator with 3-5 years of experience managing corporate IT infrastructure, endpoint security and network administration in organizations with 100+ employees.

The candidate should have hands-on experience in laptop and asset management, Microsoft Intune/JumpCloud, endpoint security (EDR), Windows/macOS administration, Microsoft 365, access management, and network administration (LAN/WAN, routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, DNS and DHCP).


Experience Required:

3-5 years managing corporate IT infrastructure for organizations with 100+ employees.


Key Responsibilities

  • Procure, configure, allocate and maintain employee laptops, and maintain a centralized asset register mapping laptops to employees.
  • Implement endpoint management through Microsoft Intune, JumpCloud or equivalent.
  • Ensure laptops have endpoint detection and response (EDR), encryption and security updates.
  • Manage employee onboarding, transfers and offboarding, and ensure access is revoked immediately when employees leave.
  • Manage company email, endpoint policies and device compliance.
  • Restrict unauthorized software installation and local administrator privileges.
  • Ensure only approved, compliant devices can access sensitive company systems.
  • Coordinate lost-device response and remote wiping.
  • Manage corporate network infrastructure, including LAN/WAN, routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs and wireless networks.
  • Monitor network performance, troubleshoot connectivity issues and manage network security, access controls and configurations.


Required Technical Skills (Must-Have)

  • OS Administration: Windows/macOS administration.
  • IT & Cloud Administration: Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, identity management.
  • Endpoint Security & Management: MDM (Intune/JumpCloud or equivalent), EDR, device encryption and security updates.
  • Networking: LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, routing and switching.
  • Network Security: Firewall management, VPN, Wi-Fi management and network access control.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Network monitoring, connectivity and infrastructure troubleshooting.


Preferred Candidate Profile: 

Candidates with hands-on experience managing corporate IT infrastructure, endpoint security and network administration in organizations with 100+ employees.

Overview

The Defender Experts (DEX) Research team is at the forefront of Microsoft’s threat protection strategy, combining world-class hunting expertise with AI-driven analytics to protect customers from advanced cyberattacks. Our mission is to move protection left—disrupting threats early, before damage occurs—by transforming raw signals into intelligence that powers detection, disruption, and customer trust. We’re looking for a passionate and curious Senior Threat Researcher to join this high-impact team. In this role, you will collaborate closely with researchers, analysts, and detection engineers to advance managed Sentinel expertise and drive research on emerging cloud threats that impact both Microsoft and third-party products. Leveraging a deep understanding of multi-cloud environments and diverse security architectures, you will develop strategies and models that enhance threat detection and response capabilities within Microsoft Sentinel. Your research will directly contribute to the development of real-time protections for enterprises worldwide, ensuring comprehensive coverage across cloud platforms and strengthening the security posture of organizations leveraging a heterogeneous mix of technologies. This is a unique opportunity to work at scale, tackle complex cloud security challenges, and shape the evolution of threat research within Microsoft Security.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

We are seeking a Threat Researcher with a deep passion for advancing cloud security and a proven track record in high-throughput, multi-tenant environments. The successful candidate will demonstrate expertise in designing and deploying advanced detection engineering solutions—including Sentinel playbooks, workbooks, analytical rules, and custom detections. In this pivotal role, you will drive advanced research on emerging threats, architect innovative detection and response solutions, and play a key role in enhancing Microsoft Security’s capabilities to anticipate, detect, and disrupt sophisticated attacks across complex, heterogeneous cloud ecosystems.

Responsibilities Include

Qualifications

Qualifications

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer with strong expertise in network security, routing, and enterprise network infrastructure.

· The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, and Cisco networking technologies.

· This role requires an independent contributor who can effectively manage tasks and ensure secure, reliable network operations.

Key Responsibilities

Network Security

  • Manage and maintain network security infrastructure including Palo Alto and Cisco ASA firewalls.
  • Implement and monitor security policies, firewall rules, NAT configurations, and VPNs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex security and connectivity issues.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and best practices.

Web Application Security

  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions for protecting applications against threats, including DDoS attacks and bot traffic.
  • Configure WAF rules, rate limiting, and security policies to enhance application security and optimize performance.

Network Infrastructure

  • Design, implement, and support Cisco-based LAN, WAN, and Meraki environments.
  • Manage switching, wireless, and WAN connectivity across enterprise networks.
  • Monitor network performance and ensure high availability and reliability.

Routing & Switching

  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot dynamic routing protocols including BGP and EIGRP.
  • Perform routing optimization and traffic engineering for improved performance.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience in network engineering.
  • 3+ years of experience managing network security using Palo Alto and Cisco ASA.
  • Strong experience with Cisco LAN, WAN, and Meraki environments (minimum 3 years).
  • Deep understanding of routing protocols such as BGP and EIGRP.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in networking and security domains.
  • Ability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or Palo Alto certifications.
  • Experience with network monitoring and logging tools.
  • Exposure to cloud networking is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Self-motivated and capable of working as an individual contributor.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Good communication and documentation abilities.

PLUS - Desired to have: Cloudflare WAF experience

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a Cyber Security Incident Analyst to independently own and manage cybersecurity incidents from initial detection through to resolution. You will monitor and manage incidents received through multiple intake queues, including SIEM, SOAR, Incident Portal, DLP and VFCZ VBU customer incident queues.

This role requires autonomy, sound judgement and the ability to progress complex investigations with minimal supervision. You will assess risk and business impact, perform detailed technical analysis, make informed escalation decisions and ensure incidents are managed consistently in line with Vodafone Cyber Security Incident Management standards.

A strong focus on analytical depth, timely risk-based escalation and accurate, audit-ready documentation is essential.

What You’ll Do

Independently own and manage cybersecurity incidents throughout the end-to-end incident lifecycle.

Perform advanced incident triage, validation and prioritisation with minimal supervision.

Assess incident severity, risk and potential impact on customers, services, data and operations.

Conduct detailed technical investigations by correlating alerts, logs and indicators of compromise (IoCs).

Identify and appropriately close false positives and low-risk events without unnecessary escalation.

Progress investigations and determine when escalation or specialist assistance is required.

Coordinate incident response activities across CSOC, Threat Intelligence, Forensics/CERT, IT and Network teams.

Maintain accurate, comprehensive and audit-ready documentation throughout each incident.

Actively manage incidents through to resolution in accordance with applicable SLAs and response standards.

Provide clear, concise and risk-focused incident updates to incident managers and relevant stakeholders.

Who You Are

You have proven experience in Cyber Security Operations, a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Incident Response or Cyber Defence.

You have hands-on experience leading cybersecurity incident triage and investigations in production environments.

You can independently take ownership of incidents from initial identification through to resolution.

You have excellent analytical capabilities and can assess complex alerts, logs and events to determine their actual impact.

You have a solid understanding of common cyber threats and attack techniques.

You understand the cybersecurity incident management lifecycle, including escalation and problem handover.

You have experience coordinating effectively across multiple technical and non-technical teams during incidents.

You communicate clearly with stakeholders and maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation.

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

What's In It For You

Take end-to-end ownership of cybersecurity incidents and contribute directly to protecting customers, services, data and operations.

Work collaboratively with specialist teams including CSOC, Threat Intelligence, Forensics/CERT, IT and Network teams.

Gain exposure to complex cybersecurity incidents across multiple intake channels and production environments.

Develop experience in risk-based decision-making, stakeholder communication and incident coordination.

What Skills You Will Learn

Advanced cybersecurity incident triage, investigation and prioritisation.

Alert, log and IoC correlation across security environments.

Risk and business-impact assessment.

Incident escalation and cross-functional response coordination.

Audit-ready cybersecurity incident documentation.

Stakeholder communication during complex and high-priority incidents.

End-to-end incident lifecycle and SLA management.

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Job Description : -

As a Senior Information Security Analyst the Threat Management organization at Omnissa is looking for a Senior Information Security Analyst who is passionate about redefining, reimagining, and contributing towards building a robust and resilient information security posture. Information security is about harnessing the power of security expertise built on a solid foundation of threat analysis, risk management, compliance, and incident response.

This role requires flexibility in work hours, including participation in an on-call rotation to ensure 24/7 coverage. Additionally, working outside regular business hours may be necessary to respond to emerging threats or incidents.

At Omnissa, we are committed to helping our people grow professionally. Our talented employees exemplify our shared values and continue to drive our company to new heights.

Job Role and Responsibility

  • As a Senior Information Security Analyst, you will be a subject matter expert in monitoring, analyzing, and responding to security event data from various sources, including logs, network traffic, and threat intelligence feeds.
  • Manage the incident response process from initial detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities. Develop and maintain incident reports and provide insights to stakeholders on incident causes, impacts, and lessons learned.
  • Administer and optimize security tools, such as SIEM systems, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and threat intelligence platforms. Collaborate with other teams to ensure the effective integration of these tools into the overall security architecture
  • Make use of AI tools to accelerate alert detection and triage as well as log and data analysis to drive the maturity of the SOC and meet evolving threats.
  • Share knowledge and expertise with junior analysts and other stakeholders through training sessions, documentation, and informal guidance. Participate in the development of security procedures, playbooks, and other documentation to support the SOC team's mission.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve the effectiveness of security processes and tools, identifying opportunities for automation and streamlining workflows to enhance efficiency and reduce risk.

Required Skills

  • You should have a minimum of 6 to 12 years of work experience in Security Monitoring and Incident Response.
  • Experience with SIEM systems, including configuration, tuning, optimization, and threat detection creation.
  • Understanding of cloud security principles, including AWS and Azure security best practices and Microsoft Defender for Azure.
  • At least a basic understanding of core AI security principles, methodologies, and risks to an organization from the defender perspective.
  • Strong familiarity with endpoint detection and response tools, such as Crowdstrike Falcon.
  • Experience with DLP solutions to identify and prevent sensitive data exfiltration.
  • Knowledge of IAM principles and Microsoft Identity solutions to ensure secure authentication and authorization.
  • Ability to manage the incident response process from initial detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident activities.
  • Experience with SOAR tools to streamline security workflows and automate tasks. (Swimlane Turbine experience is preferred)
  • Any experience with using AI tools and platforms to perform tasks and accelerate and automate workflows.
  • Ability to analyze complex data sets and identify potential security threats.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders and provide insightful analysis.
  • Commitment to ongoing learning and professional development in the field of cybersecurity.
  • Knowledge of relevant compliance frameworks, such as HIPAA, SOC2, ISO, or PCI-DSS, to ensure security controls are aligned with regulatory requirements.
  • Capacity to work effectively in a dynamic environment with multiple priorities and deadlines.

Job Description: *The Professional, Core Cyber Operations job operates organization wide cyber threat intelligence collection and dissemination. With limited supervision, this job operates cyber threat intelligence, conducts moderately complex forensic investigations, and provides effective and efficient incident response, thereby improving the overall security posture of the organization.

SOC Analyst, Core Cyber Operations

Job Summary

The SOC Analyst is responsible for monitoring, detecting, investigating, and responding to cybersecurity threats across the enterprise environment. This role supports 24x7 global security operations by analyzing security events, validating threats, conducting investigations and collaborating with security engineering, threat intelligence and cyber defense teams to mitigate risks.

The ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) functions, security monitoring, incident response, threat detection, and cybersecurity investigations. The candidate should have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, knowledge of attacker techniques and experience working with SIEM, EDR, cloud security and network security technologies.

Under Limited Supervision, This Role Performs The Following Functions

  • SECURITY MONITORING: Continuously monitor security alerts and events using SIEM, EDR tools to identify potential threats. Analyze logs and network traffic to detect anomalies and suspicious activities.
  • INCIDENT RESPONSE: Assist in the initial triage and investigation of security incidents. Follow established protocols to escalate incidents to senior analysts and document findings.
  • LOG ANALYSIS: Perform detailed analysis of logs from various sources (e.g., EDR, firewalls, IDS/IPS, servers) to identify and investigate security incidents.
  • THREAT INTELLIGENCE: Utilize threat intelligence feeds to stay informed about emerging threats. Apply this knowledge to enhance detection capabilities and improve response strategies.
  • DOCUMENTATION: Document security incidents thoroughly, including steps taken and outcomes. Create and maintain process documentation to ensure consistent and efficient security operations.

Minimum Work Experience

  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC)
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, threat detection methodologies, incident response and attack lifecycle concepts.

SHIFT OPERATIONS

  • Work in a monthly rotational shift schedule to support global SOC operations:

Morning Shift: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM IST

Evening Shift: 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST

Job Title: Cyber Defence Analyst

Location: Bangalore-Manyata Tech Park

Business & Team: The Cyber Attack Analysis Team (CAAT) enables the Group to respond to cyber security events that impact core business platforms, systems, data, assets, and reputation. The team serves as the Tier 1 function and is responsible for detecting, triaging and analysing cyber security events of interest.

Impact &contribution: As a Cyber Security Analyst, you will monitor the Group’s computer systems for suspicious activity using enterprise-grade cyber tools and critical thought. You will triage and manage various incidents, events, and queries from the business to the relevant resolver group. Your role will also involve contributing to the Continual Service Improvement (CSI) of the team’s operations through proactive analysis, engagement, and collaboration with your team.

Roles & responsibilities:

  • Monitor the Group’s computer systems for suspicious activity using enterprise-grade cyber tools and critical thought.
  • Triage and analyse detection alerts and staff-reported cyber attacks to identify which events require response activities based on Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Capture essential details and artefacts for cyber security events.
  • Maintain event response documentation, participate in post-mortems, and write event reports.
  • Escalate applicable incidents to other accountable functions within the Group (such as Cyber Attack Response, Data Breach, Governance, etc).
  • Identify potential new detection logic and escalate to the Detection Engineering team.
  • Contribute to the Continual Service Improvement (CSI) of the team’s operations through proactive analysis, engagement, and collaboration with your team.
  • 24/7 shift and completely work from Office

Essential skills:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Cyber Security Analyst or in a similar role.
  • Technical Skills: Knowledge of operating systems, network protocols, and cyber security tools.
  • Analytical Skills: Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • A proficiency in Splunk or other SIEM tools
  • A proficiency in Microsoft Defender for Endpoints (MDE) or other Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools
  • A good understanding of networking principles
  • Experience in incident management, with a strong emphasis on comprehensive documentation, integrity, and accountability.
  • Experience with cloud security and knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • The capability to learn fast, and a knack to analyse computer system activity to understand and assess cyber threats.
  • An ability to document and explain technical details clearly and concisely for different audiences.
  • Attention to Detail: High level of attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to work meticulously under pressure.
  • Relevant certifications such as GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), or GIAC Reverse Engineering Malware (GREM) are a plus.

Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer Science/Information Technology.

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

Our platform enables organizations to move from alert-driven monitoring to automated, policy-driven security operations—leveraging SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and CNAPP capabilities.


About the Role

This is opening on our Information Security team, and the level you're brought in at depends on your experience:

  • 0 – 2 years of relevant experience (including freshers with strong fundamentals)


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security alerts, logs, and dashboards (SIEM/SOC tooling) to identify and triage potential threats or anomalies.
  • Support vulnerability assessment and management — scanning, tracking, and following up on remediation with engineering teams.
  • Assist in security incident response: initial investigation, evidence collection, and documentation.
  • Help maintain and review security policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and playbooks.
  • Support internal and customer-facing security audits and compliance efforts (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
  • Assist with cloud security posture reviews across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, aligned with CSPM/KSPM/DSPM best practices.
  • Track and report on security metrics, open findings, and audit action items.
  • Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry security trends.


Additional Responsibilities

  • Own configuration, tuning, and health of SIEM/SOC tooling, alert rules, and detection use cases.
  • Lead incident response for moderate-severity incidents, including root cause analysis and remediation planning.
  • Design and implement security controls across cloud infrastructure, applications, and endpoints.
  • Partner with engineering teams on shift-left security — secure coding practices, IaC scanning, and secrets management.
  • Automate repetitive security tasks and reporting using scripting (e.g., Python, Bash).
  • Mentor and review the work of Information Security Analysts.


What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • Solid understanding of core security concepts: networking fundamentals, OS security, encryption, authentication/authorization, and common attack techniques.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, or ISO 27001.
  • Basic exposure to SOC/SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, or the ELK stack) is a plus — hands-on SOC experience is not mandatory.
  • Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, and clear written communication for documenting findings and reports.
  • Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced, cloud-native security product environment.


Nice to Have

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud security concepts.
  • Familiarity with containers/Kubernetes security.
  • Scripting/automation experience (Python, Bash, or similar).
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, or CySA+ (or actively pursuing one).


Why Join Banyan Cloud

  • Work on a fast-growing, AI-powered cybersecurity platform used by enterprise customers across multiple industries.
  • Hands-on exposure to modern cloud security domains — CSPM, DSPM, KSPM, CIEM — alongside core SOC and infosec fundamentals.
  • Direct mentorship and a clear growth path from Analyst to Engineer and beyond.
  • Collaborative, security-first culture in a company built entirely around protecting cloud environments.

descriptionHtml:
Role Purpose: The SOC Incident Analyst will monitor security events, investigate alerts and respond to cyber security incidents affecting the organization. The role is accountable for identifying threats, conducting analysis and supporting remediation activities to reduce cyber risk. The role will contribute to maintaining a robust security monitoring capability and improving the organization’s cyber defense posture.


Role Accountability:

Alert Monitoring, Triage & Investigation

  1. Monitor security alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, email security, web security, identity, cloud and other monitoring platforms.
  2. Perform initial triage of alerts to determine severity, validity, affected assets, user context and potential business impact.
  3. Investigate incidents by correlating logs, telemetry, threat intelligence and security events to determine scope, root cause and impact.
  4. Identify indicators of compromise, suspicious behaviors, policy violations and potential attack patterns during investigations.


Incident Response & Escalation Support

  1. Escalate high-severity incidents to SOC leads or incident response teams with clear evidence, impact assessment and containment recommendations.
  2. Execute approved response playbooks under supervision, including IOC blocking, account disablement, endpoint isolation and access reset actions.
  3. Coordinate with IT, infrastructure, application and identity teams for remediation actions such as patching, configuration changes and access corrections.
  4. Maintain shift handover notes and investigation continuity to ensure open cases are tracked and acted upon without delay.


Documentation, Tuning & Continuous Improvement

  1. Document incidents with timelines, evidence, affected systems, actions taken, escalation details and closure notes for audit and post-incident reviews.
  2. Support alert tuning by providing feedback on false positives, missed detections, recurring alerts and monitoring gaps.
  3. Participate in tabletop exercises, purple-team drills and SOC process improvement activities to strengthen response readiness.
  4. Maintain awareness of emerging threats, attack techniques and SOC procedures to improve triage quality and investigation effectiveness.


Measures of Success

  1. Security alerts are triaged accurately within defined timelines.
  2. Incidents are investigated with clear evidence, impact assessment and escalation notes.
  3. High-severity cases are escalated promptly with actionable containment recommendations.
  4. Approved response playbooks are followed consistently during containment and remediation.
  5. Incident records include complete timelines, artefacts, actions and closure details.
  6. Shift handovers maintain continuity of open investigations.
  7. Feedback from investigations helps reduce false positives and improve detection quality.


Technical Skills

  1. Incident Response, Investigation & Crisis Handling
  2. AI Security Testing, Threat Monitoring & Abuse Detection
  3. Detection Engineering, Telemetry, SIEM/XDR Data & Use-Case Lifecycle Management
  4. SOC Monitoring & Alert Triage & Incident Operations
  5. Security Platform Operations, DLP & Automation
  6. Threat, Vulnerability & Exposure Management


Exposure to below mentioned Technologies / Frameworks / Methodologies

  1. Microsoft Sentinel
  2. Splunk
  3. QRadar
  4. Defender XDR
  5. CrowdStrike Falcon
  6. Email security consoles
  7. Web security consoles
  8. ServiceNow SecOps
  9. KQL / SPL
  10. IOC analysis
  11. Incident playbooks
  12. Log correlation
  13. Case documentation methods
  14. CASB


Qualification: Bachelor’s degree / B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc. / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Systems or related discipline.


Preferred Industry: BFSI, payments, banking, fintech, large enterprises with SIEM / EDR monitoring, alert triage, incident handling and security operations exposure.

This team provides 24/7 support. This role requires shift flexibility, including the ability to rotate between days, mids, and nights.

The Principal Analyst will provide deep-level analysis for client investigations utilizing customer-provided data sources, audit, and monitoring tools at both the government and enterprise levels. The Principal Analyst will work closely with our Technology Engineers, Architects, and Threat Analysts to service customers.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Operate independently in a geographically dispersed team, while maintaining situational awareness and keeping the team up to date
  • Perform security monitoring and incident response activities across the networks, leveraging a variety of tools and techniques
  • Detect incidents through proactive “hunting” across security-relevant data sets
  • Thoroughly document incident response analysis activities
  • Review investigations conducted by more junior analysts to ensure quality standards are met
  • Develop new, repeatable methods for finding malicious activity across the networks
  • Provide recommendations to enhance detection and protection capabilities
  • Regularly present technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Develop and follow detailed operational processes and procedures to appropriately analyze, escalate, and assist in the remediation of information security incidents
  • Prioritize multiple high-priority tasks and formulate responses/recommendations to customers and team members in a fast-paced environment
  • Provide assistance to other security teams
  • Continually develop new technical skills and push overall team capabilities forward
  • Engage with and mentor other team members
  • Work with other teams on major engineering and architecture initiatives
  • Be innovative with their understanding of attack methodologies, malware analysis, malicious toolkits, and how those may manifest within various security technologies
  • Advanced proactive threat hunting
  • Understands advanced adversary emulation concepts
  • Advanced use case design for insider threat, operational, threat detection and response
  • Review of defensive and detective controls to reduce client attack surface

What We’re Looking For

  • 9+ years of hands-on cybersecurity operations experience across complex security investigations, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, and security control assessment in enterprise environments.
  • Experience in Cortex XSOAR, Proofpoint, Egress, MS Azure, MS Defender, Azure ADX, Crowdstrike.
  • Advanced understanding of the cyber threat landscape and adversary TTPs, with extensive experience applying MITRE ATT&CK to investigations, threat hunting, detection engineering, adversary behavior analysis, and detection coverage assessment.
  • Lead complex, multi-source investigations using endpoint, network, identity, cloud, SaaS, memory, disk, and log evidence; preserve evidence, reconstruct attacker timelines, determine root cause and scope, and produce technically defensible findings.
  • Investigate identity- and cloud-centric attacks involving privileged accounts, federation, OAuth applications, tokens, service identities, control-plane/API activity, cloud workloads, SaaS audit records, and cross-account or cross-tenant access.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SIEM, EDR/XDR, UEBA, and security data platforms, including developing and optimizing complex queries and correlating telemetry across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, and network environments.
  • Use Python, PowerShell, or comparable scripting languages, REST APIs, and orchestration/SOAR platforms to automate enrichment, evidence collection, threat hunting, detection deployment, and repeatable response activities.
  • Own the detection lifecycle end-to-end, including requirements, data validation, use-case and rule development, peer review, testing, deployment, performance monitoring, tuning, documentation, and retirement, with analysis of both false positives and false negatives.
  • Design and execute hypothesis-driven and exploratory threat hunts based on adversary behavior, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK coverage gaps, and incident learnings, converting validated findings into detections, analytics, or response content.
  • Assess telemetry quality and detection visibility, identify logging, ingestion, normalization, retention, and coverage gaps, and collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to improve security monitoring and investigation capabilities.
  • Serve as technical lead for significant security incidents, defining investigative priorities, evidence-preservation requirements, scoping decisions, containment strategies, remediation validation, and technical handoffs while considering operational and business impact.
  • Demonstrate advanced endpoint and network investigation capabilities, including Windows/Linux security artifacts, EDR/XDR telemetry, packet captures, DNS, proxy, firewall, flow, and related data to identify command-and-control, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and attacker infrastructure.
  • Operationalize threat intelligence by translating adversary TTPs, infrastructure, vulnerabilities, and campaign intelligence into prioritized hunts, behavioral analytics, detection logic, investigation guidance, and defensive-control improvements.
  • Perform advanced phishing and malware analysis, including malicious URLs, attachments, sender infrastructure, authentication artifacts, behavioral/static malware analysis, persistence, execution, and communications; advanced reverse engineering is not required.
  • Provide Principal-level technical leadership, including reviewing complex investigations and detections for quality and accuracy, mentoring analysts, developing repeatable investigation and response methodologies, and collaborating with Security Engineering, Architecture, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Cloud, and Identity teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently in a globally distributed environment and communicate complex technical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English fluency required. This role is Work from Office position
  • This role demands to be flexible for rotational shifts 24/7.

About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

L3 SOC Analyst

Role Overview

The L3 SOC Analyst is the senior technical escalation point within the Security Operations Centre (SOC). This role is responsible for leading complex cyber investigations, directing incident response activities, providing threat intelligence expertise, mentoring L1/L2 analysts, and driving continuous improvement of detection and response capabilities. The role combines advanced technical investigation, threat hunting, cyber threat intelligence, incident command, and operational leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical escalation point for high-severity and complex cyber incidents.
  • Lead investigations involving ransomware, business email compromise, insider threats, cloud compromise, identity attacks, and advanced persistent threats.
  • Perform detailed scoping, root-cause analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery activities during active incidents.
  • Provide incident command support and coordinate response activities across Cybersecurity, IT, Legal, HR, Privacy, and business stakeholders.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting using intelligence, behavioural analytics, SIEM, EDR, NDR, identity, and cloud telemetry.
  • Collect, analyse, operationalise, and disseminate cyber threat intelligence from internal and external sources.
  • Track threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and map activity to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Develop, tune, and improve detection use cases, correlation rules, analytics, and automated response workflows.
  • Own and maintain SOC playbooks, incident response procedures, escalation criteria, and communication templates.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and quality oversight for L1 and L2 analysts.
  • Review alert triage quality, escalation decisions, documentation standards, and investigation outcomes.
  • Produce executive-ready incident summaries, threat assessments, lessons learned, and risk-based recommendations.
  • Drive continuous improvement activities including post-incident reviews, threat modelling, detection coverage reviews, and operational readiness exercises.
  • Support compliance, audit, and regulatory activities including NIST CSF, CMMC, TISAX, and incident response evidence requirements.
  • Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in SOC Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Digital Forensics, Detection Engineering, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
  • Advanced understanding of cyber attack methodologies, adversary behaviour, and incident response frameworks.
  • Strong experience with SIEM, EDR, NDR, email security, identity security, and cloud security platforms.
  • Experience leading complex investigations and coordinating response activities across multiple teams.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with both technical and executive audiences.
  • Ability to operate independently in high-pressure situations and make risk-based decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • GCIH, GCIA, GCTI, CISSP, GCFA, GREM, CEH or equivalent certifications.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender, WIZ, SIEM/SOAR platforms, and cloud-native security tools.
  • Experience within a global enterprise SOC or regulated environment.
  • Experience leveraging AI, generative AI, and agentic security capabilities to enhance threat detection, investigation, response, and SOC operational efficiency.
  • Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time

Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

Job Description

Role : Cyber Security Operations & Incident Response Specialist

Function : Cyber Security / SOC / Incident Response

Location : Bangalore and Kochi

Experience : 1+ yrs to 7+ years

Employment Type : Full-Time

Mandatory Certification : At least one current/valid certification listed below


Job Summary

We are looking for experienced cyber security professionals to strengthen our Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Detection, Digital Forensics, and Cyber Defence teams. Candidates should have hands-on experience in one or more areas such as SOC operations, incident response, DFIR, threat hunting, SIEM/XDR engineering, or security operations and must hold at least one current and valid certification from the mandatory certification list below.


Mandatory Professional Certification

Candidates must hold at least ONE current/valid certification from the following:

  • GCIH – GIAC Certified Incident Handler
  • GCFA – GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst
  • GCFE – GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner
  • OSCP – OffSec Certified Professional
  • CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional
  • CISM – Certified Information Security Manager
  • CREST certification relevant to the candidate’s cyber security specialization


This is a mandatory eligibility requirement. Candidates should be able to provide certification details and evidence of current status during the recruitment and onboarding process.


Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor, investigate, triage, and respond to cyber security alerts and incidents.
  • Perform incident analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and root-cause analysis.
  • Investigate alerts across SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, identity, cloud, and email security platforms.
  • Conduct threat hunting and identify suspicious or malicious activity across enterprise environments.
  • Support malware, phishing, ransomware, credential compromise, data-exfiltration, and unauthorized-access investigations.
  • Perform digital forensic investigation and evidence analysis where required.
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, SOPs, runbooks, and escalation procedures.
  • Collaborate with SOC analysts, incident responders, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, network, cloud, infrastructure, and application teams.
  • Support detection-rule, correlation-use-case, dashboard, and security monitoring improvements.
  • Maintain accurate incident documentation, investigation evidence, and operational reports.
  • Participate in major-incident handling, escalation, and shift/on-call activities as applicable to the assigned role.


Required Technical Skills

Security Operations

  • SOC monitoring, alert triage, event analysis, and escalation
  • SIEM investigation, correlation, detection use cases, and dashboards

Incident Response & DFIR

  • Incident handling, containment, eradication, and recovery
  • Digital forensics, evidence collection, endpoint/network investigation, and threat hunting

Security Technologies

  • Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or equivalent SIEM platforms
  • Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, or equivalent EDR/XDR platforms
  • Network security, firewall, NDR, identity security, cloud security, and forensic technologies

Automation

  • KQL, SPL, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent query/scripting skills are desirable


Required Experience

  • Relevant experience in SOC, Cyber Security Operations, Incident Response, DFIR, Threat Hunting, Security Engineering, or Cyber Defence.
  • Hands-on experience investigating or responding to cyber security incidents is preferred.
  • Experience in enterprise or Managed Security Services environments is desirable.
  • Experience in BFSI or other regulated environments is an advantage.


Educational Qualification

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Relevant professional experience combined with the mandatory security certification may also be considered.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to work effectively during critical incidents and under time pressure.
  • Strong teamwork, ownership, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and investigation reports.


Certification Verification

Shortlisted candidates will be required to provide the certification name, issuing organization, certificate or credential number, and evidence that the certification is current/valid as part of the recruitment and onboarding verification process.


Mandatory Eligibility

Candidates who do not hold at least one current/valid GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, OSCP, CISSP, CISM, or relevant CREST certification will not meet the mandatory certification requirement for this position.

The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As an IAM Analyst (SailPoint) Senior Associate you will support cyber managed services and consult work within our Cybersecurity practice, focusing on identifying access risk, reviewing identity controls, and helping clients manage secure user access across systems and data. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex situations, guide junior team members, build meaningful client connections, and grow your technical skills while navigating ambiguity and adapting to changing business needs. In this role at PwC, you will contribute to incident response activities, interpret data to inform recommendations, and use a range of tools and methods to support identity and access management deliverables for client engagements.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzing cybersecurity incidents and identity management issues across client environments to identify root causes and remediation steps
  • Managing SailPoint access governance tasks, including user provisioning, access reviews, role updates, and entitlement controls
  • Monitoring alerts, logs, and incident queues to prioritize response actions and reduce operational exposure
  • Developing incident response runbooks and remediation plans for identity and access management events
  • Coordinating with client technical teams to gather facts, validate findings, and track issue resolution progress
  • Interpreting security data and access patterns to recommend control improvements and reduce repeat incidents
  • Supporting managed services delivery by documenting workflows, updating procedures, and maintaining service records
  • Reviewing assigned work for accuracy and consistency while guiding junior team members on task execution
  • Applying cybersecurity frameworks, vulnerability management practices, and security tooling to support incident containment and recovery

What You Must Have

  • At least a Bachelor's degree
  • At least 3 years of experience
  • Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

  • Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Studies, Computer and Information Science, Information CyberSecurity, Information Technology, Management Information Systems
  • At least one of the following: One or more certifications aligned to incident response and cyber defense, including GIAC (eg., GCFA, GCIA, GCIH) or equivalent incident response credentials
  • Demonstrating SailPoint identity and access management configuration experience in managed services environments
  • Applying incident response and cyber defense knowledge to identity-related events and escalations
  • Interpreting data from logs, alerts, and access reviews for actionable recommendations
  • Anticipating client needs while navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities
