descriptionHtml:
Agentic Full-Stack Engineer


About Securin

Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions — giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do.


Our Engineering Values

We build with agents and verify with humans — treating AI as a genuine collaborator, holding agent-generated code to the same review standard as human-authored code, and shipping features only when test coverage and security checks are in place. We take end-to-end ownership, write maintainable code, and bring security awareness into every decision — not as a checkbox, but as a core discipline.


The Role

A high-agency software engineer who uses coding agents as a force multiplier: generating design specs with AI, curating those outputs with engineering judgment, and shipping high-quality features at pace on the Securin cybersecurity platform.


Responsibilities

● Feature Development

Design and ship full-stack features for the Securin platform end-to-end — using AI coding agents (Claude) to generate specs and boilerplate, then curating those outputs with engineering rigor, security context, and architectural judgment before finalizing. Work with teams in the US and India to facilitate communication, operations, and design. Required to attend 1-2 US evening meetings a week to sync with India based teams.


● Agent & Automation Engineering

Build agentic workflows and automation pipelines that streamline engineering — and enforce a human-in-the-loop review process ensuring every AI-produced change is critically evaluated for correctness, security, and fit before it reaches production.


● Platform & Infrastructure

Architect and maintain cloud-native SaaS services on AWS, contributing to API design, data modeling, and microservices architecture that power real-time threat intelligence ingestion and delivery.


● Security Mindset

Apply secure-by-design principles throughout development and work alongside Securin's security researchers to translate vulnerability intelligence domain knowledge into robust platform capabilities.


Requirements

● 3+ years building production SaaS

● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

● Public cloud experience required (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure acceptable)

● Deep familiarity with:

○ Containerization

○ Serverless architecture

○ Event-driven architecture

○ RESTful API design


Culture-Forward Building with AI: What We Expect - Role-Specific

○ Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents is a prerequisite.

○ Must be able to critically review agent-generated code and specs for:

● Hallucinations

● Security flaws

● Architectural drift before merging.


General

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate


GenAI tools into daily workflows - Automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.


● Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role.

● Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it.

● Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques - structuring multi-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production-grade results.

● Comfort with agentic AI workflows - using, designing, or building multi-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human-in-the-loop validation.

● Awareness of AI security fundamentals - prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows.

● Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems.

● Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use.

● Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing within the team.

Essential Functions And Tasks

  • Conduct internal ISMS and ISO 27001 audits and assess the effectiveness of security controls.
  • Review information security policies, procedures, standards, and control evidence.
  • Identify and document security risks, control gaps, observations, and non-conformities.

  • Track audit findings and corrective actions and validate remediation evidence through closure.
  • Support ISO 27001 certification, surveillance audits, and management reviews.
  • Monitor security systems, networks, endpoints, and infrastructure for threats and suspicious activity.
  • Support security incident identification, investigation, response, and documentation.
  • Coordinate vulnerability management, patch management, and remediation activities.
  • Support access management, privileged access, and periodic user access reviews.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain security tools and infrastructure, including firewalls, endpoint security, authentication, and monitoring solutions.
  • Support security logging, alerting, and investigation activities.
  • Assist with data protection, information classification, and secure handling of sensitive information.
  • Participate in third-party/vendor security assessments where required.
  • Support business continuity and disaster recovery security requirements.
  • Identify security requirements and recommend solutions to improve the organization's security posture.
  • Develop and implement security improvements and automation for repeatable security tasks.
  • Support security awareness and training initiatives.
  • Prepare security, audit, risk, and compliance reports for management.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and applicable information security standards.
  • Contribute to the continual improvement of the organization's ISMS and overall security posture.


Education And Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Information Security, ISMS, IT Audit, IT Compliance, GRC, or a related security role.

Cyber Managed Services – Privileged Identity & Access Management – Senior Consultant (BeyondTrust PAM – Operations)

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Consultant – BeyondTrust PAM Operations to join our Cyber Managed Services team. This role focuses on delivering ongoing operational support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of BeyondTrust PAM environments for our clients. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in BeyondTrust operations, strong troubleshooting skills, and a commitment to ensuring secure and reliable access to privileged systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide Level 2 and Level 3 operational support for BeyondTrust PAM-related issues, including access failures, session management disruptions, and system performance concerns.
  • Perform day-to-day administration of privileged accounts within the BeyondTrust platform — including provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and policy updates as per change requests.
  • Monitor BeyondTrust system health and logs proactively; perform regular housekeeping activities to ensure availability, stability, and performance.
  • Coordinate with client IT/security teams to maintain alignment with security policies, operational procedures, and audit requirements related to PAM.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and runbooks; contribute to documentation and knowledge base for consistent operations.
  • Perform routine health checks, validations, and access audits; work on remediation of findings from internal or external audits.
  • Support operational controls like Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), session recording, and other security configurations within the PAM environment.
  • Handle incident tickets, change requests, and service requests per agreed SLAs, escalating as needed and ensuring proper closure with documentation.
  • Keep up with BeyondTrust product updates, known issues, and patches to advise on operational relevance or risk.
  • Identify automation opportunities within day-to-day operations to reduce manual effort and increase efficiency.
  • Work closely with BeyondTrust support or third-party vendors when necessary to resolve product-level or environment-specific issues.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience in BeyondTrust Password Safe, Session Management, and general PAM operational functions.
  • Understanding of IAM concepts, access lifecycle management, and integration touchpoints with directory services or ticketing systems.
  • Working knowledge of ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira, etc.) for managing tickets and changes in a structured environment.
  • Basic scripting capabilities (e.g., PowerShell or Python) for automation or data extraction/reporting.
  • Ability to analyze logs and events to troubleshoot issues and provide RCA (Root Cause Analysis).
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, PCI-DSS, especially in an operations context.
  • Strong communication skills for stakeholder interactions, documentation, and process adherence.
  • Experience working in 24x7 or follow-the-sun support models.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Work Requirements:

  • Willingness to work in rotational shifts or be part of on-call support as per business needs.
  • Occasional off-hours or weekend support during critical issues or planned activities.
  • Readiness to collaborate across time zones with global teams or clients.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description: Application Security Engineer

Experience: 2 to 5 years

Location: Alwarpet,Chennai.


Job Summary:

In this role, you will focus on ensuring the security of web applications, mobile applications, and APIs through a combination of proactive security testing, code review, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessments. You will work closely with development teams to integrate secure coding practices and help mitigate risks in the software development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, penetration testing, and vulnerability scans of applications and services.
  • Perform static and dynamic analysis on web applications, mobile applications, and APIs to identify and resolve security vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to implement secure development practices, reviewing code for security flaws and recommending improvements.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to identify potential security threats and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Assist in the development and execution of security tools, procedures, and frameworks to automate security testing processes.
  • Keep up-to-date with the latest security vulnerabilities, exploits, and security best practices.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior security engineers and developers on security issues.
  • Advise on the secure architecture and design of systems, identifying potential security gaps early in the design phase.
  • Create and maintain documentation related to security testing, security incidents, and remediation activities.
  • Support the incident response team in handling security incidents and provide post-incident analysis.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • 2-5 years of experience in application security or related field.
  • Strong knowledge of web and mobile application security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, OWASP Mobile, etc.).
  • Experience with penetration testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, etc.) and techniques.
  • Familiarity with static and dynamic code analysis tools (Checkmarx, SonarQube, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of secure coding practices (e.g., input validation, encryption, and authentication).
  • Experience in threat modeling and risk assessment techniques.
  • Understanding of web application technologies (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, etc.) and backend technologies (Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, etc.).
  • Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of industry standards and frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, SOC2, etc.).
  • Good understanding of authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML, OpenID, etc.) and encryption algorithms (AES, RSA, TLS, etc.).
  • Experience in conducting security code reviews and integrating security into the SDLC.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Skills:

  • Certifications such as OWASP, CISSP, CISM, CEH, or equivalent.
  • Experience with automated security testing in CI/CD environments.
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools and their integration into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools.

descriptionHtml:
Role purpose: Own day-to-day administration and implementation of security tools for Karix [Tanla Group Company], maintain effective controls and support Group security operations through a shared backup arrangement.


Expected outcomes: Healthy and documented security platforms; timely completion of approved implementation and change activities; fewer recurring operational issues; complete control evidence; demonstrated ability to provide leave coverage for the other entities.


What you’ll be Responsible for?

  • Implement, configure and administer ZTNA and DLP, CyberArk PAM, WAF and email security platforms in coordination with Group security standards and approved designs.
  • Manage access policies, application onboarding, privileged account onboarding and rotation, session controls, DLP policies, WAF rule tuning and email protection settings through approved change processes.
  • Troubleshoot user access failures, connector or agent issues, certificate dependencies, policy conflicts and platform availability; coordinate with IT, DevOps, network teams and vendors.
  • Maintain platform health checks, configuration records, access reviews, approved exceptions, runbooks, upgrade plans and renewal inputs. Validate controls after deployment or significant changes.
  • Integrate security tool logs and alerts with the Group SOC; support incident investigation and execute approved platform actions while preserving evidence.
  • Assess operational gaps, propose improvements and track implementation to closure. Provide control evidence for internal reviews, customer audits and compliance activities.
  • Perform IAM reviews for AD and identified tools, and reconcile security tool coverage against user and asset inventories, using the quarterly cycle. Document gaps and track corrective actions.
  • Shadow the other two entity Security Operations resources, maintain current handover records and provide cross-entity support during leave or agreed workload peaks.


What We'll Lok in you?

  • 4–5 years of hands-on security operations, security platform administration or implementation experience.
  • Practical experience across multiple tools in the required stack: ZTNA and DLP, CyberArk PAM, WAF and email security. Strong depth in at least two areas and the ability to support the remaining areas.
  • Experience with Zscaler ZIA / ZPA and DLP, CyberArk, Akamai WAF, Check Point Harmony Email Security or equivalent solutions is desirable; CyberArk administration experience is strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of SSO, MFA, SAML / OIDC, DNS, TLS certificates, routing, proxies, endpoint agents and Windows / Linux administration.
  • Strong critical thinking, structured troubleshooting, change discipline, documentation and communication; ability to distinguish a platform issue from a security incident. Ability to review AD and tool access, reconcile inventories and report coverage gaps is required.
  • Education – BE / B.Tech / MCA in a relevant technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Certifications - Relevant Zscaler, CyberArk, WAF or email security certifications are desirable, not mandatory.


Why join us?


  • Impactful Work: Play a key role in strengthening HR operations and delivering a seamless employee experience across the organization.
  • Tremendous Growth Opportunities: Be part of a rapidly growing company with opportunities to build and improve HR processes and practices.
  • Innovative Environment: Work alongside a collaborative team in a dynamic environment where ownership, accountability and innovation are valued.


Tanla is an equal opportunity employer. We champion diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

www.tanla.com / www.karix.com

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Application & Software Security (AppSec)

  • Implement, manage, and optimize Veracode platform capabilities, including SAST, DAST, and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).

  • Manage Edge and Layer 7 security using AWS WAF and Cloudflare WAF, defining and maintaining rate-limiting rules, bot management policies, and custom firewall configurations.

Cloud & Network Security Architecture

  • Design, configure, and manage secure AWS network architectures involving VPCs, Security Groups, Network ACLs, NAT Gateways, Bastion Hosts, and Site-to-Site VPNs.
  • Administer AWS security governance, monitoring, and compliance tooling, including Security Hub, GuardDuty, Macie, Config, Inspector, and CloudTrail.
  • Implement and audit identity and data protection standards using AWS IAM, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, and AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).
  • Configure network-level logging, analyze network traffic, and troubleshoot complex routing or security issues.
  • Perform dynamic packet analysis using Wireshark, tcpdump, and packet inspection tools to diagnose complex network/security anomalies.

Security Operations & Automation

  • Maintain operational visibility into Malware Protection, SIEM, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms (configuration, monitoring, and incident investigation).

  • SecOps & Endpoint Security: Operational knowledge of SIEM, EDR, and Malware Protection configuration and threat monitoring.

Job Summary

  • App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.
  • Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Application Development

  • Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
  • Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
  • Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
  • Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.

Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards

  • Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
  • Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
  • Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
  • Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.

Secure Development & Technology Risk

  • Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
  • Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
  • Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
  • Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

API, Integration & Data Engineering

  • Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.
  • Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.
  • Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.
  • Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.

DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness

  • Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.
  • Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.
  • Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability.
  • Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.

Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability

  • Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.
  • Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.
  • Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.

Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.
  • Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.
  • Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.
  • Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.
  • Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.
  • Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.
  • Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Software Engineering
  • Programming Principles
  • Application Programming Interface
  • Database Development
  • Distributed Systems
  • DevOps
  • Software Testing
  • Secure Coding
  • Web Application Security
  • Mobile Security

Other Skills

  • Platform Management
  • Operating Systems
  • Computer Network
  • Database Administration
  • Functional Writing

Motivations

  • Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity.
  • Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions.
  • Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued.

Qualifications

  • Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes.
  • Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions.
  • Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.
  • Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement.
  • Experience adapting to evolving technologies, development practices or delivery approaches while maintaining effective outcomes.
  • Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: IT Administrator (Infrastructure, AWS Cloud & ERPNext)

Location: [Chennai – On-site]


Department: Information Technology


Employment Type: Full-time


Experience Level: 3–5+ Years


Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on, proactive IT Administrator to manage, secure, and optimize our hybrid IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will possess strong operational expertise across Windows Active Directory, AWS Cloud environments, FortiGate Next-Generation Firewalls, and ERPNext (Frappe Framework) administration. You will be responsible for ensuring high system availability, enforcing network and cloud security protocols, managing ERPNext user access and backend stability, and resolving escalated technical issues across departments.


Key Responsibilities

1. ERPNext Administration & Technical Support


  • Administer, maintain, and monitor the company’s ERPNext instance (hosted on AWS/Linux), ensuring high uptime, fast query performance, and smooth daily operations.
  • Manage ERPNext user onboarding, role permissions, custom workflows, DocType configurations, print formats, and email/SMS notification gateways.
  • Handle Frappe Bench operations (bench update, bench migrate, backups, scheduler jobs, and Redis/MariaDB health monitoring).
  • Troubleshoot integration issues between ERPNext and external platforms (payment gateways, biometric attendance devices, e-invoicing/GST APIs, or third-party tools) and coordinate with external ERPNext developers/consultants for custom app deployments.

2. Identity & Windows Server Administration (Active Directory)


  • Administer and maintain Windows Server environments, Active Directory (AD), Group Policy Objects (GPO), DNS, DHCP, and shared file/print servers.
  • Execute user lifecycle management—account provisioning, offboarding, organizational unit (OU) structuring, and role-based access control (RBAC).
  • Monitor Domain Controller health, replication, and directory synchronization with cloud identity/email services.

3. AWS Cloud Infrastructure Management


  • Provision, configure, and manage core AWS services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and Route 53) hosting ERPNext and internal workloads.
  • Implement AWS security best practices including IAM least-privilege policies, Security Groups, NACLs, and encrypted storage volumes.
  • Manage automated snapshots, S3 backup policies, cost optimization, and disaster recovery (DR) testing.

4. Network Security & Firewall Administration (FortiGate)


  • Configure, administer, and troubleshoot FortiGate Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), including firewall policies, NAT/VIP rules, Web Filtering, Application Control, IPS/IDS, and SSL inspection.
  • Set up and maintain secure Site-to-Site IPSec VPNs (between offices/plants/warehouses and AWS VPC) and SSL VPNs for remote staff.
  • Manage LAN/WAN switching, VLAN segmentation, Wi-Fi access points, and monitor FortiGate traffic logs for bandwidth bottlenecks or security threats.

5. IT Operations, Asset Management & End-User Support


  • Serve as the L2/L3 escalation point for complex hardware, OS, network, and ERPNext functional/technical tickets.
  • Maintain accurate IT asset registers, software license tracking, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and network architecture diagrams.
  • Oversee endpoint security (Antivirus/EDR), OS patch compliance, and periodic vulnerability audits.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics/Engineering, or an equivalent technical field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of proven hands-on experience in IT Infrastructure, Cloud, and ERP System Administration.
  • ERPNext & Linux: Practical experience administering ERPNext / Frappe on Ubuntu/Debian Linux, including familiarity with Frappe Bench CLI, Nginx, Supervisor, Redis, and MariaDB/MySQL backups and troubleshooting.
  • Directory & Windows: Strong command of Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Active Directory, GPOs, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience deploying, securing, and monitoring production servers on AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Networking & Security: Proven experience configuring and troubleshooting FortiGate firewalls, Site-to-Site/SSL VPNs, VLANs, and TCP/IP networking.
  • Soft Skills: Strong root-cause troubleshooting mindset, disciplined documentation habits, and clear communication with non-technical business teams (Finance, Supply Chain, HR, Operations).


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package with annual performance reviews.
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage and statutory benefits.
  • Support for technical certifications and continuous skill development.

Job Title: IT Network Engineer

Location: Chennai, India (on-site)


Who are we?

Securin is a leading provider of tech-enabled cybersecurity solutions, helping hundreds of customers worldwide gain resilience against emerging threats. Our products are powered by accurate vulnerability intelligence, human expertise, and automation, enabling enterprises to make crucial security decisions to manage their expanding attack surfaces.


What do we promise?

  • A chance to be on the leading edge of cybersecurity and AI
  • An opportunity to build and lead a critical function from the ground up
  • Ability to have direct impact on company growth and revenue strategy
  • A collaborative and high-growth environment where you will work very closely with executive leadership and your expertise will be valued


Overview

We are looking for an experienced IT Network Engineer to design, implement, and maintain Securin’s internal and customer-facing network and virtualization infrastructure. This role focuses heavily on network security, firewall management, virtualization platforms, and infrastructure automation in a fast-paced cybersecurity company.


Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, manage, and troubleshoot Fortinet/FortiGate firewalls (policies, VPNs, SD-WAN, threat prevention, HA clusters).
  • Administer and optimize Proxmox VE clusters for internal lab, testing, and production virtualization environments.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Ansible, PXE boot, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), and Google Workspace administration scripting/API integration.
  • Leverage AI to increase the efficiency of IT services, automate IT processes and to proactively monitor and alert any issues related to IT Infrastructure.
  • Monitor network and system performance, proactively identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to ensure high availability and minimal downtime.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for critical network and infrastructure incidents.
  • Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for network designs, automation playbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with security best practices and internal policies.


Qualifications

This posting is based out of Chennai. To be eligible for consideration, candidates must be local or willing to relocate.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience in network engineering and infrastructure administration.


Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise with Fortinet/FortiGate firewalls (configuration and management (NSE 4 or higher strongly preferred), core/aggregate switches(CISCO/Aruba/Unifi)
  • Hands-on experience managing Proxmox VE clusters in production or lab environments.
  • Proficiency with Ansible and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Endpoint Management and Security tools
  • Hands on with AI tools like Chatgpt, Claude, Cursor, Gemini
  • Solid scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Deep understanding of networking (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools and performance troubleshooting.


Core AI Skill Requirements (In General):

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate GenAI tools into daily workflows - automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.

  • Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role.
  • Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques - structuring multi-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production-grade results
  • Comfort with agentic AI workflows - using, designing, or building multi-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human-in-the-loop validation
  • Awareness of AI security fundamentals - prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows
  • Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems
  • Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use
  • Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing within the team


Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently in a fast-paced environment.


Certifications (preferred but not required)

  • Fortinet NSE 4/5/6/7
  • Red Hat Ansible Automation, Proxmox-related certifications
  • CCNA/CCNP or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Industry standards like ISO27001:2022, SOC2


Working Conditions

  • Full-time
  • Onsite (IITRP, Chennai)


Join us in our mission to advance cybersecurity and help secure some of the most critical digital ecosystems worldwide!

description: THE ROLEWe are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Presales Implementation Engineer with experience in the Cybersecurity domain. descriptionHtml:
THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Presales Implementation Engineer with experience in the Cybersecurity domain. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM), Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools, or Patch Management solutions. As a Presales Implementation Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in working with customers to understand their requirements, assisting in the presales process, and ensuring smooth implementation of security solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with sales and technical teams to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Conduct product demonstrations, proof-of-concept (POC) deployments, and solution presentations for customers.
  • Design and implement security solutions, including MDM, RMM, and Patch Management tools, based on customer needs and business goals.
  • Provide technical guidance and advice to clients during the presales cycle. Assist in creating and customizing proposals, responses to RFPs, and technical documentation.
  • Work closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful deployments, configurations, and implementations of cybersecurity products.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during presales and post-sales phases.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in the cybersecurity domain, particularly related to MDM, RMM, and Patch Management.
  • Support clients in managing and securing devices, networks, and endpoints.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction by ensuring timely and efficient implementation of solutions.

Required Skills And Qualifications

  • 2 -5 years of experience in the cybersecurity domain, with a focus on MDM (Mobile Device Management), RMM (Remote Monitoring and Management), or Patch Management tools.
  • Strong understanding of security frameworks and protocols for device management, remote monitoring, and patching.
  • Experience with deploying, configuring, and supporting MDM solutions such as AirWatch, MobileIron, or Microsoft Intune.
  • Familiarity with RMM and Patch Management tools like Kaseya, ConnectWise, or NinjaRMM.
  • Hands-on experience in presales activities, including customer engagements, presentations, and demos.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage customer expectations, solve problems quickly, and work under pressure.
  • Basic understanding of network security, endpoint protection, and IT infrastructure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (preferred).

REQUIREMENT

  • Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or any other relevant cybersecurity certifications.
  • Experience in network security and endpoint management.
  • Knowledge of cloud security concepts and technologies.

Hexnode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences to apply

Job Description Summary

Product Cyber-security Analyst is responsible for the analysis of controllers , systems, Cloud architectures for cyber security requirements.

Conduct tests to verify Cyber security levels and recommend mitigation plans for products , systems during tendering ,Project execution and product development stages.

As a key member of a global and matrixed design team, he will also be responsible for secure design of cloud and Customer facing Dashboards.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

  • Involve in reviews, suggest architectural changes, conduct tests to ensure systems, controllers, and Cloud platform meet Cyber security requirements .
  • Collaborate with a team of controls and system engineers developing operational software for various subsystems.
  • The position requires a clear understanding of OT System, cloud application architecture and conversant with all Cyber security requirements.
  • This role requires strong cooperation with system and subsystem teams necessary for command and control of the systems involved.
  • The architect should be comfortable making design decisions in a sometimes-uncertain context, crafting innovative solutions, and demonstrating rigorous and decisive leadership.
  • Work with multiple teams in diﬀerent location to deliver Cyber secure software to meet customer requirements.

As a Cyber Security Engineer, You Will

  • Collaborate with system and subsystem engineers to develop top level software requirements, architecture and designs.
  • Facilitate decisions and bring teams together to design and document software architecture, modularity, and future-proof.
  • Involve in proofs-of-concept to prove out strategy and manage development and product risks.
  • Champion testing and validation of critical architecture and interface requirements for real time controls system software as well as application tools.
  • Own production of technical documentation for software architecture, design, verification plans.
  • Contribute to multi-generation product and tool planning.
  • Ensure all software developed is compliant to Cyber-security requirements.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor /Master Degree in computer science or relevant engineering or equivalent knowledge / experience with 5+ Years of Experience.
  • Significant software development experience for Cloud based systems.
  • Experience in Cyber security for Controller, Systems in OT Space and in Cloud architectures.
  • Familiar with penetration testing for Controllers, Systems, Web software’s, CAPEC, Ethical hacking.
  • Experience on Cyber security/network tools like Wireshark, NESSUS, Burp Suite, etc.
  • Design and development skills using latest Java/Java EE technologies and open source frameworks including Spring, JSF, Hibernate, OpenJpa and EclipseLink.
  • Experienced in diﬀerent phases of Software Development Life cycle (SDLC) including Design, Implementation and Testing.
  • Extensively worked on web technologies like JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, AngularJS, Angular 6, NodeJs, Spring, Hibernate, Spring boot, MVC, RESTful Web Services, Flux, SOAP.
  • Cloud platform experience : AWS
  • Database RDBMS, MySQL NoSQL databases
  • Software component : MS Visual Studio, MS Oﬃce, MS Visio, SVN, GitHub
  • Linux and Windows OS
  • Extensively worked on Software Configuration Management tools like Git.
  • Hands on experience with Enterprise Application and Web Application servers like Tomcat, and WLP.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong software development skills in C++, C#, Python.
  • Familiar with ISA -624443, NIST 800 standards.
  • Experience in software development including system design, requirement gathering, software development and verification, build and release, documentation.
  • Experience in build automation, continuous integration, configuration management, verification, deployment of software.
  • Experience in database design and version control repository-based applications.
  • Demonstrated track record of success with excellent technical written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven project management experience.
  • Experience in highly demanding computational power software, HPC and cloud-based engineering solutions.
  • Leadership experience in a research and development environment.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

Job Summary

This job ensures the integrity and security of the company's cyber infrastructure by designing robust system architecture. It also entails solving complex engineering challenges. It involves documenting technical processes, reporting outcomes, and recommending innovative solutions. The role supports project teams and influences engineering staff, while maintaining a comprehensive understanding of network protocols and security strategies. The position requires flexibility to work variable schedules, including nights and weekends, as necessary.

Job Description

Senior CyberArk Engineer / CyberArk Developer

Experience: 6+ Years | Domain: Identity Security / Privileged Access Management (PAM)

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior CyberArk Engineer / Developer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in CyberArk PAM engineering, custom plugin development, enterprise onboarding, platform integrations, automation, upgrades, and operational support. The role focuses on CPM password management plugins, PSM session management connectors, CyberArk enhancements, Snyk finding remediation, L2/L3 troubleshooting, and enterprise-scale onboarding of accounts, servers, devices, and applications. PowerShell is mandatory, while Java and Python are preferred development skills.

Primary Focus

CyberArk PAM Engineering and Development

Development Preference

Java and Python optional / preferred

Experience Requirements

  • 6+ years of CyberArk PAM experience in enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience with CyberArk implementation, customization, maintenance, upgrades, and integrations.
  • Strong exposure to both engineering delivery and operational support functions.
  • Experience developing and supporting password management and session management plugins.

Core Responsibilities

CyberArk Development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain CPM Password Management Plugins.
  • Develop and customize PSM Session Management Connectors for applications, databases, servers, and devices.
  • Build and enhance CyberArk integrations using REST APIs and automation frameworks.
  • Develop new CyberArk platform capabilities, enhancements, utilities, and reusable automation modules.
  • Perform code fixes, maintenance activities, peer reviews, and release readiness validation.
  • Automate operational processes using PowerShell; Java and Python experience is preferred.
  • Remediate Snyk findings and application security findings within agreed timelines.
  • Maintain source code, release artifacts, branches, and version history using Git.

CyberArk Engineering

  • Design, configure, implement, and support CyberArk PAM solutions across enterprise use cases.
  • Manage and support EPV, CPM, PSM, PVWA, PTA, CyberArk APIs, safes, platforms, and access policies.
  • Onboard privileged accounts, service accounts, servers, databases, applications, and network devices.
  • Conduct POCs for new applications, technologies, and device integrations with CyberArk.
  • Execute CyberArk upgrades, platform migrations, patching, health checks, and post-upgrade validations.
  • Integrate CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, Vault platforms, ticketing tools, and enterprise applications.
  • Perform L2/L3 troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and permanent fix implementation for production issues.

Operations & Support

  • Provide support through Slack, Email, and IT service management channels.
  • Troubleshoot onboarding, password rotation, reconciliation, session launch, and access workflow issues.
  • Resolve incidents, service requests, and JIRA tickets within defined SLA expectations.
  • Support production deployments, release validations, critical incident management, and escalations.
  • Create and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and handover guides.
  • Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Application, IAM, and Operations teams.

Required Technical Skills

CyberArk

  • Enterprise Password Vault (EPV)
  • Central Policy Manager (CPM)
  • Privileged Session Manager (PSM)
  • Password Vault Web Access (PVWA)
  • Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA)
  • CyberArk REST APIs
  • Safe Management
  • Platform Management
  • Discovery & Onboarding
  • Privileged Account Lifecycle Management
  • CyberArk Upgrades & Migration
  • CPM Plugin Development
  • PSM Connector Development

Development & Automation

  • PowerShell mandatory
  • REST API development
  • Git / GitHub
  • Secure coding practices
  • Automation design
  • Release support

Preferred Development Skills

  • Java
  • Python
  • Shell scripting
  • Reusable utility development
  • CI/CD pipeline exposure

Infrastructure & Integration

  • Active Directory
  • LDAP
  • Windows Server
  • Linux administration
  • HashiCorp Vault / OpenBao
  • Databases
  • Network devices
  • Enterprise application integrations

Tools

  • CyberArk
  • Git
  • JIRA
  • Snyk
  • Vault technologies
  • Active Directory
  • PowerShell
  • Java
  • Python

Preferred Certifications

  • CyberArk Defender
  • CyberArk Sentry
  • CyberArk CDE

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Strong CyberArk PAM engineering and development background with practical experience in enterprise-scale environments.
  • Proven hands-on expertise in CPM Plugin Development and PSM Connector Development.
  • Strong understanding of privileged account onboarding, password rotation, reconciliation, session management, and access controls.
  • Ability to independently drive enhancements, troubleshooting, upgrades, onboarding activities, and operational improvements.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to work with security, infrastructure, application, and operations stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using JIRA and Git.

Note

The role is focused on CyberArk PAM, CPM, PSM, integrations, onboarding, upgrades, automation, Snyk remediation, and operational support.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Network Engineer

Experience: 2-5 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced L2 Network Engineer to join our Network Operations team. The role involves handling complex network incidents, advanced troubleshooting, network changes, technical escalations, and infrastructure projects across enterprise customer environments.

Key Responsibilities

· Troubleshoot and resolve complex LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN and Internet connectivity issues.

· Perform advanced troubleshooting across enterprise network infrastructure.

· Configure, troubleshoot and optimize Cisco routers and switches.

· Troubleshoot routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP and static routing.

· Troubleshoot switching technologies including VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP/MST, EtherChannel and LACP.

· Troubleshoot HSRP, VRRP and network redundancy/high-availability configurations.

· Troubleshoot routing loops, asymmetric routing, packet loss, latency and network instability.

· Analyze network traffic and perform packet-level troubleshooting using Wireshark and packet captures.

· Troubleshoot MPLS, SD-WAN, Internet circuits and WAN connectivity.

· Configure and troubleshoot IPsec, SSL VPN, GRE and site-to-site VPNs.

· Troubleshoot enterprise firewalls including Fortinet, Palo Alto and Cisco ASA/Firepower.

· Troubleshoot firewall policies, NAT, security rules, VPN tunnels and connectivity issues.

· Support enterprise wireless infrastructure including Cisco, Aruba and Meraki environments.

· Troubleshoot wireless authentication, roaming, RF, coverage, performance and connectivity issues.

· Monitor network health and performance using PRTG, SolarWinds or equivalent monitoring platforms.

· Analyze network alerts, logs, SNMP data, syslog and performance metrics to identify root causes.

· Take ownership of Major Incidents and coordinate technical resolution within agreed SLAs.

· Participate in RCA and Problem Management activities for recurring and critical network issues.

· Prepare detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive action reports.

· Perform network configuration changes, upgrades and maintenance activities following the approved Change Management process.

· Participate in network migrations, infrastructure upgrades and technology refresh projects.

· Review existing network configurations and identify opportunities for performance, availability and security improvements.

· Validate network designs and provide technical recommendations for new implementations.

· Coordinate with ISPs, OEMs, vendors and third-party service providers for complex issue resolution.

· Work closely with internal infrastructure, security, service desk and application teams during troubleshooting.

· Participate in customer technical calls and provide regular updates on critical incidents and planned changes.

· Maintain accurate network diagrams, configuration documents, SOPs, troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles.

· Ensure network documentation and CMDB information are updated following infrastructure changes.

· Perform configuration reviews and identify potential network risks or single points of failure.

· Support network capacity planning and identify bandwidth, performance and infrastructure requirements.

· Participate in network audits, compliance activities and security reviews where required.

· Develop and improve network troubleshooting procedures, SOPs and operational runbooks.

· Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and technical training for junior engineers.

· Identify recurring incidents and recommend permanent solutions to reduce incident volume.

· Ensure all incidents, changes and problem records are properly documented in the ITSM tool.

· Maintain compliance with SLA, ITIL, security and operational processes.

· Participate in 24×7 on-call / rotational support for critical network incidents.

Required Skills

· 2-5 years of experience in Enterprise Networking / Network Operations.

· Strong hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches.

· Strong knowledge of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLAN, STP, HSRP/VRRP and TCP/IP.

· Experience with firewalls, VPN and network security.

· Experience with SD-WAN, MPLS and WAN technologies.

· Strong knowledge of enterprise network troubleshooting methodologies.

· Hands-on experience with Wireshark and packet analysis.

· Experience with network monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds or equivalent.

· Good understanding of ITIL, Incident, Problem and Change Management.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Excellent communication and customer-handling skills.

· Ability to work independently and handle critical incidents under pressure.

· Willingness to work in a 24×7 / rotational support environment.


Preferred Certifications

· CCNP Enterprise

· CCNA

· Fortinet / Palo Alto certification

· Aruba / Meraki certification

· ITIL Foundation

Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)

Department: Trimble Cloud xOps

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role: Power Resilient Cloud Infrastructure at Scale

Are you passionate about building self-healing cloud architectures, automating complex deployments, and driving operational excellence? Trimble is seeking a DevOps Engineer II to join our Trimble Cloud xOps team in Chennai.

In this role, you will design, automate, and maintain mission-critical AWS infrastructure using modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. You will focus on maximizing system availability, shifting our operations from reactive troubleshooting to proactive observability, and integrating intelligent automation to support Trimble’s global cloud platforms.

What Makes This Role Exciting

As part of the Trimble Cloud xOps team, you will work at the intersection of cloud engineering, reliability, and intelligent automation. Beyond maintaining CI/CD pipelines and disaster recovery strategies, you will have the opportunity to apply hands-on AI engineering skills and modern AI tooling to enhance operational workflows, build self-healing infrastructure, and shape resilient cloud standards across a global technology leader.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Engineering: Develop, modify, and maintain AWS-based cloud components using Terraform and configuration management tools like Ansible, while reviewing and maintaining high standards across IaC repositories in GitHub and Bitbucket.
  • Automated Product Deployments & CI/CD: Create, maintain, and continuously improve automated application deployment pipelines utilizing GitHub Workflows and Jenkins.
  • Proactive Observability & Self-Healing: Enhance platform availability and incident response by building automated, self-healing remediation workflows triggered by system alerts, continuously evolving monitoring capabilities from reactive to proactive.
  • Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity: Design, configure, and test resilient Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions on AWS—including automated backup, replication, and failover strategies utilizing services such as AWS Backup and AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery.
  • Risk & Impact Analysis: Conduct thorough technical risk assessments and business impact analyses (BIA) to proactively identify potential infrastructure threats and safeguard business operations.
  • Intelligent Operations: Leverage Python scripting and applied AI engineering techniques to streamline operational tasks, automate diagnostics, and optimize cloud workflows.

Required Skills And Experience

  • Enterprise Experience: Proven experience in a similar DevOps or Cloud Operations role within a large-scale enterprise environment.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Strong hands-on proficiency with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation to provision and manage AWS resources, paired with deployment automation tools such as Ansible and familiarity with AWS networking, security, and storage solutions.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, and Amazon EKS.
  • Disaster Recovery & Resilience: Strong knowledge of AWS services related to Disaster Recovery and automation, including AWS Backup, AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, and AWS Lambda.
  • Monitoring & Observability: 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience implementing and managing enterprise monitoring solutions such as Datadog, Nagios, or New Relic.
  • Programming & AI Tooling: Strong coding and scripting expertise in Python, alongside hands-on AI engineering skills and practical experience using modern AI tools like n8n and Cursor.
  • CI/CD & Version Control: Practical experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Workflows and Jenkins, with solid repository management in GitHub/Bitbucket.
  • Core Competencies: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively across global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer.

Why Join Trimble?

At Trimble, you will work on foundational cloud platforms that power transformative technology across construction, agriculture, geospatial, and transportation worldwide. Within the Trimble Cloud xOps team in Chennai, you will collaborate with talented global engineers who value automation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Trimble is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive, equitable environment for all employees.

How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.

Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.

At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

The Security Central team builds and operates services that help OCI teams understand their security posture, identify risks, and drive remediation across cloud infrastructure. The Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, and optimizes distributed system components, backend services, data pipelines, and integrations with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability.

The role includes owning features and service components from design through production, delivering load and performance tests, and using data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing. Responsibilities include building fault-tolerant paths through redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automatic failover; applying recovery-oriented design principles; and implementing retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts.

Operational ownership includes proactively detecting and mitigating issues through tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authoring runbooks; and participating in incident response and root cause analysis. The role also involves developing automation and Infrastructure as Code for deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance, and implementing security controls for encryption, access management, and remediation while meeting change management, compliance, and documentation standards.

Close collaboration with security and engineering teams is essential to translate requirements into practical solutions. Contributions include technical design reviews, peer implementation reviews for scalability and reliability, and ongoing improvements to engineering and operational practices.

This role is ideal for an engineer with strong software development fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and an interest in building secure, reliable cloud services.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.

–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.

–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.

–Implements performance and load testing.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.

–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.

–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.

–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.

–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.

–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.

–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.

–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.

Compliance & Security:

–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.

–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.

–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management:

–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.

–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.

–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Problem Solving:

–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning:

–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Qualifications

Role Description

Network Engineer – Routing, Switching & Firewall

Job Summary

We are looking for a Network Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Routing, Switching, and Palo Alto OR Juniper OR Fortinet firewall technologies. The role focuses on maintaining reliable network infrastructure, performing network health checks, providing technical support, handling incidents, and supporting network changes in line with established processes.

  • Manage, support, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise Routing and Switching environments.
  • Perform network health checks and proactively identify connectivity, performance, and availability issues.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and support firewall environments using Palo Alto OR Juniper OR Fortinet based on the deployed environment.
  • Provide hands-on technical support for network-related incidents and service disruptions.
  • Monitor network performance and ensure high levels of system availability and reliability.
  • Monitor network resource utilization, trends, and capacity requirements.
  • Support planned network maintenance activities and coordinate with vendors during critical/P1 incidents.
  • Review network changes for potential security implications and recommend appropriate improvements.
  • Work within established change management and Major Incident Management (MIM) processes when implementing network infrastructure changes.
  • Collaborate with global teams, vendors, and other IT stakeholders to troubleshoot and resolve network issues.
  • Maintain a client-focused approach while adhering to established processes, policies, and operational standards.

Required Skills

Proficient

  • Routing
  • Switching
  • Palo Alto OR Juniper OR Fortinet

Why Join UST

At UST, you will have opportunities to work in a technology-driven environment supporting digital transformation initiatives while collaborating with global teams. The environment encourages continuous learning, innovation, skill development, and long-term career growth.

Routing, Switching, Firewall OR Juniper OR Palo Alto OR Fortinet OR FortiGate

Project Role Description : Deliver and manage security services across client environments to ensure protection, compliance, and operational resilience.

Must have skills : Business Requirements Analysis

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:

As a Security Managed Services Practitioner, a typical day involves overseeing and delivering comprehensive security services tailored to diverse client environments. This role requires continuous monitoring and management to uphold protection standards, ensure compliance with relevant regulations, and maintain operational resilience. The practitioner collaborates with various stakeholders to adapt security measures dynamically, addressing evolving challenges and supporting the overall security posture of client organizations. The workday is marked by proactive engagement in service delivery, incident response coordination, and maintaining seamless security operations across multiple platforms and infrastructures.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
  • Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
  • Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
  • Collaborate with clients to understand their security needs and tailor services accordingly.
  • Monitor security systems and respond promptly to incidents to minimize impact.
  • Document and report on security service performance and compliance status.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance security service delivery.


Professional & Technical Skills:

  • Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Business Requirements Analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess and interpret complex business needs related to security services.
  • Experience in developing and documenting detailed business requirements for security solutions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams and clients to bridge gaps between business objectives and technical implementation.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards to align business requirements with regulatory expectations.
  • Skilled in identifying potential risks and proposing mitigation strategies within business processes.


Additional Information:

  • The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Business Requirements Analysis.
  • This position is based at our Chennai office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

About the role:

We are looking for a Network Security Engineer with 5 years to 8 Years of strong expertise in network security, routing, and enterprise network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Cloudflare WAF, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, and Cisco networking technologies. This role requires an independent contributor who can effectively manage tasks and ensure secure, reliable network operations.

Responsibilities

Network Security

  • Manage and maintain network security infrastructure including Palo Alto and Cisco ASA firewalls.
  • Implement and monitor security policies, firewall rules, NAT configurations, and VPNs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex security and connectivity issues.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and best practices.

Web Application Security

  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions for protecting applications against threats, including DDoS attacks and bot traffic.
  • Configure WAF rules, rate limiting, and security policies to enhance application security and optimize performance.

Network Infrastructure

  • Design, implement, and support Cisco-based LAN, WAN, and Meraki environments.
  • Manage switching, wireless, and WAN connectivity across enterprise networks.
  • Monitor network performance and ensure high availability and reliability.

Routing & Switching

  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot dynamic routing protocols including BGP and EIGRP.
  • Perform routing optimization and traffic engineering for improved performance.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience in network engineering.
  • 2–3 years of hands-on experience with Cloudflare WAF.
  • 3+ years of experience managing network security using Palo Alto and Cisco ASA.
  • Strong experience with Cisco LAN, WAN, and Meraki environments (minimum 3 years).
  • Deep understanding of routing protocols such as BGP and EIGRP.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in networking and security domains.
  • Ability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or Palo Alto certifications.
  • Experience with network monitoring and logging tools.
  • Exposure to cloud networking is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Self-motivated and capable of working as an individual contributor.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Good communication and documentation abilities
