NVIDIA is seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst with deep expertise in incident response, forensics investigation, threat hunting, and proactive cyber defense. This role is ideal for a cybersecurity professional passionate about defending enterprise and product environments against advanced threats, and eager to tackle complex investigations across diverse platforms. As part of our Cyber Defense & Response team, you will lead efforts to detect, analyze, and respond to sophisticated attacks targeting NVIDIA’s corporate, cloud, and product ecosystems. You will leverage your technical skills to drive investigations, orchestrate automated responses, and strengthen our security posture across infrastructure and products.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact in the industry, collaborating with elite experts in security, data science, and AI to shape the future of product security technologies. If this sounds like a fun challenge and you are a hands-on Security Analyst, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead Incident Response efforts for corporate, cloud, and product environments, including investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery.
  • Perform threat hunting across endpoints, networks, and cloud workloads to proactively identify indicators of compromise, emerging threats, and control gaps.
  • Conduct cloud incident response for AWS, Azure, and GCP, and other cloud environments including Kubernetes and containerized workloads, performing log analysis, identity compromise investigations, and workload forensics.
  • Drive product security incident response, collaborating with engineering teams to analyze potential exposure to vulnerabilities, exploits, and security flaws in NVIDIA products.
  • Perform digital forensics and malware analysis to support investigations and root cause analysis.
  • Develop and optimize security orchestration and automation playbooks in partnership with Security Engineering to accelerate detection and response.
  • Build and refine detections and defense strategies based on threat models and attacker behaviors across cloud, identity, endpoint, and product telemetry, using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to map adversary tactics and enhance detection coverage.
  • Provide guidance to engineering and business teams on secure design and incident handling standards and contribute to security policies, standards, and metrics to continuously improve NVIDIA’s security posture.

What We Need To See

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in incident response and threat hunting, including cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud security principles, identity and access management, and workload protection.
  • Experience with product security investigations, vulnerability analysis, and secure coding practices.
  • Proficiency in forensic analysis, intrusion detection, and threat intelligence.
  • Advanced knowledge of network analysis, OS internals (Windows/Linux/macOS), and web application security, including the ability to detect abnormal behaviors and assess exploit paths.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across global teams.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, CISSP.
  • Experience with cloud-native security tools (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, Azure Sentinel, GCP Security Command Center).
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or similar for building security automation.
  • Hands-on experience with container security (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipeline , and AI security.
  • Advanced knowledge of digital forensics and malware reverse engineering.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Summary

 Position Summary

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design and technology as we partner with clients to transform their security posture.

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Serving as a primary point of contact for client stakeholders and supporting security automation strategy and value realization
  • Designing, developing, and managing SOAR playbooks for triage, enrichment, investigation, containment, escalation, and remediation
  • Leading integrations across security platforms, including security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity and access management (IAM), threat intelligence, ticketing, firewall, email, cloud, and endpoint security tools
  • Building and optimizing AI-augmented SOAR workflows, including alert triage, contextual enrichment, incident summarization, escalation logic, and governed decisioning
  • Defining automation metrics, dashboards, technical documentation, and workflow improvements to enhance reliability, scalability, and security operations maturity

The team

Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR).

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, SOAR engineering, security automation, or security operations
  • Experience with SOAR platforms such as Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Swimlane, IBM Resilient, or Tines
  • Experience with security operations center processes, security information and event management (SIEM) workflows, and incident response lifecycle activities
  • Experience integrating application programming interfaces (APIs), webhooks, and third-party security technologies into automated workflows
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, REST APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies
  • Experience designing AI-augmented SOAR workflows that include large language model (LLM)-based reasoning, prompt engineering, output validation, and human-in-the-loop decisioning
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, or Information Technology

Preferred:

  • Experience with multi-cloud security environments across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, detection engineering, and incident response practices
  • Experience with information technology service management (ITSM) or case management tools such as ServiceNow or Jira
  • Relevant certifications in cybersecurity, cloud security, or SOAR or SIEM platforms
  • Experience with AI-assisted playbook generation, machine learning-based alert triage, or automated incident summarization in enterprise SOAR platforms
  • Experience architecting Claude-based or equivalent agentic security operations center capabilities, including tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), extended reasoning, or structured outputs

Summary

 Position Summary

Join the Cyber Incident Response & Forensics team at Deloitte as a Senior Consultant supporting organizations through complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders while helping lead rapid-response incident management, forensic analysis, and threat hunting activities. This position requires sound judgment, immediate responsiveness during active incidents, and the ability to work independently in high-pressure situations.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Incident Response team, you will be responsible for…

  • Lead incident response activities for malware, ransomware, data breach, and insider threat investigations across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments
  • Perform triage, containment, and forensic analysis across endpoints, networks, cloud environments, and identity infrastructure, including Windows, Linux, and macOS systems
  • Conduct threat hunting, log analysis, malware analysis, and investigation activities across security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, and network security platforms
  • Document incident timelines, indicators of compromise, attack methodologies, findings, and remediation actions, and prepare post-incident reports and reviews
  • Serve as a technical advisor to client stakeholders during active incidents, support tabletop exercises and incident response planning, and contribute to internal playbooks and knowledge assets

The team

Deloitte’s Cyber Incident Response team helps organizations investigate, contain, and recover from complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. The team supports clients through forensic analysis, threat hunting, incident management, and recovery planning during high-impact events. Professionals in this practice work across industries to strengthen incident response readiness, improve detection and response capabilities, and reduce the impact of future attacks.

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Shift Timings: Based on client / project needs

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a comparable technical field, or equivalent experience
  • 6-10 years of cybersecurity experience, including at least 2+ years of incident response experience
  • Experience responding to ransomware, business email compromise, or advanced persistent threat incidents
  • Experience supporting enterprise clients in a consulting environment
  • Experience with security information and event management platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or Chronicle
  • Experience with forensic tools such as Magnet Axiom, EnCase, FTK, Volatility, X-Ways, or Autopsy
  • Experience with endpoint detection and response or extended detection and response platforms, network analysis tools, threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK or STIX/TAXII, scripting in Python, PowerShell, or Bash, and Active Directory attack techniques

Preferred:

  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
  • GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Splunk Engineer with expertise in Splunk platform administration, cloud technologies, networking, DevOps practices, and scripting. This role is responsible for developing, deploying, and maintaining Splunk solutions across enterprise environments to support operational intelligence, security, and compliance needs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain Splunk infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Create custom Splunk dashboards, alerts, and reports tailored to business and operational needs.
  • Integrate Splunk with various data sources, including applications, servers, network devices, and cloud services.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement monitoring and alerting for CI/CD pipelines and microservices.
  • Develop and maintain scripts (Python, Shell, PowerShell, etc.) for automation, data parsing, and onboarding.
  • Optimize Splunk performance and indexer/search head clustering.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to data ingestion, parsing, and visualization.
  • Implement role-based access control and maintain security compliance across Splunk environments.
  • Support network visibility and threat detection use cases using Splunk and third-party integrations.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Splunk (Enterprise, ES, ITSI, or Observability Suite).
  • Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience deploying Splunk in cloud environments.
  • Strong foundation in networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, Firewall, Load Balancers, etc.).
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.).
  • Experience with SPL.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Experience onboarding structured and unstructured data from various sources.
  • Familiarity with log formats and data parsing (JSON, XML, syslog, etc.).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Splunk Certifications (e.g., Splunk Core Consultant Certified or Architect).
  • Experience with SIEM use cases and security event monitoring.
  • Exposure to machine learning and anomaly detection using Splunk.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating third-party applications with Splunk.

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

The CyberOps Engineer is responsible for the design, deployment, operation, and continuous optimization of enterprise security platforms that support threat detection, response, and vulnerability management. This role serves as a technical authority for CrowdStrike, secondary resource for Tenable, and Stellar Cyber, ensuring these platforms are correctly integrated, tuned, and delivering high-fidelity security outcomes.

The position works closely with CyberOps analysts, incident responders, and security leadership to translate business and risk requirements into scalable, reliable security platform capabilities.

What You'll Do

CyberOps Platform Ownership

  • Own the configuration, health, and ongoing optimization of CrowdStrike Falcon and other CrowdStrike product lines.
  • Ensure platform availability, data integrity, and correct telemetry ingestion across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity sources.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex platform issues impacting detection, response, or vulnerability workflows.
  • Be a secondary resource for Tenable and Stellar Cyber platforms.

Threat Detection & Response Enablement

  • Optimize CrowdStrike policies, prevention settings, and detections to balance protection and operational impact
  • Support incident investigations by providing deep platform expertise and advanced telemetry analysis

Platform Integration & Automation

  • Integrate security platforms with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and reporting systems
  • Support API-based integrations and automation to improve operational efficiency
  • Validate and onboard new client installations log sources.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and maintain platform standards, runbooks, and operational documentation
  • Identify gaps in telemetry, coverage, or detection logic and drive improvements
  • Stay current with platform feature releases and recommend enhancements aligned to threat trends

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3 to 5 years of relevant cyber engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience administering CrowdStrike Falcon
  • Scripting or automation experience (PowerShell, Python, APIs)
  • Strong understanding of endpoint, network, identity, and cloud security telemetry
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and incident response workflows

Preferred

  • Experience with additional security platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, EDR, or NDR
  • Hands-on experience with Tenable (Tenable.io, Nessus)
  • Hands-on experience with Stellar Cyber
  • Cloud security experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Relevant security certifications (CrowdStrike, Tenable, GIAC, or equivalent)

What Success Looks Like

  • Security platforms are stable, fully integrated, and delivering high-quality detections
  • CyberOps analysts receive actionable alerts with reduced noise
  • Vulnerability data is accurate, prioritized, and trusted by stakeholders
  • Leadership has confidence in platform coverage and security visibility

Work Environment + Benefits

Benefits

Netrio offers a hybrid work environment, prioritizing work-life balance, continuous learning, and a supportive team culture. We invest in our people by providing comprehensive benefits, including:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Wellness programs and professional development opportunities.

About Netrio

Netrio is a leading MSP in North America, specializing in IT solutions for small- to mid-market enterprises. We serve over 1,000 clients across industries with services including managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, connectivity, voice, and custom application development.

descriptionHtml:
Job Purpose

Responsible for supporting the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise cybersecurity controls to protect the organization's applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, networks, and information assets. Conducts security architecture reviews, evaluates identity and access management controls, administers network and endpoint security technologies, performs third-party and cloud security assessments, and supports threat monitoring, incident response, and compliance activities. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to embed security-by-design principles into projects, strengthen the organization's security posture, ensure regulatory and policy compliance, and support the secure delivery of business and technology initiatives.

Key Result Responsibilities

  • Conduct security architecture reviews for new applications, SaaS platforms, APIs, cloud services, integrations, and infrastructure changes.
  • Review application data flows, authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, secrets management, retention, and third-party integrations.
  • Assess security controls including SSO, MFA, RBAC, API security, WAF protection, session management, data masking, and audit logging.
  • Provide security approvals, remediation requirements, and risk-based recommendations.
  • Embed security-by-design principles and threat modeling into project and change processes.
  • Review Microsoft Entra ID application registrations, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, Microsoft Graph API permissions, and service accounts.
  • Review privileged access, service accounts, application secrets, conditional access, MFA, and role-based access controls.
  • Enforce least-privilege and periodic access recertification across privileged and service identities.
  • Manage and maintain enterprise firewalls, VPNs, SD-WAN, routing, NAT, web filtering, application control, and IPsec tunnels.
  • Perform firewall health checks, firmware upgrades, rule reviews, policy optimization, and security hardening.
  • Troubleshoot firewall, VPN, routing, DNS, certificate, and connectivity-related issues.
  • Manage and support WAF platforms such as Cloudflare WAF, HAProxy WAF, FortiWeb, or similar technologies.
  • Tune WAF rules, custom signatures, rate limiting, and bot mitigation to protect public-facing applications.
  • Support SSL/TLS certificate purchase, deployment, renewal, and troubleshooting.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued

  • Administer and improve Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Attack Surface Reduction rules, exclusions, indicators, and endpoint security policies.
  • Tune anti-phishing, anti-spoofing, and anti-malware policies, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC alignment. [added]
  • Investigate endpoint, email, firewall, WAF, SIEM, and cloud security alerts.
  • Support security incident investigations and coordinate containment and remediation activities.
  • Contribute to threat hunting and align detection with MITRE ATT&CK where applicable.
  • Assess SaaS solutions, cloud platforms, AI tools, browser extensions, APIs, and other third-party services.
  • Review supplier security documentation including SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 certifications, data-processing agreements, privacy documents, incident response procedures, and business continuity arrangements.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing security documentation, access-control evidence, firewall review records, and remediation updates.
  • Maintain documentation for security approvals, exceptions, risk acceptances, architecture decisions, and security assessments.
  • Support cybersecurity projects including firewall upgrades, new site deployments, WAF migrations, SIEM integrations, endpoint protection, cloud security, and identity security improvements.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, business owners, suppliers, and security vendors to ensure timely closure of security actions.

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Fluent in English Language
  • Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written documentation and clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate across teams, suppliers, and vendors.
  • Scripting/automation skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for security tasks and integrations.
  • Proficient in MS Office.
  • Exposure to VAPT concepts and secure code review to inform architecture decisions.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and Microsoft Graph API permissions.
  • Detail-oriented, with a proactive and continuous-learning mindset for evolving threats.
  • Ability to work both independently and within cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards: ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP, and MITRE ATT&CK.

Work Experience

  • With 4-6 years of hands-on experience in security engineering, network security, or security architecture. Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SC-100 / SC-200, Security+, CCNP Security, Fortinet NSE, or PCNSE are preferred.
  • Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms and log correlation for threat detection.
  • Experience administering Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender for Office 365.
  • Practical experience with enterprise firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, FortiGate, Cisco), VPNs, SD-WAN, routing, and NAT.
  • Experience with WAF platforms (Cloudflare, HAProxy, FortiWeb, or similar).
  • Experience assessing third-party and SaaS security (SOC 2, ISO 27001, DPAs).

  • Conduct security architecture reviews for new applications, SaaS platforms, APIs, cloud services, integrations, and infrastructure changes.
  • Review application data flows, authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, secrets management, retention, and third-party integrations.
  • Assess security controls including SSO, MFA, RBAC, API security, WAF protection, session management, data masking, and audit logging.
  • Provide security approvals, remediation requirements, and risk-based recommendations.
  • Embed security-by-design principles and threat modeling into project and change processes.
  • Review Microsoft Entra ID application registrations, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, Microsoft Graph API permissions, and service accounts.
  • Review privileged access, service accounts, application secrets, conditional access, MFA, and role-based access controls.
  • Enforce least-privilege and periodic access recertification across privileged and service identities.
  • Manage and maintain enterprise firewalls, VPNs, SD-WAN, routing, NAT, web filtering, application control, and IPsec tunnels.
  • Perform firewall health checks, firmware upgrades, rule reviews, policy optimization, and security hardening.
  • Troubleshoot firewall, VPN, routing, DNS, certificate, and connectivity-related issues.
  • Manage and support WAF platforms such as Cloudflare WAF, HAProxy WAF, FortiWeb, or similar technologies.
  • Tune WAF rules, custom signatures, rate limiting, and bot mitigation to protect public-facing applications.
  • Support SSL/TLS certificate purchase, deployment, renewal, and troubleshooting.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued

  • Administer and improve Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Attack Surface Reduction rules, exclusions, indicators, and endpoint security policies.
  • Tune anti-phishing, anti-spoofing, and anti-malware policies, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC alignment. [added]
  • Investigate endpoint, email, firewall, WAF, SIEM, and cloud security alerts.
  • Support security incident investigations and coordinate containment and remediation activities.
  • Contribute to threat hunting and align detection with MITRE ATT&CK where applicable.
  • Assess SaaS solutions, cloud platforms, AI tools, browser extensions, APIs, and other third-party services.
  • Review supplier security documentation including SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 certifications, data-processing agreements, privacy documents, incident response procedures, and business continuity arrangements.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing security documentation, access-control evidence, firewall review records, and remediation updates.
  • Maintain documentation for security approvals, exceptions, risk acceptances, architecture decisions, and security assessments.
  • Support cybersecurity projects including firewall upgrades, new site deployments, WAF migrations, SIEM integrations, endpoint protection, cloud security, and identity security improvements.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, business owners, suppliers, and security vendors to ensure timely closure of security actions.

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Fluent in English Language
  • Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written documentation and clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate across teams, suppliers, and vendors.
  • Scripting/automation skills (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for security tasks and integrations.
  • Proficient in MS Office.
  • Exposure to VAPT concepts and secure code review to inform architecture decisions.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and Microsoft Graph API permissions.
  • Detail-oriented, with a proactive and continuous-learning mindset for evolving threats.
  • Ability to work both independently and within cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards: ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP, and MITRE ATT&CK.

Work Experience

  • With 4-6 years of hands-on experience in security engineering, network security, or security architecture. Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SC-100 / SC-200, Security+, CCNP Security, Fortinet NSE, or PCNSE are preferred.
  • Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms and log correlation for threat detection.
  • Experience administering Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender for Office 365.
  • Practical experience with enterprise firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, FortiGate, Cisco), VPNs, SD-WAN, routing, and NAT.
  • Experience with WAF platforms (Cloudflare, HAProxy, FortiWeb, or similar).
  • Experience assessing third-party and SaaS security (SOC 2, ISO 27001, DPAs).

title: Sr Cloud Security Engineer
description: The Sr. Cloud Security Engineer plays a critical role within Entrata’s cybersecurity organization. This position is responsible for identifying and mitigating security threats, architecting cloud security solutions, and responding to security incidents across Entrata’s cloud environments. The engineer collaborates cross-functionally with CloudOps, IT, and Security Operations teams to support scalable, secure, and compliant cloud infrastructure. This role requires advanced technical acumen, independent judgment, and the ability to drive security initiatives that align with company objectives and best practices.ResponsibilitiesCollaborates with cross-functional engineering teams to maintain and enhance secure, scalable, and PCI-compliant cloud and Kubernetes environments. Leads incident investigations and vulnerability management efforts, delivering tactical solutions and long-term strategic improvements. Partners with application and security operations teams to refine telemetry data and drive actionable insights to strengthen Entrata’s security posture. Evaluates complex security problems, develops creative solutions, and recommends new policies or tools in alignment with business goals. Drives security uplift projects and participates in the development of automated security frameworks using infrastructure-as-code. Mentors junior team members and contributes thought leadership across the security domain. Independently perform threat analysis, incident response, and remediation activities. Architect and implement cloud security infrastructure and automation solutions. Lead security-related project work and drive cross-functional initiatives to completion. Apply expert-level knowledge of cloud platforms, especially AWS, to improve system security and performance. Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently. Maintain professional interaction with internal and external stakeholders Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-stress environment Minimum QualificationsAdvanced proficiency with cloud service providers, including AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Azure. Strong experience with tools and practices in DevOps/DevSecOps, including Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud-native security solutions. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex security incidents and apply secure design principles in cloud environments. Proficient in scripting or programming languages such as Bash, Python, or PowerShell. Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills; experience working in Jira-based environments. Deep knowledge of cloud security concepts including identity management, encryption, authentication, and regulatory compliance (ISO, SOC, NIST). Education And Experience RequirementsBachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field. Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, or Security Engineering roles. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (required); additional certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, Terraform Associate, or SysOps Administrator are preferred. Proven experience designing and operating secure cloud infrastructure at scale in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. AI & Operational FluencyAI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables. Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop," by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations. Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models. Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

This role requires advanced technical acumen, independent judgment, and the ability to drive security initiatives that align with company objectives and best practices.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborates with cross-functional engineering teams to maintain and enhance secure, scalable, and PCI-compliant cloud and Kubernetes environments.
  • Leads incident investigations and vulnerability management efforts, delivering tactical solutions and long-term strategic improvements.
  • Partners with application and security operations teams to refine telemetry data and drive actionable insights to strengthen Entrata’s security posture.
  • Evaluates complex security problems, develops creative solutions, and recommends new policies or tools in alignment with business goals.
  • Drives security uplift projects and participates in the development of automated security frameworks using infrastructure-as-code.
  • Mentors junior team members and contributes thought leadership across the security domain.
  • Independently perform threat analysis, incident response, and remediation activities.
  • Architect and implement cloud security infrastructure and automation solutions.
  • Lead security-related project work and drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.
  • Apply expert-level knowledge of cloud platforms, especially AWS, to improve system security and performance.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently.
  • Maintain professional interaction with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-stress environment


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced proficiency with cloud service providers, including AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Azure.
  • Strong experience with tools and practices in DevOps/DevSecOps, including Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud-native security solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex security incidents and apply secure design principles in cloud environments.
  • Proficient in scripting or programming languages such as Bash, Python, or PowerShell.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills; experience working in Jira-based environments.
  • Deep knowledge of cloud security concepts including identity management, encryption, authentication, and regulatory compliance (ISO, SOC, NIST).


Education And Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, or Security Engineering roles.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (required); additional certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, Terraform Associate, or SysOps Administrator are preferred.
  • Proven experience designing and operating secure cloud infrastructure at scale in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.


AI & Operational Fluency

  • AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables.
  • Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop," by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.
  • Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.
  • Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.

Make an impact with NTT DATA

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA

The Senior Security Technical Services (TS) Systems Integration Specialist / Technical Lead is an advanced subject matter expert who is involved in highly complex environments for installation, integration, deployment, configuration and fault management.

This role is able to compile technical specifications in a clear, concise, unambiguous manner to explain the advantages and disadvantages of options leading to the final solution and are able to create alternative solutions as backup planning.

This role works towards expert level certification, whilst at the same time developing business knowledge.

Key responsibilities:

  • Interacts with clients on site and remote to meet more complex requirements of a solution.
  • Escalates unresolved problems and issues to the relevant third parties.
  • Delegates lower complexity tasks to engineers and technicians.
  • Assumes responsibility for the coordination of the activities of the engineers, in line with performance targets, leading by example and monitoring the quality of engineer's and technician's work when required.
  • Writes reports and proposals and completes and maintains project documentation.
  • Assists with the documentation of standard operating procedures relating to installations and fixes.
  • Acts as coach and mentor to more junior Implementation Engineers and Technicians.
  • Assumes responsibility for the coordination of the activities of the Engineers, in line with performance targets.
  • May be required to serve periodically on the customer service desk, providing third line telephonic, remote and on-site support and problem management.
  • Included in complex design work, with input to the design expected.
  • Expected to take ownership of relevant technologies according to domain or specialization.
  • Engages vendors for priority escalations or bugs found during deployments.
  • Performs any other related task as required.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:

  • Advanced understanding and appreciation of technical design and business principles.
  • Advanced project fundamental and administration ability.
  • Advanced project fundamentals which are demonstrated in the execution of installations and other assignments.
  • Advanced customer engagement skills.
  • Advanced relevant domain specialist knowledge.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills.
  • Client focused and displays a proactive approach to solving problems.
  • Advanced ability to coach, mentor and provide guidance to team members.
  • Ability to take ownership as technical lead during project lifecycle.

Academic qualifications and certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computing or related field.
  • Vendor certification is mandatory.
  • Azure Certified Solutions Architect / PCNSE / FCE / CCNP Security / CISSP / Automation certifications or equivalent preferred.
  • Cloud Security certifications and certifications like AZ-500, SC-200, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM or similar Certification in different networking technologies such as CCIE / CCDP Security, JNCIA, ACCA, PCNSE, PCNSC, FCE, CCSA, ITIL, Azure Security Engineer, Azure Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure Certified Network Engineer, Azure Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator Associate, will be an advantage.
  • Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role) - Terraform, Azure, Sentinel, EDR Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Security, Devops Ci/CD Pipelins, Azure Governance (Defender for Cloud, Azure Policies, Secure Score and Compliance), Version Control (Git), Microservices (Kubernetes, Azure Containers), Azure / AWS/ GCP Infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Azure Infrastructure as Code, Azure Administration, Hybrid Cloud, Networking (Firewalls, LAN, VPN), Automation, MS Office365, Power BI Administration, Scripting (PowerShell), ZTNA.

Required experience:

  • Advanced experience in SOC Analysis Operations.
  • Advanced experience in SIEM usage for investigations.
  • Advanced experience in Azure or AWS or GCP.
  • Advanced experience in Security technologies like Firewall, IPS, IDS , Proxy etc.
  • Advanced experience in technical support to clients.
  • Advanced experience in handling security incidents end to end.
  • Advanced experience in configuring/managing security controls, such as SIEM, Firewall, IDS/IPS, EDR, NDR, UTM, Proxy, SOAR, Honeypots, decoys, and other security tools.
  • Advanced experience in log collection mechanism such as Syslog, Log file, DB API.
  • Advanced experience in configuring/managing security controls, such as SIEM, Firewall, IDS/IPS, EDR, NDR, UTM, Proxy, SOAR, Honeypots, and other security tools.
  • Advanced experience in web service protocols and frameworks for high-availability, low-latency, resiliency, and auto-scaling.
  • Advanced experience in sound practices on securing data and systems by applying appropriate authentication and authorization controls.
  • Advanced experience in Event Driven Development and asynchronous operations.
  • Advanced experience in scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Ruby, and experience with automation tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

descriptionHtml:
About Armor Defense Inc

At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.

Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.

Learn more at: https://www.armor.com

Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our infrastructure team with expertise across Cloud Deployments, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, Office 365, Zerto, Rubrik, VMware, and NSX-T. This hands-on, automation-heavy role focuses on system reliability, scalability, and proactive problem prevention. You will be responsible for building and maintaining resilient infrastructure, automating repetitive tasks, monitoring, and improving

performance, and driving incident reduction strategies across hybrid cloud environments.

This role operates in a hybrid structure with on-site presence four days a week, specifically Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, based in Pune, India.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)

  • Administer and maintain Microsoft Entra ID and on-prem Active Directory environments.
  • Implement conditional access, MFA, and identity protection policies per defined security standards.
  • Deploy, patch, and maintain VMware vSphere environments.
  • Administer Office 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Intune.
  • Write PowerShell/Python scripts to automate operational tasks and health checks.
  • Maintain monitoring dashboards and alerts using Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent.
  • Operate Zerto replication and Rubrik backups; remediate failures and validate restore points.
  • Execute DR tests and document results against defined RTO/RPO targets.
  • Apply infrastructure changes using existing Terraform modules and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and perform first-line incident troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis and postmortems; implement assigned remediation actions.
  • Execute the automated vulnerability patch management cycle.
  • Maintain runbooks and operational documentation.

Required Skills

  • 3–5 years administering Windows-based production environments in an SRE, systems, or infrastructure engineering role.
  • Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter administration.
  • Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and on-prem Active Directory, including conditional access and MFA policies.
  • Scripting in PowerShell or Python to automate operational tasks.
  • Experience operating monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, firewalls, load balancing, VLANs.
  • Experience participating in on-call rotations and incident response.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to NSX-T or other software-defined networking.
  • Hands-on experience with Zerto replication and Rubrik backup platforms.
  • Familiarity with Terraform or Ansible (using existing modules/playbooks).
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent).
  • Exposure to AWS or Azure environments.
  • Linux/Unix administration experience.
  • Basic understanding of RTO/RPO and DR testing.
  • Awareness of security and compliance frameworks (PCI, HIPAA, ISO).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills in hybrid environments.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

WHY ARMOR

Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.

ARMOR CORE VALUES

  • Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges.
  • Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency + honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.
  • Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.
  • Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.
  • Follow-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.

This person will be required to build solutions for configuration and vulnerability data sources, gather and normalize assessment data, analyze security posture gaps, assess risk criticality, and automate remediation workflows. Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure Security, you play a crucial role in helping client IT and business executives comprehend Cloud & Infrastructure Security challenges, risks, and vulnerabilities. You apply security and zero trust principles and in-depth knowledge of secure infrastructure and applications of hybrid cloud to develop tailored solutions for clients.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Conduct Client Assessments: Conduct interviews, workshops, and assessments to identify potential security issues and provide consulting services to analyze and resolve security incidents.
  • Develop Security Strategies: Develop infrastructure security strategy, programs, incident response plans, and remediation recommendations and roadmaps tailored to the client's business needs.
  • Analyze Security Incidents: Apply security and zero trust principles to analyze security incidents and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Provide Consulting Services: Deliver consulting services to help clients achieve a superior security posture and effectively manage security incidents.
  • Design Remediation Plans: Create remediation recommendations and roadmaps to address identified security vulnerabilities and incidents.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Exposure to Cloud Security: Familiarity with cloud security challenges, risks, and vulnerabilities, including experience working with hybrid cloud infrastructure and applications.
  • Secure Infrastructure Knowledge: Understanding of secure infrastructure principles, including zero trust architecture and its applications in hybrid cloud environments.
  • Incident Response Experience: Exposure to analyzing and resolving security incidents, including developing incident response plans and remediation recommendations.
  • Security Consulting Skills: Experience providing consulting services to help clients improve their security posture and manage security incidents.

About The Role:

We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.

Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime for apps built by our Foundry Module and is 'dogfooded' internally to automate workflows and accelerate development. Processing anywhere from 500M to 10B+ events per day, it is utilized by essentially every customer of the Falcon Platform.

This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability, and scalability will be key ingredients to your success at CrowdStrike.

What You'll Do:

  • Build production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to core platform services powering connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
  • You'll own connectors end-to-end—from API research through deployment and production support—while improving underlying platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines).
  • Research, evaluate, and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio.
  • Develop both connectors and platform services working with complex authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys).
  • Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to ensure connector quality and reliability across multi-region deployments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, taking operational ownership across our fleet of Falcon environments.
  • Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks.

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining software systems across all phases of the development lifecycle, preferably in a SaaS model.
  • Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably Python or Go.
  • Proven expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, and REST APIs.
  • Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Hands-on experience in large-scale system architecture, high scalability, availability, and optimization.
  • Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills with a track record of working collaboratively across stakeholders.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with commercial cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Contributions to open-source communities.
  • Hands-on Golang experience.
  • Prior experience with (cybersecurity) platforms or integrations.

Benefits Of Working At CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

descriptionHtml:
about searce


Searce is an AI outcome engineering company and a modern technology consultancy that helps enterprises futurify their business with AI, cloud and data. Founded in 2004, we are 1,300+ Searcians across 12 countries, with deep business process expertise, a Google Cloud Global MSP status and compliance credentials including PCI DSS and ISO 27001. We solve with our proprietary evlos™ problem-solving methodology: no bureaucratic fluff, working prototypes fast, and production scale that holds.


about ATRE


ATRE is Searce's AI Trust & Resilience Engineering practice: the managed-service team that keeps customers' cloud and AI estates secure, reliable and resilient 24x7. We are building it AI-first. Every engineer is expected to use AI tools and AIOps to raise efficiency, cut toil and shorten recovery time.


role overview


As a Lead Engineer you own SOAR automation end to end, from playbook design to CI/CD deployment. You turn manual SOC response into modular, version-controlled automation that the customer’s security team can rely on.


what you'll do


Playbook design: Build complex playbooks of up to about 50 steps, with loops, parallel flows and async execution.


Reusable blocks: Engineer modular playbook blocks of up to about 20 steps to speed up future builds.

Environment governance: Set up logging, tenant-level RBAC and secrets across Dev, Test and Staging.

Python logic: Write custom logical operators and transformation functions for complex decision branches.

Integrations: Build API connectors to Jira, Google Workspace and other platforms, aligned to the customer’s existing code architecture.

Response-as-Code: Build Terraform and Python modules to deploy playbooks, parsers and dashboards.

CI/CD: Run a repeatable pipeline for version-controlled security content.

what you bring


SOAR depth: Expert-level, hands-on Google SecOps SOAR (Chronicle/Siemplify) playbook delivery.


Python: Advanced Python for security automation and API integrations.

Response-as-Code: Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD for security content.

Environment setup: Experience with multi-environment SOAR setup (RBAC, secrets, logging).

Work mode: Comfortable working from the office.

good to have


Google Cloud Professional Security Engineer or SecOps certifications


Chronicle SIEM / YARA-L detection engineering

MSSP or MSP experience

why searce


Solver mindset: We hire solvers, not task-takers. You will be trusted to own problems end to end.


Not a CAVEr, say no to HiPPO: We are not Citizens Against Virtually Everything, and the best idea wins over the highest-paid person's opinion.

AI-native practice: ATRE is built around AI tools and AIOps from day one, so you build the future of managed services rather than inherit the past.

Learning and growth: Partner-led certifications and exposure to Google Cloud, AWS, Databricks and Anthropic Claude ecosystems.

Culture: HAPPIER values (humble, adaptable, positive, passionate, innovative, excellence, responsible).

descriptionHtml:
Position Summary

Clearwater is seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Microsoft 365 and Azure Cloud Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Microsoft 365 Configuration and Management and significant experience with Azure operational tools such as Entra ID and Intune. As an Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and maintaining our client’s M365 and Azure-based infrastructure, ensuring its reliability, security, and scalability.

Specific Job Responsibilities

M365 and Azure Client Operations Management:

  • Microsoft Entra ID — day-to-day identity management: Conditional Access policies, SSPR, PIM (Privileged Identity Management), directory sync (Entra Connect / Cloud Sync), B2B/B2C configurations, app registrations, enterprise app management
  • Microsoft Intune — device enrollment (BYOD + corporate), compliance policies, configuration profiles, app deployment, co-management with SCCM if applicable, Autopilot
  • Microsoft Purview — data classification, sensitivity labels, DLP policies, insider risk management, communication compliance, audit log review
  • Exchange Online — mail flow rules, connectors, hybrid config, anti-spam/anti-phishing policies (Defender for Office 365)
  • SharePoint Online & OneDrive — permissions governance, external sharing controls, tenant-level configuration
  • Microsoft Teams — policy management, governance (lifecycle, guest access, DLP integration)
  • Microsoft 365 Defender / Defender XDR — incident response integration, alert triage, threat hunting basics

Azure Operation Management

  • Azure IaaS/PaaS operations — Setup VMs, VNets, NSGs, storage accounts, Key Vault
  • Entra ID integration with Azure resources – Setup RBAC, managed identities, configure service principals
  • Azure Policy and Defender for Cloud – Perform and monitor compliance posture management
  • Hybrid connectivity — Setup ExpressRoute, VPN Gateways, Azure Arc
  • PowerShell / Microsoft Graph API — Enable Automation of both Azure and M365 workloads using Graph
  • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Sentinel

Infrastructure Optimization

  • Continuously monitor and optimize Azure resources to minimize costs while maximizing performance and efficiency.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities using PowerShell scripts, ARM templates, or other cloud-based automation tools.
  • Maintain cloud network configurations and network diagrams.

Security And Compliance

  • Familiarity with key Azure security tools such as Defender Suite, Sentinel and Purview
  • Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements within the Azure environment.
  • Manage access control and identity management within Azure Active Directory.

Documentation

  • Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps for Azure infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience working directly with M365 and Azure Client Operations Tools
  • At least 2 years of experience working with other Azure components
  • Preferred, at least 2 years of experience in cybersecurity.
  • One or more certifications in Microsoft Azure
  • Strong understanding of M365 services and including Intune and Mobile Device Management (MDM).
  • Administrative experience with multiple operating systems, including Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and iPhone OS.
  • Familiarity with networking concepts, including VPNs, firewalls, and DNS.
  • Experience with virtual machines, storage, networking, security, and database services.
  • Background with Active Directory Services, including DNS, DHCP, and DFS.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain cloud network configurations and network diagrams.
  • Proficiency in scripting or automation (e.g., PowerShell, CLI).
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently or in a team.
  • Flexible schedule to accommodate client service hours.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

Work Environment

  • Currently, Clearwater is a "virtual" company, and all colleagues work remotely.
  • Travel is required, estimated at less than 10% of the time.
  • Colleagues are expected to provide their computer, printer/scanner, computer audio capability, cell phone, internet service, and Microsoft Office software.
  • The company provides subscriptions to various tools, including Microsoft Online Services, Salesforce.com, Encryption tools, data backup and others selected as standard by the company.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary
  • Participation in the company's medical/RX, disability, life/ADD insurance, and 401K benefit programs.
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) vacation policy.

Join our dynamic team and help us maintain a secure, efficient, and highly available Azure infrastructure that supports our organization's growth and innovation. If you are a passionate Azure Infrastructure Engineer with a strong skill set in Azure Virtual Desktop, MDM Intune, Azure Backup, and PowerShell, along with expertise in cloud computing and cybersecurity, we encourage you to apply.

description: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. and patch VM images and templates so issues do not return.Plan changes through change management with tested rollback steps, and work within maintenance windows to avoid outages.Re-scan to confirm closure, and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.Support incident response when an actively exploited vulnerability needs emergency patching.Reporting and Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Vulnerability assessment

  • Run authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability scans across Windows and Linux servers, virtual machines, cloud workloads, and network devices.
  • Validate findings manually to remove false positives before they reach a remediation queue.
  • Review configurations against CIS Benchmarks and internal hardening standards.
  • Assess cloud security posture in AWS and Azure: IAM, security groups and NSGs, storage exposure, and public endpoints.
  • Maintain accurate asset inventory and scan coverage, and flag unmanaged or unscanned assets.
  • Prioritise findings by exploitability, asset criticality, and exposure, using CVSS, EPSS, and the CISA KEV catalogue.
  • Agree remediation timelines with asset owners and document exceptions with compensating controls.

Remediation and patching

  • Apply operating system and third-party patches on Windows (WSUS, SCCM/MECM, Intune) and Linux (yum/dnf, apt, Ansible).
  • Harden servers: disable weak protocols and ciphers, remove insecure services, fix permissions, and enforce secure baselines through Group Policy and configuration management.
  • Fix network findings: firewall rule clean-up, switch and router hardening, TLS and SSH configuration, and segmentation gaps.
  • Remediate cloud misconfigurations, and patch VM images and templates so issues do not return.
  • Plan changes through change management with tested rollback steps, and work within maintenance windows to avoid outages.
  • Re-scan to confirm closure, and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.
  • Support incident response when an actively exploited vulnerability needs emergency patching.

Reporting and communication

  • Report open risk, finding age, and SLA compliance to security leadership and business unit owners.
  • Record remediation evidence for audits such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and PCI DSS where in scope.
  • Write runbooks and automation scripts so business unit teams can repeat fixes on their own.
  • Explain risk to system owners and non-technical stakeholders, and agree on realistic maintenance windows.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

Benefits

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.
Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

descriptionHtml:
Job Title

Security Automation Lead

Location

India (Pune)


Role Overview

FNZ is building a global Cyber Platform Engineering function responsible for the operation, reliability, and evolution of the firm’s core security platforms.

We are seeking a Cyber Security Platform Engineer to join the growing engineering capability in India. This is a hands-on technical role focused on operating and improving FNZ’s production cyber security platforms.

The successful candidate will help ensure FNZ’s security platforms remain reliable, well-configured, and continuously improving through engineering, automation, and operational excellence.

This role sits within Cyber Platform Engineering, not the Security Operations Centre (SOC). The focus is on engineering and operating security platforms, rather than monitoring alerts or performing SOC analysis.

You will work closely with global engineering teams across the UK, US, and APAC.


Core Responsibilities

Operate, maintain, and continuously improve FNZ’s production security platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.

The role combines hands-on platform operation with engineering improvements that enhance platform capability and reduce operational overhead.

Responsibilities include:

  • Configuring, operating, and optimising enterprise security platforms
  • Supporting platform upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management
  • Monitoring platform health, reliability, and performance
  • Troubleshooting operational issues across security platforms
  • Ensuring platforms operate in line with FNZ’s global security and operational standards
  • Assisting with automation of platform configuration and operational workflows
  • Supporting integrations between security platforms and internal systems
  • Writing scripts or tooling to improve operational efficiency
  • Supporting infrastructure automation or configuration improvements
  • Helping improve telemetry pipelines and data flows between security platforms

Engineers are expected to approach platform operations with an engineering mindset, identifying opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency over time

Incident Engineering Support

Provide engineering support during security incidents where platform expertise is required.

This includes:

  • Supporting incident response teams with platform troubleshooting
  • Assisting with root-cause analysis
  • Helping implement fixes and improvements following incidents

The focus is platform engineering support, not incident monitoring or SOC investigation.

Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement

Work with the wider engineering team to improve the maturity and reliability of FNZ’s security platform environment.

This includes:

  • Identifying recurring operational issues
  • Contributing to automation initiatives
  • Improving platform observability and operational metrics
  • Supporting adoption of new security tools and platform capabilities

Working Pattern

The team provides global coverage across shifts aligned with international operations.

Core hours will align with APAC and EMEA collaboration, with occasional out-of-hours work required during major incidents or platform maintenance windows.


Required Experience

Candidates should demonstrate hands-on experience operating enterprise security platforms.

Typical background includes:

  • 6+ years in cyber security engineering or platform engineering roles
  • Hands-on experience working with enterprise security platforms
  • Experience troubleshooting operational issues across security controls
  • Experience working within distributed global engineering teams


Technical Experience

Experience across several of the following security platform domains is expected:

  • Endpoint security platforms (EDR / XDR) such as CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne
  • Secure Web Gateway / Proxy platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, iBoss, Prisma Access
  • Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and application-layer protection platforms
  • Security logging and SIEM platforms
  • Email security platforms and secure email gateways
  • Vulnerability management platforms
  • Network security controls, including next-generation firewalls


Candidates should demonstrate experience operating, configuring, and supporting these platforms in production environments.

Engineering & Automation Experience

Experience in the following areas is beneficial:

  • scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar)
  • working with APIs for platform integrations
  • infrastructure automation or configuration management
  • operating security tooling in cloud environments


Nice to Have

Experience in the following areas would be beneficial:

  • infrastructure-as-code or DevOps practices
  • cloud security platform engineering
  • integrating security tooling within CI/CD pipelines
  • platform telemetry and observability tooling


What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

  • support the reliable operation of FNZ’s security platforms
  • contribute to engineering improvements and automation initiatives
  • help maintain platform performance and stability
  • collaborate effectively with global engineering teams
  • grow technical expertise across FNZ’s security platform ecosystem


Why This Role Matters

Security platforms form a critical part of FNZ’s global technology infrastructure.

The Cyber Platform Engineering team ensures these platforms remain:

  • reliable
  • scalable
  • well-engineered
  • continuously improving

This role contributes directly to maintaining the security and resilience of FNZ’s global environment.

Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.

Your Key Responsibilities

Key Resposibilities

  • Design and operate secure, scalable Entra ID tenants, including administrative units, RBAC, and security boundaries.
  • Architect Zero Trust and Conditional Access strategies, including risk-based and device-based access policies.
  • Design and maintain Entra App Registrations and Enterprise Applications across their entire lifecycle.
  • Implement SSO and federation using OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML across internal and third-party applications.
  • Define authentication and authorization flows, including passwordless, MFA, and modern credential strategies (FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business, Passkeys).
  • Design privileged access concepts using Entra PIM, role governance, and access reviews.
  • Implement Identity Governance (Entra ID Governance): access packages, entitlement management, lifecycle workflows, and certification.
  • Operate hybrid sync where required via Entra Connect / Cloud Sync, and drive migration toward cloud-native identity.
  • Configure and optimize Identity Protection, threat detection, and identity-attack defense.
  • Automate Entra ID via Microsoft Graph API, PowerShell, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep).
  • Drive security hardening: legacy authentication decommissioning, attack-surface reduction, and least-privilege enforcement.
  • Establish automated testing, monitoring, and compliance checks for identity policies and tenant configuration.
  • Build a monitoring and governance framework for Entra ID, including drift detection and policy compliance.
  • Document architectures and processes, and train internal teams on Entra ID, Zero Trust, and DevOps topics.
  • Act as a technical advisor to internal stakeholders and customers on cloud IAM topics.

Your Qualifications

Your Qualification

  • Fluent English is mandatory.
  • Academic degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of hands-on experience with Entra ID (Azure AD) in enterprise environments.
  • Strong expertise in Entra ID tenant management, app registrations, enterprise apps, and SSO/federation integrations.
  • Solid knowledge of Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and Entra ID security best practices.
  • Demonstrable experience with Entra ID Governance (PIM, access reviews, entitlement management).
  • Practical experience with modern authentication (OAuth, OIDC, SAML) and passwordless/MFA strategies.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Graph API, automation, and scripting (PowerShell).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code for identity (Terraform, Bicep) is a strong plus.
  • Experience managing and optimizing Azure and Microsoft 365 identity-related services.
  • Strong analytical skills, structured working style, and a security-first / Zero Trust mindset.
  • Ability to communicate complex identity concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.

Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
