About Armor Defense Inc

At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.

Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.

Learn more at: https://www.armor.com

Summary

Armor is seeking an Incident Response and Security Operations Technical Leader to serve as the senior technical authority for our managed security practice in Pune. This role operates at the practice level, cooperating with a US based peer, defining incident response methodology, leading detection strategy, shaping the expanded operational scope of the SOC, and driving the highest-impact customer engagements. The Technical leaders actively leads strategic projects to operationalize new customer-facing capabilities across vulnerability management, control validation, data security, and security technology, and policy management. As the technical apex of the Incident Response and Security Operations (SOC) organization, this role mentors the entire team, influences cross-functional roadmaps, and represents Armor's security expertise to customers, partners, and industry forums.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Additional duties may be assigned as required.

  • Define and continuously evolve incident response methodology, detection strategies, and consultation frameworks across the practice.
  • Lead strategic customer engagements requiring senior technical consultation on incident response, threat landscape, and security architecture.
  • Actively lead the most complex and highest-impact projects to operationalize new customer-facing SOC capabilities; set delivery standards across the practice.
  • Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for the most complex triage or incident investigations requiring advanced forensic analysis or threat research.
  • Architect detection and response capabilities: SIEM optimization, SOAR workflow design, and threat detection use-case strategy.
  • Build agentic AI capabilities to automate operations and drive the level of effort of the team towards supporting higher value customer engagement and decision making.
  • Consult with customer executives on security strategy, risk posture, and program maturity.
  • Evaluate and recommend, considering build vs. buy modalities, emerging technologies including AI/ML-assisted detection, automated response, and cloud-native security capabilities.
  • Own the practice-level knowledge management strategy; ensure the SOC's collective knowledge is captured, current, and continuously enriched.
  • Define cross-functional handoff standards and escalation protocols between the SOC and Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams.
  • Mentor the entire security operations organization; technical talent development needs and build programs to address them at scale in cooperation with management.
  • Champion professional development across the practice; define certification roadmaps and create continuing education structures for all tiers.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to align service capabilities with customer needs and market direction.
  • Develop and deliver advanced training on analytical techniques, consultation skills, and emerging threats.
  • Represent Armor's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and industry forums.
  • Engage customers directly via video, phone, chat, and executive briefings; model the consultative standard for the entire team.

Required Skills

  • Expert-level incident response expertise, including detection engineering and security architecture.
  • Deep cloud security experience across Azure, AWS, and VMware, including cloud-native threat detection and response.
  • Hands-on expertise with security platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, QRadar, and other enterprise security tools.
  • Advanced threat hunting and forensic analysis skills with experience leading investigations into sophisticated cyber threats.
  • Strong scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, and KQL) for automation, detection engineering, and security tooling.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with agentic AI tools (Claude, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent) and AI/ML integration within security operations.
  • Experience with additional security technologies such as Microsoft Purview, F5 WAF, and ChaosSearch.
  • Expertise in vulnerability management, control validation, security technology management, and policy management.
  • Strategic vision for evolving a SOC from reactive incident response to a proactive security consultancy.
  • Strong leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Strong executive communication and customer consulting skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication, including incident reports, presentations, and customer deliverables.

Education And/Or Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in incident response, security consulting, or detection engineering with progressive technical leadership.
  • Required certifications within 12 months: AZ-500, SC-200, SC-300, SC-401
  • Certifications required: GCIH and GCFA, or equivalent.
  • Certifications preferred: CISSP, GREM, GNFA, OSCP.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field required; Master's preferred; equivalent experience accepted.
  • Sustained record of growing technical talent and advancing team capabilities through mentoring, training design, and continuing education.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

EY GDS – RCT

Staff – Python & Advanced SQL

Staff – Software Engineering

Experience: Strictly 2+ years

Eligibility requirement:

Candidates must have 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on cloud experience. Freshers, candidates with less than 2 years of experience, and candidates without cloud experience are not eligible for this role.

The opportunity

Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
  • Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
  • Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
  • Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
  • Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
  • Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
  • Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
  • Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
  • Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
  • Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.

Primary Skills – Must Have

  • Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
  • Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
  • Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
  • APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
  • Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
  • Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.

Good to have

  • Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
  • Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
  • Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
  • Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.

Financial Crime domain knowledge

  • KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
  • AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
  • Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
  • Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
  • Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

Experience And Education

  • Experience: Strictly 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
  • Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.
  • Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP is mandatory.
  • Domain experience: Relevant delivery experience in KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud is good to have.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

What Success Looks Like

  • Production-quality Python and SQL that is accurate, maintainable, secure, and efficient.
  • Clear understanding of the business purpose and regulatory context behind the solution being built.
  • Strong ownership of assigned deliverables, defects, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
  • Ability to explain technical findings and data issues clearly to both engineering and compliance stakeholders.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Title: DevSecOps Engineer

Department: DevOps / Platform Engineering

Reports To: Devops Lead

Position Overview

We are seeking a hands-on DevSecOps Engineer to embed security throughout our Azure-based SDLC, working within our existing DevOps toolchain and infrastructure. The role combines the platform and automation depth of our DevOps engineering practice with the security methodology defined by AZT's DPE Security function — Threat Modelling, SCA, SAST, DAST, IAST, CSPM and RASP.

This is a delivery-focused role. The immediate priority is standing up and operationalising Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) across our pipelines and environments, in parallel with ongoing responsibility for CI/CD, infrastructure automation and container platform support. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable scripting an Azure pipeline, tuning a Kubernetes deployment, and configuring a security scanning tool against a running application.

Key Responsibilities

  • DevSecOps Tooling & Pipeline Security — priority: DAST
  • Lead the rollout of Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST): select/configure tooling, integrate scanning into CI/CD, and establish scan cadence (manual, scheduled, and build-triggered).
  • Design DAST test coverage for AuthN/AuthZ flaws, session-management vulnerabilities, configuration issues and insecure workflows across web, API and microservice applications.
  • Own reporting and remediation workflows for DAST findings, working with development teams to prioritise and close out vulnerabilities.
  • Support and extend the wider DevSecOps pipeline: Threat Modelling / security architecture review, Software Configuration Analysis (SCA) and Static Application Security Testing (SAST) at build time.
  • Evaluate and pilot Interactive Application Security Testing (IAST) where suited to the application stack in use.
  • Contribute to Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) — monitoring Azure configuration, compliance and vulnerabilities — and to Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) for production workloads.
  • Act as a shared-responsibility partner alongside Development, Security and Operations: automate security checks in the pipeline, harden deployment configurations, and keep systems patched and up to date.
  • GitHub Enterprise & CI/CD
  • Administer and optimise GitHub Enterprise (or Azure DevOps) to support development teams; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / YAML pipelines) for build, test, security-scan and release stages.
  • Manage build agents (Linux and Windows), Git repositories, branching strategies (GitFlow / trunk-based) and Personal Access Token (PAT) governance.
  • Lead migration of source repositories from GitLab, Bitbucket, SVN and other platforms into GitHub Enterprise, ensuring data integrity, security and minimal downtime.
  • Implement security best practice within the GitHub Enterprise ecosystem (branch protection, secret scanning, access control).
  • Cloud Infrastructure (Azure)
  • Operate and improve Azure infrastructure: VMs/VMSS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Application Service Environment (ASE), Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, Storage (Blob/File), Data Factory.
  • Manage networking and security controls: VNETs, NSGs, Private Endpoints/Private Link, Application Gateway and WAF, Key Vault.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Crossplane, Terraform or ARM templates; use Packer for image creation and Ansible for configuration management.
  • Containers & Microservices
  • Manage AKS clusters, pod deployment and scaling, Helm charts, Istio service mesh, Flannel networking and ingress controllers.
  • Support containerisation practices (Docker) and container registries (Harbor, Amazon ECR, Azure ACR).
  • Automate deployment using Argo CD and integrate deployment automation with the broader CI/CD toolchain.
  • SDLC Toolchain & Binary Management
  • Manage binary repositories (Nexus) and support migration from legacy tools (e.g. Artifactory) as part of platform modernisation.
  • Work across the full SDLC toolchain cluster: build/package management, container registries, deployment automation and monitoring.
  • Scripting & Automation
  • Develop automation using Bash/Shell, PowerShell and Python (preferred) across Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell and REST APIs.
  • Build scripts and tooling to automate security checks, infrastructure changes and repetitive operational processes.
  • Databases
  • Support Azure SQL administration, performance tuning, backup/restore and on-premises-to-Azure migration.
  • Support NoSQL platforms — MongoDB (PaaS and VM-hosted) and Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Monitoring & Observability
  • Maintain dashboards and alerting in Dynatrace (primary platform), Grafana, Kibana (ELK), Azure Monitor/Log Analytics and Application Insights.
  • Support incident management, log analysis, troubleshooting and performance monitoring across environments.
  • Collaboration
  • Work in agile teams using Jira for issue tracking and Confluence for documentation; contribute to agile ceremonies and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with development, operations and security teams to understand needs, provide solutions, and troubleshoot toolchain issues.
  • Provide training and support on best practice within GitHub Enterprise and the wider DevSecOps toolchain.

DevSecOps Methodology — Practices Covered by This Role

The table below reflects AZT's DevSecOps approach: security integrated continuously across the SDLC rather than concentrated at the end. DAST is the current priority delivery focus.

Practice (SDLC Stage)

Scope & Focus

Threat Modelling (Plan / Design)

Identify threats against architecture components — user interfaces, data flows, data processes, data storage. Rate and prioritise remediation. Supported by AZT's global Threat Modelling service.

Software Configuration Analysis — SCA (Develop)

Detect vulnerabilities in open-source dependencies; produce SBOMs and check licence attribution/compliance. Typically bundled with SAST tooling (GHAS).

Static Application Security Testing — SAST (Build)

Analyse source code for vulnerabilities before runtime, without executing the application. Performed once code is feature-complete; earliest and cheapest point to fix defects (shift-left).

Dynamic Application Security Testing

Simulate real-world attacks against the running application: crafted requests, response analysis, and detection of AuthN/AuthZ flaws, session-management issues, misconfiguration and insecure workflows. This is a priority project for AZT Ireland and the primary near-term focus of this role.

Interactive Application Security Testing — IAST (Test)

Agent/sensor-based testing that combines SAST- and DAST-style visibility across code, data flow, requests/responses and configuration; traces exploitable vulnerabilities back to source. Suited to web, mobile, microservice and API-based applications; tool selection depends on the application stack in use.

Cloud Security Posture Management — CSPM (Release / Deploy)

Continuous monitoring of cloud configuration, compliance and vulnerabilities across cloud services and resources; unifies visibility across providers into a single console.

Runtime Application Self-Protection — RASP (Operate / Monitor)

Embedded security agents that monitor application behaviour and block attacks in real time at the application layer, complementing network-level controls.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • Proven DevOps/DevSecOps experience with a strong focus on the GitHub Enterprise ecosystem and CI/CD pipeline creation (GitHub Actions).
  • Hands-on experience with Azure infrastructure services listed above, and with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, or Crossplane).
  • Practical experience with at least one application security testing practice (SAST, DAST or IAST); willingness and ability to lead DAST implementation specifically.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (AKS), Helm and container registries (Nexus, Harbor, ECR or ACR).
  • Strong scripting ability (Python preferred; Bash/PowerShell) and comfort with Azure CLI/REST APIs.
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Grafana or the ELK stack.
  • Experience working in agile teams using Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong communication and cross-team collaboration skills, and sound understanding of security best practice and compliance standards.

Preferred

  • Certifications in DevOps and/or security-related fields.
  • Prior involvement in a DAST or broader application-security-testing rollout.
  • Experience with Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, and cloud-to-cloud or on-prem-to-cloud database migrations.
  • Experience with repository migration (GitLab, Bitbucket, SVN → GitHub Enterprise).
  • Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Runtime Application Self-Protection (RASP) tooling.

Good To Have

  • Having a basic understanding or exposure to AI tools would be a plus.
  • Familiarity with basic AI tools is considered an advantage.
  • Basic knowledge or experience with AI tools will be beneficial.
  • Exposure to AI tools, even at a basic level, is a value-add.A fundamental grasp of AI tools will be an added benefit.

Your benefits:We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroadWe believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location)From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fosteredFlexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach

What We Offer

About Allianz Technology

With its headquarters in Munich, Germany, Allianz Technology is Allianz's global IT service provider and delivers IT solutions that drive the group's digitalization. With more than 11,000 employees in over 20 countries around the world, Allianz Technology is tasked with running, optimizing, transforming, and innovating the infrastructure, applications, and services together with Allianz companies to co-create the best customer experience. We service the entire spectrum of digitalization – from one of the industry's largest IT infrastructure projects that spans data centres, networks, and security, to application platforms ranging from workplace services to digital interaction. In short: We deliver comprehensive end-to-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age. We are the backbone of Allianz.

Find Us At

www.linkedin.com/company/allianz-technology

Commitment to Integrity, Fairness & Inclusion

Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace individuals of all gender identities and expressions, sexual orientations, ethnicities, ages, nationalities, religions, disabilities, and philosophies of life. Ultimately, our greatest strength as a company lies in the unique skills, experiences, and backgrounds our employees contribute.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

descriptionHtml:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. 

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

Reporting to the VP, Cloud Operations & GRC, the Sr. Security & Compliance Analyst will support the execution and continuous improvement of Energy Exemplar’s security, risk, compliance, vulnerability management, and AI governance programs across cloud and enterprise operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Support security and compliance programs aligned with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, privacy, and emerging AI governance requirements.
  • Coordinate and drive vulnerability remediation activities across Engineering, Cloud Operations, IT, and Product teams to ensure remediation within defined EE SLAs.
  • Track and report security metrics, including MTTR, overdue vulnerabilities, remediation trends, audit findings, and compliance dashboards.
  • Proactively follow up and escalate unresolved vulnerabilities, audit findings, and compliance gaps.
  • Support continuous control monitoring, risk assessments, third-party risk management, policy management, access reviews, and audit activities.
  • Respond to customer security and compliance due diligence requests, audits, and questionnaires.
  • Support AI governance, security, and compliance initiatives, including assessment of AI-related risks, emerging regulations, and industry standards (e.g., ISO 42001, EU AI Act, privacy requirements).
  • Assist in evaluating AI-enabled solutions and third-party AI services for security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, privacy regulations, and industry compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive remediation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications:

  • 6–8 years of experience in Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), cybersecurity, information security, or risk management.
  • Strong understanding of ISO 27001, SOC 1 / SOC 2, GDPR/privacy principles, vulnerability management, and security controls.
  • Experience in Energy / Utilities sector security and compliance requirements (e.g., CEII or critical infrastructure requirements)
  • Experience coordinating vulnerability remediation programs, tracking SLA compliance, MTTR metrics, and executive reporting.
  • Experience supporting audits, customer security reviews, and compliance programs.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI governance, privacy, and security frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001, EU AI Act, responsible AI principles) preferred.
  • Strong communication, organizational, stakeholder management, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively drive outcomes across distributed teams.

Preferred Certifications:

  • CISSP, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or similar certifications.
  • AI governance/privacy certifications are a plus.

 

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.

Product Security Engineer

Location: Pune, India

Model of Work: Hybrid

  • Hours of operation: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM CT (UTC−6) / 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST (UTC+5:30), a nine-hour day. IST hours move one hour earlier while the US is on daylight saving time.
  • Shift timing: After six months, we may evaluate moving to a second shift of 1:00 AM – 10:00 AM CT (UTC−6) / 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST (UTC+5:30).

About Quorum Software

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com

Be a part of our legacy

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

Who We Are Looking For

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

We are looking for a hands-on security engineer who likes turning a design into something that runs every day: scanners wired into pipelines, guardrails enforced by policy, findings closed on time, and a monthly report that shows the trend. You enjoy working alongside software engineers, and you use AI agents as a normal part of how the work gets done.

Job Purpose

Quorum's products help energy companies operate critical infrastructure, so customers hold us to a high security bar. Our Product and Cloud Security team, part of Global Cloud Operations, owns build-side security: the security of the software we ship and the Azure platform it runs on.

The Director, Security Architect sets the direction and produces the designs: reference architectures, threat models, standards, and guardrails. You are the engineer who puts them into practice with the product and platform teams. You assist in running the Product Security Guild's monthly maturity scoring, operate the application security tooling, implement cloud guardrails, track findings to closure, and produce the evidence that audits and customers ask for.

This is a build and operate role. Success is measured by maturity scores that rise, findings closed within SLA, and controls that are checked automatically.

What You Will Do

  • Maturity reporting: Run the monthly security maturity cycle for every product and platform: collect evidence, score each product against the security requirements list, publish the report, and keep the Cloud Portal security dashboard current. Move scores from self-assessment to automated evidence wherever tooling allows.
  • Product Security Guild: Support the Product Security Guild day to day: onboard product security champions, run working sessions, answer questions on the requirements, and keep the requirements list and its guidance up to date.
  • Application security tooling: Integrate, tune, and operate SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in Azure DevOps and GitHub pipelines. Keep signal high and noise low, triage findings with engineering teams, and track remediation against SLAs in Azure DevOps.
  • Threat modeling: Facilitate threat modeling sessions with product teams using the architect's templates, record the results, and turn the agreed mitigations into backlog items.
  • Cloud security guardrails: Implement the Azure guardrails the architect designs: Azure Policy definitions and assignments, Defender for Cloud configuration, and private networking standards, held as code in Bicep or Terraform. Triage cloud security posture findings and drive them to closure with the Cloud Platform team.
  • Secrets management: Help roll out vault-based secret storage and rotation, and run secret detection so credentials stay out of source code and pipelines.
  • Identity and tenant isolation testing: Build and run automated tests for customer-facing identity and tenant isolation, so a release that lets one customer reach another's data fails before it ships.
  • Pentest remediation: Track penetration test and red-team findings from intake to verified fix, coordinate retests, and report status to the architect.
  • Audit evidence and questionnaires: Gather product and cloud evidence for SOC 2 and ISO 27001, draft answers to customer security questionnaires for review, and keep a reusable answer library current.
  • Incident support: Support containment and investigation inside the product and Azure estate during security incidents, working within the CISO-led incident response process.
  • AI-assisted delivery: Use Claude Code and agentic workflows as a default way of working for evidence collection, finding triage, policy authoring, and reporting. Review AI-generated code and configuration before it reaches production, and own the result.
  • And other duties as assigned.

What To Bring

Security engineering experience (required): At least four years in application security, cloud security, or DevSecOps, with a total of five to eight years in software engineering, platform engineering, or security roles. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field.

Secure SDLC tooling (required): Hands-on experience integrating and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in CI/CD pipelines, with tools such as Checkmarx, Veracode, SonarQube, Snyk, Mend, GitHub Advanced Security, Microsoft Defender for DevOps, or OWASP ZAP. You can tell a real finding from a false positive and explain the fix to a developer.

Azure security (required): Working experience with Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, network security groups, private endpoints, and Key Vault. You have written or changed infrastructure as code in Bicep or Terraform.

Application security knowledge (required): Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10, common web and API vulnerabilities, and how they are fixed in code. Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.

Scripting and automation (required): Confident with Python or PowerShell for automating checks, pulling data from APIs, and building reports. Comfortable with Azure DevOps or GitHub for pipelines and work tracking.

AI-assisted working methods (required): Demonstrated delivery using AI coding and automation tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, with the judgment to review and verify what they produce. Claude Code experience is strongly preferred.

Certifications (strongly preferred): At least one Azure certification, such as AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer, AZ-104 Azure Administrator or SC-100 Cybersecurity Architect, and at least one security certification, such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, OSCP, GIAC (GWAPT, GCSA), CSSLP or CISSP.

Compliance awareness: Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence collection and to customer security questionnaires.

Communication: Clear written and spoken English. You can work with engineering teams across time zones, explain why a finding matters, and keep work moving across teams.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products and tenant isolation testing.
  • Experience securing AI and LLM applications, including prompt injection and data leakage risks.
  • Container and Kubernetes security, including image scanning and admission policies.
  • Microsoft Sentinel or KQL for detection and investigation.
  • Background in energy, utilities, or other critical-infrastructure industries.

Additional Details

  • Hours of operation: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM CT (UTC−6) / 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST (UTC+5:30), a nine-hour day. IST hours move one hour earlier while the US is on daylight saving time.
  • Shift timing: After six months, we may evaluate moving to a second shift of 1:00 AM – 10:00 AM CT (UTC−6) / 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST (UTC+5:30).
  • Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

Success in the First 90 Days

  • The first monthly maturity report published, with every product and platform scored once against requirements list v1.
  • Security champions named in each product and platform group, with a regular Guild working session running.
  • SAST, SCA, and secrets scanning running in the pipelines of at least two products, with findings flowing into Azure DevOps and remediation SLAs agreed.
  • All open penetration test findings logged in Azure DevOps with owners, due dates, and a weekly status view for the architect.
  • A reusable customer security questionnaire answer library in place, covering the most common product and cloud questions.
  • At least one recurring task, such as evidence collection or finding triage, running as an agentic workflow.

Quorum Diversity Statement: At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a member of the Human Resources Department

Recruitment Scam Alert: Quorum Software does not charge fees, request payments, conduct interviews via messaging apps, or request the installation of software at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate recruitment activities are conducted exclusively through our official careers website (www.quorumsoftware.com/careers) and email addresses ending in @quorumsoftware.com. Any communication that does not originate from these official channels should be considered unauthorized and may be reported to [email protected]

By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

Job Purpose

Designs, implements, manages and supports enterprise infrastructure environments across on-premises and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure and OCI), covering Windows Server administration, Active Directory services, VMware virtualization, monitoring platforms, and infrastructure automation using Ansible and Terraform. Ensures high availability, security, performance and operational excellence of critical infrastructure services in collaboration with internal and external teams, in line with prescribed IT measures and ISA’s adopted policies and procedures.

Key Result Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure

  • Administers and supports Cloud Infrastructure environments.
  • Deploys, configures and maintains networking, compute, storage and security services.
  • Manages cloud resource provisioning, performance optimization and cost management.
  • Implements cloud governance, backup and disaster recovery.
  • Supports cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

Windows Infrastructure

  • Installs, configures, maintains and troubleshoots Windows Server environments.
  • Manages Windows Server upgrades, patching and lifecycle management.
  • Performs system performance tuning and capacity planning.
  • Supports highly available enterprise infrastructure platforms.

Active Directory, DNS & Core Infrastructure Services

  • Manages user provisioning, authentication and access controls.
  • Supports DNS, DHCP, Certificate Services and Federation Services.
  • Troubleshoots identity and authentication-related issues.
  • Manages name resolution, DNS zones, forwarders and replication.
  • Supports DHCP and related network services.
  • Ensures availability and reliability of core infrastructure services.

Infrastructure Automation

  • Develops and maintains automation solutions using Ansible.
  • Creates Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments using Terraform.
  • Automates provisioning, configuration management, patching and compliance tasks.
  • Maintains code repositories and automation documentation.
  • Implements CI/CD practices for infrastructure deployments.

Monitoring & Operations

  • Manages enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Configures monitoring, alerting, dashboards and reporting.
  • Analyzes infrastructure health and performance metrics.
  • Supports proactive incident detection and resolution.
  • Participates in on-call support and major incident management.
  • Prepares technical documentation, SOPs and operational runbooks.

Security & Compliance

  • Implements security standards and hardening guidelines.
  • Manages vulnerability remediation activities.
  • Supports audit, compliance and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensures adherence to organizational security policies.

General

  • Builds effective relationships with internal and external parties to ensure smooth operations, compliance with policies, and timely and right execution of SLAs and business plans.
  • Delivers clear, concise and timely communication to ISA clients to provide them with the best customer experience possible.
  • Performs any other additional duties as directed by the line manager.

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of Infrastructure Engineering experience.
  • 1 year of public cloud administration experience (AWS, Azure, or OCI).
  • Experience managing and supporting hybrid infrastructure environments.

Preferred Certifications

  • Any cloud certification.
  • Microsoft certification.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

Work Experience

  • Fluent in English Language.
  • 3+ years in an enterprise-level IT environment with 24x7 critical operations, implementing, troubleshooting and maintaining complex hybrid infrastructure.

Required Technical Skills

  • Infrastructure: Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS & DHCP, VMware.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Cloud networking, compute and storage services, cloud security concepts, disaster recovery.
  • Automation: Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell scripting, Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Monitoring Tools: Experience with one or more of Zabbix, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus.
  • Operating Systems: Windows Server; basic Linux administration.

Additional Skills

  • ITIL practices.
  • Backup & recovery solutions.
  • Documentation and technical writing.
  • Troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

Abilities

  • Proven skills in analyzing data, identifying pitfalls and recommending cost-effective solutions.
  • Cost-oriented; possesses effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Detail oriented; works well under pressure.
  • Employs technical expertise and interpersonal relations to achieve company’s objectives.
  • Demonstrates the ability to contribute and successfully deliver against business strategy and set KPIs.

descriptionHtml:
Role - Lead/Staff - Information Security Engineer-Security Red Team(India)

Job Location - Pune/Hyderabad

Work Mode - Hybrid


Role Overview


You will be part of the global Enterprise Cyber Security organization responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of security controls, identifying realistic attack paths, and strengthening enterprise defenses. The Red Team partners with Security Operations, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, Security Engineering, and technology teams across regions. This India-based position supports authorized global security engagements and advanced incident investigations.

As a Staff Information Security Engineer – Security Red Team (India), you will serve as a hands-on senior individual contributor and technical lead for authorized offensive security engagements, penetration testing, and Level 3 Incident Response support. You will lead engagements from planning and execution through reporting and remediation validation; coordinate internal engineers and external testing partners; and provide advanced investigative expertise during security incidents. The role has no formal people-management responsibilities and participates in an on-call rotation for global incident response.


Impact of the Role

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of security controls, identify realistic attack paths, and strengthen enterprise defenses.
  • Lead authorized global security engagements and support advanced incident investigations.
  • Translate Red Team and incident findings into detection improvements, response playbooks, and defensive control validation.
  • Provide advanced technical leadership and investigative expertise during security incidents.


Technology Platforms You Will Work On

• Cobalt Strike, BloodHound Enterprise, Burp Suite, Metasploit, and Kali Linux.

• CrowdStrike and Google SecOps or comparable EDR/SIEM technologies.

• Windows and Linux operating systems.

• Active Directory, enterprise networking, cloud environments, web applications, and APIs.

• MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Python and PowerShell for scripting and automation.

• Endpoint, identity, network, and SIEM technologies.

• Modern security assessment and forensic tools.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead authorized internal and external network penetration tests, web application and API testing, Active Directory and identity attack-path assessments, and cloud penetration tests.
  • Plan and execute Red Team adversary simulations, Purple Team exercises with SOC and Detection Engineering, and approved social engineering assessments.
  • Define engagement objectives, scope, written authorization, rules of engagement, testing windows, safety controls, and communication plans to minimize production disruption.
  • Coordinate internal Red Team resources and external penetration-testing vendors, including schedules, deliverables, evidence quality, and follow-up testing.
  • Perform controlled vulnerability exploitation and validation to establish realistic impact and prioritize remediation; use approved tooling such as Cobalt Strike, BloodHound Enterprise, Burp Suite, Metasploit, and Kali Linux.
  • Produce clear technical findings, executive-level reports, evidence, risk context, and actionable remediation recommendations; coordinate validation and retesting with system owners.
  • Provide Level 3 Incident Response escalation for complex investigations, including endpoint forensic analysis, malware triage and analysis, advanced threat hunting, and investigation of lateral movement, persistence, and identity compromise.
  • Correlate endpoint, identity, network, and SIEM evidence; preserve investigative artifacts and chain-of-custody practices where applicable; document findings and recommend containment and recovery actions.
  • Work under the designated incident-response leadership and approved playbooks to support containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident lessons learned; do not assume Incident Commander authority.
  • Translate Red Team and incident findings into detection improvements, response playbooks, and defensive control validation in partnership with SOC, Threat Intelligence, and Detection Engineering.
  • Mentor engineers through technical guidance and knowledge transfer, develop reusable engagement methodologies, and identify safe opportunities for scripting and automation.
  • Collaborate with global Cybersecurity leadership and participate in India-based business-hour coverage and a scheduled on-call rotation for global Incident Response escalations.


Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in offensive security, penetration testing, Red Team operations, incident response, or related cybersecurity engineering, including substantial hands-on offensive security experience.
  • At least one recognized offensive security or penetration-testing certification: CEH, LPT, OSCP, GPEN, PNPT, or a comparable certification.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading authorized penetration tests and Red Team engagements, including rules of engagement, evidence collection, technical reporting, and remediation validation.
  • Advanced understanding of enterprise networking, Windows and Linux, Active Directory, cloud environments, web applications, APIs, and common attacker tactics and techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with complex security incident investigations, endpoint forensic artifacts, malware analysis or triage, threat hunting, and technical containment recommendations.
  • Ability to lead technical initiatives without direct-report authority and communicate clearly with engineering teams, global stakeholders, and security leadership.
  • Ability to participate in a scheduled on-call rotation and coordinate effectively across India and U.S. time zones.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Practical experience with Cobalt Strike, BloodHound Enterprise, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and modern assessment or forensic tooling.
  • Experience using CrowdStrike and Google SecOps or comparable EDR/SIEM technologies for advanced incident investigations.
  • Experience mapping offensive testing and investigations to MITRE ATT&CK and running Purple Team exercises.
  • Scripting and automation experience with Python or PowerShell and familiarity with repeatable testing workflows.
  • Experience in complex global enterprise or retail/eCommerce environments, including coordination with third-party testing providers.


Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

  • Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
  • Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.
  • Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
  • Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.
  • Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

We are seeking a Technical Implementation Engineer (TIE) to lead the onboarding and technical enablement of enterprise customers across multiple Qualys cybersecurity products, including VMDR, CSAM, Patch Management, Policy Compliance, WAS, and Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM). You will play a critical role in helping customers integrate these solutions into their environments and derive maximum value aligned with their cybersecurity goals.

This role involves hands-on implementation, technical consulting, and driving customer success in hybrid, cloud, and containerised environments.

This is a Global role, so you may be working across different shifts(including Night shifts) supporting Customers across multiple timezones.

We work in Hybrid mode (3 days from office, 2 days from home) Relocation to Pune would be required for the role.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Onboarding & Enablement

  • Lead end-to-end onboarding for enterprise customers on multiple Qualys Cyber Security products
  • Conduct kickoff sessions, product walkthroughs, and configuration workshops tailored to customer needs.
  • Align solution deployment/configuration/optimisation with customer business goals, security policies, and compliance requirements.


Technical Implementation

  • Assist with the deployment and configuration of Qualys agents, sensors, connectors, and APIs across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments.
  • Support secure integration with AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, and containerized platforms such as Kubernetes, Docker, and CRI-o.
  • Provide expertise in asset discovery, patch deployment, vulnerability scanning, and policy configuration.


Customer Success & Adoption

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the implementation phase, ensuring successful adoption and long-term retention.
  • Educate and guide customers on platform capabilities, security use cases, and best practices.
  • Design and manage onboarding plans, training sessions, and success criteria tracking.


Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with internal teams including Product Management, Support, and Engineering to resolve implementation challenges and shape future enhancements.
  • Collect feedback to inform product development and improve onboarding frameworks.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (e.g., onboarding, professional services, customer success, pre-sales, or support).
  • Hands-on experience in enterprise IT environments, with working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and basic networking concepts.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, compliance frameworks, and threat detection tools.


Tooling & Platform Knowledge

  • Ability to deploy and manage endpoint agents, connectors, and policy configurations across diverse systems.
  • Experience in working with security scanning tools, configuration baselines, patch rollouts, and dashboards.


Communication & Interpersonal Skills

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and client engagement skills.
  • Proven ability to simplify complex topics for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.


Mindset & Adaptability

  • Analytical thinker with problem-solving orientation.
  • Flexible working schedule, as role requires
  • Able to work independently and manage multiple onboarding projects simultaneously.
  • Collaborative and empathetic approach to building customer relationships.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience with Qualys platform (as an end-user, consultant, or sales engineer).
  • Understanding of IT asset management, configuration compliance, and security operations workflows.
  • Exposure to container technologies (Kubernetes, Docker, CRI-o).

title: Staff Security Engineer
description: Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?About The RoleWe are looking for a highly experienced Staff Engineer with deep expertise in Windows internals, Active Directory internals, and AD security. This is a single, combined role: you will build the Windows agent, model Active Directory at the protocol and database level, and reason about how attackers compromise a directory and how a defender recovers from it. The work spans granular change tracking, object recovery, forest-level backup, identity threat detection, and full forest recovery onto clean operating systems.How You'll Spend Your Time HereDesign and deliver AD protection features: granular change tracking, object- and attribute-level recovery, forest-aware backup, and full forest recovery.Build and own the Windows agenta signed, serviceable, silently upgradeable component running on domain controllers.Design identity threat detection: change-delta engines, rules for privileged-object and ACL abuse, and the findings pipeline into audit log and SIEM.Own the safety of write and restore paths — idempotent steps, USN-rollback safety, pre-flight validation before any destructive action.Engage across the security lifecycle: threat modeling, architecture review, attack-surface reduction, vulnerability remediation.Work hands-on in code and test automation, including automated recovery drills and fidelity validation.Lead projects, mentor engineers, and build Windows and AD depth across the team.We'd Love to Talk to You If You Have Many of the FollowingEducationB.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.Experience10+ years in software design and development, with significant time on Windows-platform software.5+ years with Active Directory internals — building software that reads, writes, replicates, backs up, or recovers directory data, not only administering it.3+ years security-focused: identity security, detection engineering, security architecture, or product security.Shipping agent or systems software onto customer-managed production infrastructure.Windows Platform & Agent EngineeringWindows internals: registry and hive structure, the SYSTEM hive and BootKey material, WMI, services, RPC.Agent development in C++, C#, or Go; VSS writers and shadow copy APIs — writer sets, freeze/thaw, DiskShadow, orphaned shadows.Windows security model: SIDs, tokens, privileges, ACLs and SDDL, impersonation, service accounts.Serviceability and transport: code signing, MSI packaging, silent upgrade, mTLS and certificate handling, gRPC agent-to-cluster channels with resumable operations.Debugging: WinDbg, ETW, performance counters, dump analysis; PowerShell modules, remoting, and hosting PowerShell from native code.Active Directory InternalsSchema, object classes, naming contexts, linked-value replication; safe writes — modify, ModifyDN, object create.LDAP at depth: filters, server controls, paged and persistent search, change notification; DirSync and USN cookies for incremental capture.Tombstones, deleted-object lifetime, Recycle Bin; SID, SID history and GUID continuity semantics.Group Policy internals (GPC/GPT, SYSVOL, DFSR/FRS, authoritative restore); AD-integrated DNS zones, forwarders, delegation.Database and topology mechanics: ESE/JET, ntds.dit and logs, esentutl, FSMO, trusts, repadmin/dcdiag, USN rollback, DC promotion, IFM, DSRM, RODC.Active Directory Security & ITDRKerberos and NTLM internals: ticket flow, delegation, krbtgt and its role in forest compromise and recovery.AD attack techniques and their detectable artifacts — DCSync, DCShadow, AdminSDHolder tampering, ACL abuse, privileged group manipulation, ticket forgery.Detection engineering: deterministic rules with low false-positive rates, baseline-diff and attack-path reasoning; AD auditing and change attribution.Cyber recovery of identity: clean-source and clean-OS principles, malware re-introduction risk in image-based restore, isolation during recovery.SIEM integration (syslog, CEF, webhooks); descriptionHtml:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.

We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

About The Role

We are looking for a highly experienced Staff Engineer with deep expertise in Windows internals, Active Directory internals, and AD security. This is a single, combined role: you will build the Windows agent, model Active Directory at the protocol and database level, and reason about how attackers compromise a directory and how a defender recovers from it. The work spans granular change tracking, object recovery, forest-level backup, identity threat detection, and full forest recovery onto clean operating systems.

How You'll Spend Your Time Here

  • Design and deliver AD protection features: granular change tracking, object- and attribute-level recovery, forest-aware backup, and full forest recovery.
  • Build and own the Windows agenta signed, serviceable, silently upgradeable component running on domain controllers.
  • Design identity threat detection: change-delta engines, rules for privileged-object and ACL abuse, and the findings pipeline into audit log and SIEM.
  • Own the safety of write and restore paths — idempotent steps, USN-rollback safety, pre-flight validation before any destructive action.
  • Engage across the security lifecycle: threat modeling, architecture review, attack-surface reduction, vulnerability remediation.
  • Work hands-on in code and test automation, including automated recovery drills and fidelity validation.
  • Lead projects, mentor engineers, and build Windows and AD depth across the team.

We'd Love to Talk to You If You Have Many of the Following

Education

  • B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

  • 10+ years in software design and development, with significant time on Windows-platform software.
  • 5+ years with Active Directory internals — building software that reads, writes, replicates, backs up, or recovers directory data, not only administering it.
  • 3+ years security-focused: identity security, detection engineering, security architecture, or product security.
  • Shipping agent or systems software onto customer-managed production infrastructure.

Windows Platform & Agent Engineering

  • Windows internals: registry and hive structure, the SYSTEM hive and BootKey material, WMI, services, RPC.
  • Agent development in C++, C#, or Go; VSS writers and shadow copy APIs — writer sets, freeze/thaw, DiskShadow, orphaned shadows.
  • Windows security model: SIDs, tokens, privileges, ACLs and SDDL, impersonation, service accounts.
  • Serviceability and transport: code signing, MSI packaging, silent upgrade, mTLS and certificate handling, gRPC agent-to-cluster channels with resumable operations.
  • Debugging: WinDbg, ETW, performance counters, dump analysis; PowerShell modules, remoting, and hosting PowerShell from native code.

Active Directory Internals

  • Schema, object classes, naming contexts, linked-value replication; safe writes — modify, ModifyDN, object create.
  • LDAP at depth: filters, server controls, paged and persistent search, change notification; DirSync and USN cookies for incremental capture.
  • Tombstones, deleted-object lifetime, Recycle Bin; SID, SID history and GUID continuity semantics.
  • Group Policy internals (GPC/GPT, SYSVOL, DFSR/FRS, authoritative restore); AD-integrated DNS zones, forwarders, delegation.
  • Database and topology mechanics: ESE/JET, ntds.dit and logs, esentutl, FSMO, trusts, repadmin/dcdiag, USN rollback, DC promotion, IFM, DSRM, RODC.

Active Directory Security & ITDR

  • Kerberos and NTLM internals: ticket flow, delegation, krbtgt and its role in forest compromise and recovery.
  • AD attack techniques and their detectable artifacts — DCSync, DCShadow, AdminSDHolder tampering, ACL abuse, privileged group manipulation, ticket forgery.
  • Detection engineering: deterministic rules with low false-positive rates, baseline-diff and attack-path reasoning; AD auditing and change attribution.
  • Cyber recovery of identity: clean-source and clean-OS principles, malware re-introduction risk in image-based restore, isolation during recovery.
  • SIEM integration (syslog, CEF, webhooks); threat modeling a component that runs privileged on a domain controller.

General

  • Distributed systems: durable state machines, idempotency, crash recovery and resume, long-running orchestration. Protocols: LDAP, Kerberos, DNS, SMB, TLS, gRPC, REST.
  • Test automation for infrastructure software: multi-domain forest labs, destructive recovery drills, upgrade and interop matrices.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent analytical skills under incomplete information — customer forests are never the lab forest.
  • Ability to lead initiatives, mentor, and explain directory-level failure modes to non-specialist audiences.
  • Sound judgement about risk. Recovery software gets one chance to be right, and knowing when not to proceed matters as much as knowing how.

Nice to Have

  • A commercial AD backup, recovery, or ITDR product, or having executed a real forest recovery.
  • AD tooling — DSInternals, BloodHound, PingCastle; hybrid identity with Entra ID and Entra Connect.
  • Windows kernel or filter driver work; EDR allowlisting; air-gapped or regulated environments.
  • Published security work, CVE credits, Red/Blue Team experience; OSCP, GCFA, or equivalent.

Location

  • This position is located in our office in Bangalore or Pune, India.

For information on personal data processing, please see our Privacy Policy.

Cohesity is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us at 1-855-9COHESITY or recruiting@cohesity.com for assistance.

In-Office Expectations

Cohesity employees who are within a reasonable commute (e.g. within a forty-five (45) minute average travel time) work out of our core offices 2-3 days a week of their choosing.

We strongly prefer candidates who are currently located in or near the designated job location. Candidates outside the area should apply only if they are committed to relocating prior to their start date and have the legal right to work in the job location.

descriptionHtml:
The AI Security Engineer is responsible for building and running the security controls that find and govern the use of artificial intelligence across Danaher, including chat tools, AI platforms, and autonomous agents. The engineer configures and tunes policies and detections in CrowdStrike Falcon and AI gateways, and builds the automation that lets Danaher adopt AI safely.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, AI Security & Governance and is part of the DIS Corporate Cybersecurity - AI Security team located in Bangalore or Pune India and will be an on-site role.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

  • Configure, tune, and maintain security policies for the AI control plane in CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) and Falcon Shield, including access rules, prompt rules, and report, transform, or block actions.
  • Manage policy and configuration for AI gateways that cover gaps the CrowdStrike tools cannot reach.
  • Build alerts and detections for unapproved AI use, risky agent behavior, and policy violations, aligned to the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications.
  • Build the automation yourself: prove a task by hand in the platform, then automate it with Python, PowerShell, and platform APIs.
  • Contribute to AI security design with the AI Security Architect, and coordinate with the Security Operations Center and the CrowdStrike engineering team.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 9+ years of security engineering experience, including hands-on work on endpoint, software-as-a-service, or cloud security platforms.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, or customizing CrowdStrike Falcon, such as policy authoring, integrations, detection logic, or console administration.
  • Experience writing and tuning detection logic and security policy, and building automation for it with Python, PowerShell, or platform APIs.
  • Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, including how prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency map to policy or detection logic.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) or Falcon Shield.
  • AI gateways or AI security platforms (such as JetStream, LiteLLM, or Prisma AIRS), or security for Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
  • Securing autonomous AI agents or Model Context Protocol servers.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

descriptionHtml:
Cyber- IGA Engineer

Maersk is going through a time of unprecedented change, transforming our business to becoming the global integrator of container logistics. We are a product and platform led organisation and undertaking an agile transformation across our enterprise.

In this role you will become a key part of our scrum teams in our cyber security platform where we develop cyber security products and services to our customers thereby providing a cyber secure IT environment for our colleagues, customers and third parties we collaborate with.

You will be part of the IGA platform team within Maersk and you are expected to contribute to our agile journey. Being part of Maersk means working and communicating across geographical and cultural borders that will enable you to build a strong professional network. We will provide you with opportunities to broaden your knowledge and strengthen your technical and professional foundation.

The role:

As a key member of our wider Identity Access Management (IAM) operations team where your expertise and valued input will be directed toward Identity Governance and Administration.

Working with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders your key responsibilities will include:

  • Work within the IAM / IGA operations team developing and supporting other team members
  • Work closely with other interdependent engineers and solution architects to produce technical requirements and ensure solutions work together and fulfil business needs.
  • Work as team to provide deliver required solutions as well as actively contribute in supporting the IGA platform ensuring uptime and efficiency of the plaftform as well as continuous improvements..
  • Activity participate in the scrum rituals.

Generally, you will be experienced working in an agile environment with the application of Cyber Security within DEVSECOPS and a good understanding of customer centric design principles and software development.

You will be able to manage conflicting priorities & tasks and effectively prioritize in a dynamic, collaborative and decentralized work environment

You will also have some knowledge of compliance standards like CIS, NIST in conjunction with PCI-DSS and GDPR and working knowledge of secure development practices and standards such as OWASP and BSIMM (especially on cloud providers).

The Top Core Skills and Experience we’re hoping you’ll have:

  • Saviynt IGA (1 year min)
  • Any IGA platform (2 year min)
  • Java – core Java (Good to Have)

Specifically (below is the very broad wish list… and we certainly don’t expect you to have it all):

  • Exposure across one or more of the following: Identity Governance; Access Management; Privileged Access Management; Customer Identity, Enterprise Identity, OT Identity, Identity for M&A
  • Working with one or more of the following technologies: Saviynt; Delinea; AzureAD
  • Hands on experience on Saviynt version 5.5 or above
  • Worked on Following IGA integrations/components:
  • Authoritative: Workday /DB/ flat files/REST API
  • Applications: AD/AAD/SAP/REST APIs/SOAP/ Salesforce/APIs/SCIM/DB
  • Implementation experience on concepts like Segregation of Duties, Role Mining, etc..
  • Min. 3 years of IGA experience (Saviynt/SailPoint/OIM/CA IDM/NetIQ etc.)
  • Development experience in .Net and/or Java. Experience with scripting (e.g. json, python, java scripting, SQL etc..). Knowledge of APIs development and usage/consumption
  • Business development experience supporting new features and solutions to meet business requirements

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
